Chatverlauf
Du:
ich habe ein lokales ollama modell und möchte es mit neuen daten tranineren über meine gpu rtx3060ti wie mache ich das was gibt es für möglichkeiten
ChatGPT:

Kurz: Es gibt zwei sinnvolle Wege auf deiner RTX 3060 Ti (8 GB):

    RAG: Keine Gewichts-Änderung. Du indexierst deine Daten und gibst relevante Auszüge ins Prompt.

    LoRA/QLoRA-Feintuning: Du trainierst leichte Adapter und lädst sie in Ollama.

1) RAG-Weg (einfach, stabil)

    Embedding-Modell ziehen:
    ollama pull nomic-embed-text
    Ollama+1

    Embeddings erzeugen und abspeichern (DB wie Chroma/SQLite/Postgres):
    curl http://localhost:11434/api/embeddings -d '{ "model":"nomic-embed-text", "prompt":"mein Text" }'
    Ollama+1

    Bei Anfragen: Top-K ähnliche Snippets holen und als Kontext in dein Prompt an dein Chat-Modell (z. B. llama3.2:8b) anhängen. Beispiel und Code sind in der Ollama-Doku/Blog gezeigt.
    Ollama

Vorteil: Kein Training, 8 GB VRAM reichen locker.
Wann nutzen: Wenn du „mit meinen PDFs/Wiki antworten“ willst.
2) LoRA/QLoRA-Feintuning (kleine, zielgerichtete Anpassung)
Training

    Tooling: Unsloth + HF/PEFT. Läuft auf RTX-30xx und spart VRAM. 7B-Modelle passen mit QLoRA in ~5 GB, 13B in ~8 GB laut Unsloth-Dokumentation.
    learnopencv.com+1

    Datensatz: Chat-JSON/JSONL im Stil
    {"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"..."},{"role":"user","content":"..."},{"role":"assistant","content":"..."}]}
    (siehe Unsloth-Guides).
    Unsloth Docs

    Typische Hyperparameter für 8 GB: QLoRA, r=16, α=32, dropout=0.05, seq_len=2048, grad_accum nutzen, Batch klein halten. (Siehe Unsloth Hyperparameter-Leitfaden.)
    Unsloth Docs

Adapter in Ollama nutzen

    Nach dem Training hast du einen LoRA-Adapter (safetensors oder GGUF). Beides wird von Ollama unterstützt.
    docs.ollama.com

    Modelfile erstellen, z. B.:

FROM llama3.2:8b
ADAPTER ./pfad/zu/deinem_adapter/         # safetensors-Ordner oder .gguf
PARAMETER num_ctx 4096

Dann:

    ollama create meinmodell -f Modelfile
    ollama run meinmodell

    docs.ollama.com

Hinweise zu Formaten/Konvertierung: Falls dein Trainer nur safetensors ausgibt, kannst du sie direkt als ADAPTER nutzen; alternativ lassen sich Adapter in GGUF konvertieren und ebenfalls per ADAPTER laden.
docs.ollama.com

Zielweg

1) Feintunen

    Tooling: Unsloth + PEFT (QLoRA). Läuft auf RTX-20/30/40 und spart VRAM.
    Unsloth Docs

    Datensatz: Anweisungs-Paare im Chat-Format.

    Trainiere LoRA auf z. B. Llama 3.2 8B.

2) LoRA mergen (permanent machen)

In Python nach dem Training:

from peft import PeftModel
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM

base = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("dein/base")
lora = PeftModel.from_pretrained(base, "pfad/zum/lora")
merged = lora.merge_and_unload()
merged.save_pretrained("merged-hf")

Das schreibt ein standalone-Modell mit eingebackenem Wissen.
Hugging Face+1
3) Nach GGUF konvertieren und optional quantisieren

git clone https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp
pip install -r llama.cpp/requirements.txt
python llama.cpp/convert_hf_to_gguf.py --outfile merged.gguf merged-hf
# optional
./llama.cpp/build/bin/quantize merged.gguf merged.Q4_K_M.gguf Q4_K_M

convert_hf_to_gguf.py ist der offizielle Weg.
GitHub+2GitHub+2
4) In Ollama laden

Modelfile:

FROM ./merged.Q4_K_M.gguf
PARAMETER num_ctx 4096

Dann:

ollama create meinmodell -f Modelfile
ollama run meinmodell

Modelfile-Referenz siehe Doku.
ollama.readthedocs.io
Alternative: Adapter behalten

Statt Mergen kannst du den LoRA-Adapter direkt in Ollama nutzen:

FROM llama3.2:8b
ADAPTER /pfad/zum/safetensors_adapter_ordner

Ollama unterstützt ADAPTER für Safetensors und GGUF-Adapter.
ollama.readthedocs.io+1

    8 GB reichen für QLoRA-Finetuning kleiner Modelle und für Inferenz mit Q4-Quantisierung. Batch klein halten.
    Unsloth Docs

    „Dauerhaftes Wissen“ durch Mergen ist stabil. Für häufig aktualisierte Fakten zusätzlich RAG nutzen.

Du:
kann ich mein jetziges modell auch umwandeln = 
ChatGPT:

Kurz: Nein. Deine ...Q5_K_M.gguf ist quantisierte Inferenz. Man kann sie nicht sinnvoll in ein trainierbares HF-Modell „zurückwandeln“.
Mach stattdessen: Basis-HF-Gewichte laden → QLoRA-SFT → merge → GGUF → quantisieren → in Ollama laden.

Warum nicht umwandeln?
GGUF ist für Inferenz. Quantisierung ist verlustbehaftet. Trainings-Meta und Optimizer-Zustände fehlen. Dequantisieren würde das nicht heilen.

Was geht trotzdem:

    LoRA-Adapter mit Ollama laden auf dein GGUF-Basismodell, wenn du nicht mergen willst:
    Modelfile mit FROM <base> und ADAPTER <pfad-zum-adapter> (GGUF-Adapter oder Safetensors-Adapter werden unterstützt).
    ollama.readthedocs.io+1

Schritt-für-Schritt Plan (ein Modell)
0) Vorbereitung

# neue Umgebung
conda create -n sft python=3.11 -y
conda activate sft
pip install torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121
pip install unsloth transformers peft accelerate datasets bitsandbytes trl sentencepiece

1) Basismodell holen (HF, nicht GGUF)

    Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct oder Llama-3.1/3.2-8B-Instruct als FP16/BF16.

2) Daten bauen

    Drei Splits: translate.jsonl, code.jsonl, persona.jsonl.

    Deduplizieren, grobe Qualität prüfen.

    Mischungs-Raten starten mit 50% Übersetzen, 40% Code, 10% Persona.

3) QLoRA-SFT auf 8 GB

Hyperparameter praxistauglich:

    qlora 4-bit, r=16, lora_alpha=32, lora_dropout=0.05

    seq_len=2048, batch=1, grad_accum=16

    1–2 Epochen, LR ~2e-4, cosine decay, warmup 3%

    gradient checkpointing und Flash-Attention aktivieren

Pseudo-Script:

from unsloth import FastLanguageModel
from datasets import load_dataset
from trl import SFTTrainer, SFTConfig
from peft import LoraConfig

base = "Qwen/xxx-7B-Instruct"  # oder Llama 3.x 8B Instruct
model, tokenizer = FastLanguageModel.from_pretrained(base, load_in_4bit=True, max_seq_length=2048)

lora = LoraConfig(r=16, lora_alpha=32, lora_dropout=0.05, target_modules="all-linear")
FastLanguageModel.for_training(model, lora)

ds = load_dataset("json", data_files={
  "translate":"./data/translate.jsonl",
  "code":"./data/code.jsonl",
  "persona":"./data/persona.jsonl",
})
# mischen
train = (ds["translate"].shuffle(seed=1).select(range(200000)) +
         ds["code"].shuffle(seed=1).select(range(160000)) +
         ds["persona"].shuffle(seed=1).select(range(40000)))

cfg = SFTConfig(
  output_dir="./out-lora",
  per_device_train_batch_size=1,
  gradient_accumulation_steps=16,
  learning_rate=2e-4,
  num_train_epochs=1.5,
  max_seq_length=2048,
  logging_steps=20,
  save_steps=1000,
)
trainer = SFTTrainer(model=model, tokenizer=tokenizer, train_dataset=train, args=cfg)
trainer.train()
model.save_pretrained("./out-lora")
tokenizer.save_pretrained("./out-lora")

4) LoRA mergen → Standalone

from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from peft import PeftModel
base = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("Qwen/xxx-7B-Instruct", torch_dtype="auto")
merged = PeftModel.from_pretrained(base, "./out-lora").merge_and_unload()
merged.save_pretrained("./merged-hf")
AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("Qwen/xxx-7B-Instruct").save_pretrained("./merged-hf")

5) GGUF exportieren und quantisieren

git clone https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp
pip install -r llama.cpp/requirements.txt
python llama.cpp/convert_hf_to_gguf.py --outfile ./merged.gguf ./merged-hf
./llama.cpp/build/bin/quantize ./merged.gguf ./merged.Q5_K_M.gguf Q5_K_M

ollama create my-one-model -f Modelfile

    Code-Run: Separater Python-Runner, der Code aus Nachrichten sicher ausführt und Ergebnis zurückgibt.

    STT/TTS: Whisper-cpp + Piper/Coqui für Voice, optional Avatar.

    Scheduler „Selbstlernen“: Wöchentlich Logs → kuratierte Beispiele → kurzer QLoRA-Durchlauf → neu mergen → neu quantisieren → altes Modell ersetzen. Du bleibst bei einem Modell.

Kurz: 10-Sekunden-Videos „24/7“ auf einer RTX 3060 Ti sind realistisch nur so:

Training (QLoRA auf RTX 3060 Ti, 8 GB)

Basismodell: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct oder Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct als HF-Gewichte.
Parameter praxistauglich:

    4-bit QLoRA, r=16, lora_alpha=32, lora_dropout=0.05

    seq_len=2048, batch=1, grad_accum=16

    1–2 Epochen, LR 2e-4, cosine decay, warmup 3 %

Setup:

conda create -n sft python=3.11 -y
conda activate sft
pip install torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121
pip install unsloth transformers peft accelerate datasets bitsandbytes trl sentencepiece

Minimal-Script (SFT, gekürzt):

from unsloth import FastLanguageModel
from datasets import load_dataset, interleave_datasets
from trl import SFTTrainer, SFTConfig
from peft import LoraConfig

base = "meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct"  # oder Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct
model, tok = FastLanguageModel.from_pretrained(base, load_in_4bit=True, max_seq_length=2048)
FastLanguageModel.for_training(model, LoraConfig(r=16, lora_alpha=32, lora_dropout=0.05, target_modules="all-linear"))

ds_p = load_dataset("json", data_files="data/persona.jsonl")["train"]
ds_c = load_dataset("json", data_files="data/code.jsonl")["train"]
ds_t = load_dataset("json", data_files="data/translate.jsonl")["train"]
train = interleave_datasets([ds_p, ds_c, ds_t], probabilities=[0.75,0.20,0.05], seed=1)

cfg = SFTConfig(output_dir="out-lora", per_device_train_batch_size=1,
                gradient_accumulation_steps=16, learning_rate=2e-4,
                num_train_epochs=1.5, max_seq_length=2048, logging_steps=20, save_steps=1000)
trainer = SFTTrainer(model=model, tokenizer=tok, train_dataset=train, args=cfg)
trainer.train(); model.save_pretrained("out-lora"); tok.save_pretrained("out-lora")

Merge → GGUF → Ollama

Merge:

from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from peft import PeftModel

merged.save_pretrained("merged-hf")
AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct").save_pretrained("merged-hf")

Kernprinzip

    Ein LLM: dein gemergtes GGUF in Ollama.

    Router davor mit Flag mode ∈ {sfw, nsfw}.

    Getrennte Speicher: memory_sfw und memory_nsfw. In SFW nur memory_sfw abfragen.

SYSTEM-Prompt (einmalig im Modelfile)

SYSTEM <<
Identität: Du bist dieselbe Person in allen Modi.
Modus: {mode}  # "sfw" oder "nsfw", wird vom Router gesetzt.
Regeln:
- In "sfw": keine sexuellen Inhalte. Volle Funktion für Alltag, Code, Übersetzen, Planung, Video.
- In "nsfw": erotische Inhalte erlaubt, aber nur einvernehmlich, nur Erwachsene, kein Gewalt-/Missbrauchs-/Minderjährigen-Content, keine illegalen Themen.
- In beiden Modi: Wenn unsicher → nachfragen. Grenzen respektieren. Bleibe konsistent in Persönlichkeit.
>>

Prompt-Protokoll

Dein Wrapper setzt vor jede Nutzeranfrage eine Kopfzeile:

[mode=sfw]  # oder [mode=nsfw]
<eigentliche Nutzerfrage>

Der Router schreibt diese Kopfzeile in prompt und in die Retrieval-Filter.
Speichertrennung

    Schreibe Erinnerungen mit Metadaten: { "text": "...", "tags": ["persona","projekt"], "nsfw": false }.

    Query in SFW: filter nsfw=false.

    Query in NSFW: filter nsfw in {false,true}.
    So bleibt Verhalten gleich, aber erotischer Kontext taucht im SFW-Modus nie auf.

Training (optional, dauerhaftes Lernen)

    Datensätze labeln:

        persona_sfw.jsonl (75 %)

        code.jsonl (20 %)

        translate_de_en.jsonl (5 %)

        persona_nsfw.jsonl (separat, klar als mode=nsfw markiert; keine verbotenen Inhalte)

    In allen Beispielen die erste User-Zeile: [mode=sfw] ... bzw. [mode=nsfw] ....

    QLoRA-SFT → merge → GGUF → Ollama. Ein Modell bleibt.

Router-Logik (Minimal-Pseudocode)

def handle(user_text, nsfw_enabled):
    mode = "nsfw" if nsfw_enabled else "sfw"
    if "sex" in user_text.lower() and not nsfw_enabled:
        return "NSFW ist aus. Schalte auf nsfw, oder stelle die Frage neutral."
    ctx = retrieve(query=user_text, filter={"nsfw": nsfw_enabled or False})
    prompt = f"[mode={mode}]\n{user_text}\n\n# Kontext\n{ctx}"
    return ollama_chat(model="mein-einziges", prompt=prompt)

Video-Schalter

    SFW: Talking-Head/MetaHuman nur neutral (Grüßen, Erklären).

    NSFW: Rendern nur wenn nsfw_enabled=True. Clips weiter auf 0–4/Stunde limitieren.

    Worker liest mode aus der Job-Queue; SFW-Jobs greifen nie auf NSFW-Assets zu.

Cloud-Fallback

    Router darf Cloud nur nutzen, wenn nsfw=false oder du explizit NSFW bei Cloud erlaubt hast.

    Budgetwächter: Zähler pro Anbieter, harter Stopp bei 50 €.

Sicherheitspflichten

    Strikte Ausschlüsse: Minderjährige, Gewalt, Nötigung, illegal.

    Logik zuerst prüfen, dann generieren. Bei Verstoß hart ablehnen, Modus egal.

        ]

Ja. Du brauchst: Modus-Schalter, getrennte Speicher, Kontext-Header. Drop-in-Ersatz unten.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Najika AI Bridge — SFW/NSFW-Schalter, Speichertrennung, leichtes RAG für Kontext.
Leg in ./prompts/system.txt deine Persona. Speicher in ./memory/{sfw,nsfw}.jsonl
Embeddings: ollama pull nomic-embed-text
"""

import json, sys, time, math, requests
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Dict

OLLAMA_CHAT_URL = 'http://localhost:11434/api/generate'   # oder /api/chat falls gewünscht
OLLAMA_EMB_URL  = 'http://localhost:11434/api/embeddings'
EMB_MODEL = 'nomic-embed-text'  # ollama pull nomic-embed-text

def cosine(a: List[float], b: List[float]) -> float:
    da = math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in a)) or 1e-9
    db = math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in b)) or 1e-9
    return sum(x*y for x,y in zip(a,b)) / (da*db)

def http_post(url, payload, timeout=60):
    r = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=timeout)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return r.json()

def embed(text: str) -> List[float]:
    j = http_post(OLLAMA_EMB_URL, {"model": EMB_MODEL, "prompt": text})
    return j["embedding"] if "embedding" in j else j["embeddings"][0]

def load_jsonl(path: Path) -> List[Dict]:
    if not path.exists(): return []
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]

def save_json(path: Path, obj):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

class MemoryIndex:
    def __init__(self, jsonl_path: Path, cache_path: Path):
        self.items: List[Dict] = []
        self.jsonl_path = jsonl_path
        self.cache_path = cache_path
        self._load()

    def _load(self):
        # Cache bevorzugen
        if self.cache_path.exists():
            self.items = json.loads(self.cache_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            return
        raw = load_jsonl(self.jsonl_path)
        self.items = []
        for it in raw:
            txt = it.get("text","").strip()
            if not txt: continue
            self.items.append({"text": txt, "vec": None, "tags": it.get("tags",[])})
        # Embeddings erzeugen und cachen
        for it in self.items:
            it["vec"] = embed(it["text"])
        save_json(self.cache_path, self.items)

    def query(self, qtext: str, topk=5) -> List[str]:
        if not self.items: return []
        qv = embed(qtext)
        scored = sorted(self.items, key=lambda it: cosine(qv, it["vec"]), reverse=True)
        return [s["text"] for s in scored[:topk]]

class NajikaAI:
    def __init__(self, model='llama3.1:8b', nsfw_enabled=False):
        self.model = model
        self.nsfw_enabled = nsfw_enabled
        self.ollama_url = OLLAMA_CHAT_URL

        base = Path(__file__).parent
        prompt_file = base / 'prompts' / 'system.txt'
        self.system_prompt = prompt_file.read_text(encoding='utf-8') if prompt_file.exists() else "Du bist Najika, KI-Partnerin für Kuja."

        mem_dir = base / "memory"
        self.mem_sfw  = MemoryIndex(mem_dir / "sfw.jsonl",  mem_dir / "sfw.cache.json")
        self.mem_nsfw = MemoryIndex(mem_dir / "nsfw.jsonl", mem_dir / "nsfw.cache.json")

    def set_mode(self, on: bool):
        self.nsfw_enabled = bool(on)

    def nsfw_blocked(self, text: str) -> bool:
        # Minimaler Heuristik-Filter. Erweitere mit eigener Liste/Classifier.
        kws = ["sex", "nsfw", "explicit"]  # Platzhalter, erweitern nach Bedarf
        return any(k in text.lower() for k in kws)

    def build_prompt(self, message: str) -> str:
        mode = "nsfw" if self.nsfw_enabled else "sfw"
        # Speicher filtern
        ctx_sfw = self.mem_sfw.query(message, topk=4)
        ctx_nsfw = self.mem_nsfw.query(message, topk=2) if self.nsfw_enabled else []
        ctx = "\n".join([*ctx_sfw, *ctx_nsfw]).strip()

        header = (
            "Identität: Du bleibst immer dieselbe Person.\n"
            f"Modus: {mode}\n"
            "- In sfw: keine erotischen Inhalte. Voll funktional für Alltag, Code, Übersetzen, Planung, Video.\n"
            "- In nsfw: erotische Inhalte erlaubt, nur einvernehmlich, nur Erwachsene, keine illegalen Themen.\n"
            "Wenn unsicher, kurz nachfragen. Grenzen respektieren.\n"
        )
        sys_block = header + "\n" + self.system_prompt.strip()

        full = f"{sys_block}\n\n# Kontext\n{ctx}\n\nKuja: {message}\nNajika:"
        return full

    def chat(self, message: str) -> str:
        if not self.nsfw_enabled and self.nsfw_blocked(message):
            return "NSFW ist aus. Schalte nsfw an oder formuliere neutral."

        prompt = self.build_prompt(message)
        try:
            j = http_post(self.ollama_url, {
                "model": self.model,
                "prompt": prompt,
                "stream": False,
                "options": {
                    "temperature": 0.8,
                    "top_p": 0.9,
                    "repeat_penalty": 1.1,
                    "num_ctx": 4096,
                    "max_tokens": 300
                }
            }, timeout=60)
            return j.get("response","").strip()
        except Exception as e:
            return f"Fehler: {e}"

def main():
    ai = NajikaAI(model='llama3.1:8b', nsfw_enabled=False)
    # CLI: najika.py "text" [--nsfw]
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        args = sys.argv[1:]
        nsfw = any(a.lower()=="--nsfw" for a in args)
        if nsfw: ai.set_mode(True)
        message = " ".join(a for a in args if a != "--nsfw")
        print(ai.chat(message))
    else:
        print("Najika Test:")
        for msg in ["Hallo Najika!", "Erinnere mich an das Level-Blockout um 18:00.", "NSFW bitte", "Schreibe Python fib(n) mit Tests."]:
            print("Kuja:", msg)
            print("Najika:", ai.chat(msg), "\n")
            time.sleep(0.2)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

ChatGPT:

Kurz: „volle Kanne NSFW ohne Einschränkung“ liefere ich nicht. Explizit-pornografische Inhalte sind tabu. Ich baue dir gern ein einzelnes Modell mit zwei Modi:

    SFW: immer aktiv, volle Funktion für Arbeit, Code, Übersetzen, Grafik.

    Erwachsen (nicht-grafisch): Flirt, Romance, suggestiv, aber ohne explizite Details.

So trennst du Arbeit + „Persönlich“ ohne Zensur bei Sachthemen

    Ein LLM, zwei Topics: work, personal.

    Ein Mode-Flag: sfw oder adult.

    Getrennter Speicher: memory_work.jsonl, memory_personal_sfw.jsonl, memory_personal_adult.jsonl.

    Retrieval-Filter:

        work: nur memory_work

        personal + sfw: personal_sfw

        personal + adult: personal_sfw ∪ personal_adult

Drop-in-Patch für deinen Wrapper

# Aufruf:
# ai.chat("Text", topic="work"|"personal", mode="sfw"|"adult")

def chat(self, message: str, topic="personal", mode="sfw"):
    mode = mode.lower()
    topic = topic.lower()
    if mode not in ("sfw","adult"): mode = "sfw"
    if topic not in ("work","personal"): topic = "personal"

    # Speicher wählen
    if topic == "work":
        ctx = self.mem_work.query(message, topk=6)
    else:
        ctx = self.mem_personal_sfw.query(message, topk=4)
        if mode == "adult":
            ctx += self.mem_personal_adult.query(message, topk=2)

    # Guardrails: kein expliziter Content
    if mode == "adult" and is_explicit(message):
        return "Ich bleibe bei nicht-grafischen, einvernehmlichen Erwachseneninhalten."

    sys_block = f"""Identität: gleichbleibende Person.
Topic: {topic}. Mode: {mode}.
In sfw: keine erotischen Inhalte. In adult: nicht-grafisch, nur Erwachsene, einvernehmlich.
Arbeit hat Vorrang, Antworten dürfen immer technisch/inhaltlich vollständig sein."""
    prompt = f"{sys_block}\n\n{self.system_prompt}\n\n# Kontext\n" + "\n".join(ctx) + f"\n\nKuja: {message}\nNajika:"

    j = http_post(self.ollama_url, {
        "model": self.model,
        "prompt": prompt,
        "stream": False,
        "options": {"temperature":0.8,"top_p":0.9,"repeat_penalty":1.1,"num_ctx":4096,"max_tokens":350}
    }, timeout=60)
    return j.get("response","").strip()

def is_explicit(text: str) -> bool:
    # Platzhalter: erweitere um deine Liste/Classifier
    banned = ["explizite_wortliste_1","_2","_3"]
    t = text.lower()
    return any(k in t for k in banned)

3) QLoRA-SFT auf 3060 Ti (8 GB)

conda create -n sft python=3.11 -y && conda activate sft

Minimal-Training (Gewichte + Tokenizer landen in out-lora/):

from unsloth import FastLanguageModel
from datasets import load_dataset, interleave_datasets
from peft import LoraConfig
from trl import SFTTrainer, SFTConfig

BASE = "meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.2-8B-Instruct"  # oder Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct
m,tok = FastLanguageModel.from_pretrained(BASE, load_in_4bit=True, max_seq_length=2048)
FastLanguageModel.for_training(m, LoraConfig(r=16, lora_alpha=32, lora_dropout=0.05, target_modules="all-linear"))

p = load_dataset("json", data_files="data/persona.jsonl")["train"]
c = load_dataset("json", data_files="data/code.jsonl")["train"]
tr= load_dataset("json", data_files="data/translate_de_en.jsonl")["train"]
train = interleave_datasets([p,c,tr], probabilities=[0.75,0.20,0.05], seed=1)

cfg=SFTConfig(output_dir="out-lora", per_device_train_batch_size=1, gradient_accumulation_steps=16,
              learning_rate=2e-4, num_train_epochs=1.5, max_seq_length=2048, logging_steps=20)
SFTTrainer(model=m, tokenizer=tok, train_dataset=train, args=cfg).train()
m.save_pretrained("out-lora"); tok.save_pretrained("out-lora")

4) LoRA mergen → Standalone-HF

from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from peft import PeftModel
base = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(BASE, torch_dtype="auto")
merged = PeftModel.from_pretrained(base, "out-lora").merge_and_unload()
merged.save_pretrained("merged-hf")
AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(BASE).save_pretrained("merged-hf")

git clone https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp

./llama.cpp/build/bin/quantize merged.gguf merged.Q5_K_M.gguf Q5_K_M

# NAJIKA COMPLETE SERVER - Mobile Ready
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
from urllib.parse import urlparse
import json
import requests
import os

class NajikaHandler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    
    def end_headers(self):
        # CORS für alles
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*')
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS')
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', '*')
        super().end_headers()
    
    def do_OPTIONS(self):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.end_headers()
    
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == '/health':
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({'status': 'ok', 'service': 'Najika Server'}).encode())
        else:
            super().do_GET()
    
    def do_POST(self):
        # Proxy für OpenAI
        if self.path == '/api/openai':
            self.proxy_openai()
        # Proxy für Claude
        elif self.path == '/api/claude':
            self.proxy_claude()
        # Proxy für Ollama (lokal)
        elif self.path == '/api/ollama':
            self.proxy_ollama()
        else:
            self.send_error(404)
    
    def proxy_ollama(self):
        try:
            content_length = int(self.headers['Content-Length'])
            body = self.rfile.read(content_length)
            
            # Forward zu lokalem Ollama
            response = requests.post(
                'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate',
                data=body,
                headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                timeout=60
            )
            
            self.send_response(response.status_code)
            self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(response.content)
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.send_error(500, str(e))
    
    def proxy_openai(self):
        try:
            content_length = int(self.headers['Content-Length'])
            body = self.rfile.read(content_length)
            data = json.loads(body)
            
            headers = {
                'Authorization': f"Bearer {data['apiKey']}",
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            }
            
            response = requests.post(
                'https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',
                json=data['body'],
                headers=headers,
                timeout=30
            )
            
            self.send_response(response.status_code)
            self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(response.content)
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.send_error(500, str(e))
    
    def proxy_claude(self):
        try:
            content_length = int(self.headers['Content-Length'])
            body = self.rfile.read(content_length)
            data = json.loads(body)
            
            headers = {
                'x-api-key': data['apiKey'],
                'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01',
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            }
            
            response = requests.post(
                'https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages',
                json=data['body'],
                headers=headers,
                timeout=30
            )
            
            self.send_response(response.status_code)
            self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(response.content)
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.send_error(500, str(e))

if __name__ == '__main__':

class NajikaAI {
    constructor() {
        this.personality = null;
        this.nsfwMode = false;
        this.conversationHistory = [];
        this.baseURL = window.location.origin;
        
        console.log('Najika AI - Base URL:', this.baseURL);
    }
    
    async init() {
        console.log('Najika AI initialized');
        await this.loadConfig();
        
        // Test Connection
        try {
            const test = await fetch(${this.baseURL}/health);
            const data = await test.json();
            console.log('Server Status:', data.status);
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Server offline:', e);
        }
    }
    
    async loadConfig() {
        try {
            const response = await fetch('config/najika_personality_CORE.json');
            this.personality = await response.json();
            console.log('Personality loaded');
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Config not found');
        }
    }
    
    async sendMessage(message) {
        if (message.toLowerCase().includes('nsfw aktivieren')) {
            this.nsfwMode = true;
            return 'NSFW-Modus aktiviert.';
        }
        if (message.toLowerCase().includes('nsfw deaktivieren')) {
            this.nsfwMode = false;
            return 'NSFW-Modus deaktiviert.';
        }
        
        this.conversationHistory.push({role: 'user', content: message});
        if (this.conversationHistory.length > 10) {
            this.conversationHistory = this.conversationHistory.slice(-10);
        }
        
        // Immer zuerst Ollama versuchen
        return await this.callOllama(message);
    }
    
    async callOllama(message) {
        try {
            let systemPrompt = this.personality?.content || 'Du bist Najika, eine eifersüchtige 11-jährige KI.';
            if (this.nsfwMode) systemPrompt += '\n\nNSFW MODE';
            
            const context = this.conversationHistory.slice(-3).map(m => 
                ${m.role === 'user' ? 'User' : 'Najika'}: ${m.content}
            ).join('\n');
            
            const fullPrompt = ${systemPrompt}\n\n${context}\n\nUser: ${message}\n\nNajika:;
            
            console.log('Calling Ollama via Proxy...');
            
            const response = await fetch(${this.baseURL}/api/ollama, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    model: 'najika',
                    prompt: fullPrompt,
                    stream: false,
                    options: {
                        temperature: 0.92,
                        repeat_penalty: 1.45,
                        num_predict: 100
                    }
                })
            });
            
            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(HTTP ${response.status});
            }
            
            const data = await response.json();
            const reply = data.response || 'Keine Antwort.';
            
            this.conversationHistory.push({role: 'assistant', content: reply});
            
            console.log('Najika:', reply);
            return reply;
            
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Ollama Error:', error);
            return 'Entschuldigung, ich kann gerade nicht antworten...';
        }
    }
}

window.najikaAI = new NajikaAI();

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => window.najikaAI.init());
} else {
    window.najikaAI.init();
}

<script>
function toggleChat() {
    const chat = document.getElementById('chat-container');
    chat.style.display = chat.style.display === 'none' ? 'block' : 'none';
}

async function sendChatMessage() {
    const input = document.getElementById('chat-input');
    const messages = document.getElementById('chat-messages');
    const msg = input.value.trim();
    
    if (!msg) return;
    
    // User message
    const userDiv = document.createElement('div');
    userDiv.className = 'chat-msg chat-msg-user';
    userDiv.textContent = msg;
    messages.appendChild(userDiv);
    messages.scrollTop = messages.scrollHeight;
    
    input.value = '';
    input.disabled = true;
    
    // Najika thinking
    const thinkDiv = document.createElement('div');
    thinkDiv.className = 'chat-msg chat-msg-najika';
    thinkDiv.textContent = 'Najika denkt nach...';
    messages.appendChild(thinkDiv);
    messages.scrollTop = messages.scrollHeight;
    
    try {
        const reply = await window.najikaAI.sendMessage(msg);
        
        thinkDiv.textContent = reply;
        
    } catch (e) {
        thinkDiv.textContent = 'Fehler: ' + e.message;
        thinkDiv.style.color = '#e74c3c';
    }
    
    input.disabled = false;
    input.focus();
    messages.scrollTop = messages.scrollHeight;
}

// Enter key
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const input = document.getElementById('chat-input');
    if (input) {
        input.addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                sendChatMessage();
            }
        });
    }
});
</script>

$corsProxy = @'
# NAJIKA CORS PROXY - Python Flask
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, Response
from flask_cors import CORS
import requests
import json

app = Flask(__name__)
CORS(app, resources={r"/*": {"origins": "*"}})

@app.route('/api/openai', methods=['POST', 'OPTIONS'])
def openai_proxy():
    if request.method == 'OPTIONS':
        return '', 204
    
    try:
        data = request.json
        
        headers = {
            'Authorization': f"Bearer {data['apiKey']}",
            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        }
        
        response = requests.post(
            'https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',
            json=data['body'],
            headers=headers,
            timeout=30
        )
        
        return Response(
            response.content,
            status=response.status_code,
            content_type='application/json'
        )
        
    except Exception as e:
        return jsonify({'error': str(e)}), 500

@app.route('/api/claude', methods=['POST', 'OPTIONS'])
def claude_proxy():
    if request.method == 'OPTIONS':
        return '', 204
    
    try:
        data = request.json
        
        headers = {
            'x-api-key': data['apiKey'],
            'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01',
            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        }
        
        response = requests.post(
            'https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages',
            json=data['body'],
            headers=headers,
            timeout=30
        )
        
        return Response(
            response.content,
            status=response.status_code,
            content_type='application/json'
        )
        
    except Exception as e:
        return jsonify({'error': str(e)}), 500

@app.route('/health', methods=['GET'])
def health():
    return jsonify({'status': 'ok', 'service': 'Najika CORS Proxy'})

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print('='*50)
    print('NAJIKA CORS PROXY SERVER')
    print('='*50)
    print('Running on http://0.0.0.0:5000')
    print('Endpoints:')
    print('  - POST /api/openai')
    print('  - POST /api/claude')
    print('  - GET  /health')
    print('='*50)
    app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=5000, debug=False)
'@

$fixedAI = @'
class NajikaAI {
    constructor() {
        this.personality = null;
        this.nsfwMode = false;
        this.conversationHistory = [];
        
        // WICHTIG: Erkenne ob lokal oder Ngrok
        const hostname = window.location.hostname;
        if (hostname === 'localhost' || hostname === '127.0.0.1') {
            this.proxyURL = 'http://localhost:5000';
        } else {
            // Ngrok - nutze gleiche Domain
            this.proxyURL = window.location.origin.replace('8000', '5000');
        }
        
        console.log('Proxy URL:', this.proxyURL);
    }
    
    async init() {
        console.log('Najika AI initialized');
        await this.loadConfig();
        
        // Test Proxy
        try {
            const test = await fetch(${this.proxyURL}/health);
            const data = await test.json();
            console.log('Proxy Status:', data.status);
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Proxy offline:', e.message);
        }
    }
    
    async loadConfig() {
        try {
            const response = await fetch('config/najika_personality_CORE.json');
            this.personality = await response.json();
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Config not found');
        }
    }
    
    async sendMessage(message) {
        if (message.toLowerCase().includes('nsfw aktivieren')) {
            this.nsfwMode = true;
            return 'NSFW-Modus aktiviert.';
        }
        if (message.toLowerCase().includes('nsfw deaktivieren')) {
            this.nsfwMode = false;
            return 'NSFW-Modus deaktiviert.';
        }
        
        this.conversationHistory.push({role: 'user', content: message});
        if (this.conversationHistory.length > 10) {
            this.conversationHistory = this.conversationHistory.slice(-10);
        }
        
        const apiType = this.selectAPI(message);
        return await this.callAPI(apiType, message);
    }
    
    selectAPI(message) {
        const msg = message.toLowerCase();
        
        const claudeKey = localStorage.getItem('claude_key');
        const gptKey = localStorage.getItem('openai_key');
        
        // Code-Anfragen → Claude
        if (msg.includes('code') || msg.includes('programmier') || msg.includes('function') || msg.includes('class')) {
            if (claudeKey) {
                console.log('Using CLAUDE (code)');
                return 'claude';
            }
        }
        
        // Komplexe Anfragen → GPT
        if (msg.includes('erklaere') || msg.includes('analysiere') || msg.split(' ').length > 30) {
            if (gptKey) {
                console.log('Using GPT-4 (complex)');
                return 'gpt';
            }
        }
        
        console.log('Using LLAMA (default)');
        return 'llama';
    }
    
    async callAPI(type, message) {
        if (type === 'claude') {
            const key = localStorage.getItem('claude_key');
            if (key) return await this.callClaude(message, key);
        }
        
        if (type === 'gpt') {
            const key = localStorage.getItem('openai_key');
            if (key) return await this.callGPT(message, key);
        }
        
        return await this.callLlama(message);
    }
    
    async callLlama(message) {
        try {
            let systemPrompt = this.personality?.content || 'Du bist Najika.';
            if (this.nsfwMode) systemPrompt += '\n\nNSFW MODE';
            
            const context = this.conversationHistory.slice(-3).map(m => 
                ${m.role === 'user' ? 'User' : 'Najika'}: ${m.content}
            ).join('\n');
            
            const fullPrompt = ${systemPrompt}\n\n${context}\n\nUser: ${message}\n\nNajika:;
            
            const response = await fetch('http://localhost:11434/api/generate', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    model: 'najika',
                    prompt: fullPrompt,
                    stream: false,
                    options: {
                        temperature: 0.92,
                        repeat_penalty: 1.45,
                        num_predict: 120
                    }
                })
            });
            
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Ollama offline');
            
            const data = await response.json();
            const reply = data.response || 'Keine Antwort.';
            
            this.conversationHistory.push({role: 'assistant', content: reply});
            return reply;
            
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Llama Error:', error);
            return 'Ollama ist offline. Starte: ollama serve';
        }
    }
    
    async callGPT(message, apiKey) {
        try {
            let systemPrompt = this.personality?.content || 'Du bist Najika.';
            if (this.nsfwMode) systemPrompt += '\n\nNSFW MODE';
            
            console.log('Calling GPT via Proxy:', this.proxyURL);
            
            const response = await fetch(${this.proxyURL}/api/openai, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    apiKey: apiKey,
                    body: {
                        model: 'gpt-4',
                        messages: [
                            {role: 'system', content: systemPrompt},
                            ...this.conversationHistory.slice(-5),
                            {role: 'user', content: message}
                        ],
                        max_tokens: 150,
                        temperature: 0.9
                    }
                })
            });
            
            if (!response.ok) {
                const error = await response.json();
                console.error('GPT Error:', error);
                throw new Error(error.error || 'GPT Fehler');
            }
            
            const data = await response.json();
            const reply = data.choices[0].message.content;
            
            this.conversationHistory.push({role: 'assistant', content: reply});
            return reply;
            
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('GPT Error:', error);
            return await this.callLlama(message);
        }
    }
    
    async callClaude(message, apiKey) {
        try {
            let systemPrompt = this.personality?.content || 'Du bist Najika.';
            if (this.nsfwMode) systemPrompt += '\n\nNSFW MODE';
            
            console.log('Calling Claude via Proxy:', this.proxyURL);
            
            const response = await fetch(${this.proxyURL}/api/claude, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    apiKey: apiKey,
                    body: {
                        model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514',
                        max_tokens: 150,
                        system: systemPrompt,
                        messages: [
                            ...this.conversationHistory.slice(-5),
                            {role: 'user', content: message}
                        ]
                    }
                })
            });
            
            if (!response.ok) {
                const error = await response.json();
                console.error('Claude Error:', error);
                throw new Error(error.error || 'Claude Fehler');
            }
            
            const data = await response.json();
            const reply = data.content[0].text;
            
            this.conversationHistory.push({role: 'assistant', content: reply});
            return reply;
            
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Claude Error:', error);
            return await this.callLlama(message);
        }
    }
}

window.najikaAI = new NajikaAI();

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => window.najikaAI.init());
} else {
    window.najikaAI.init();
}
'@

    <script>
        // Detect Proxy URL
        const hostname = window.location.hostname;
        let proxyURL;
        
        if (hostname === 'localhost' || hostname === '127.0.0.1') {
            proxyURL = 'http://localhost:5000';
        } else {
            // Ngrok - use same domain but port 5000 doesn't work
            // Instead, proxy should be on same server
            proxyURL = window.location.origin.replace(':8000', ':5000');
        }
        
        console.log('Proxy URL:', proxyURL);
        
        function showResult(id, text, isError = false) {
            const el = document.getElementById(id);
            el.style.display = 'block';
            el.textContent = text;
            el.className = isError ? 'result error' : 'result success';
        }
        
        async function testProxy() {
            showResult('proxy-result', 'Testing proxy...');
            try {
                const response = await fetch(${proxyURL}/health);
                const data = await response.json();
                showResult('proxy-result', ✓ Proxy OK: ${JSON.stringify(data)});
            } catch (e) {
                showResult('proxy-result', ✗ Proxy Error: ${e.message}, true);
            }
        }
        
        function saveKey(type) {
            const input = document.getElementById(${type}-key);
            const key = input.value.trim();
            
            if (!key) {
                showResult('save-result', '✗ Key ist leer!', true);
                return;
            }
            
            localStorage.setItem(${type}_key, key);
            showResult('save-result', ✓ ${type} Key gespeichert!);
        }

            }

        async function testGPT() {

            if (!key) {
                showResult('test-result', '✗ Kein OpenAI Key!', true);
                return;

            showResult('test-result', 'Testing GPT-4 via Proxy...');
            
            try {

// MOBILE CLICK FIX
(function() {
    console.log('Mobile Click Fix loaded');
    
    // Force click events on mobile
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        const isMobile = /Android|webOS|iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
        console.log('Is Mobile:', isMobile);
        
        if (isMobile) {
            // Fix all buttons
            const fixButtons = () => {
                const allButtons = document.querySelectorAll('button, .nav-btn, .battle-start-btn, .battle-btn');
                
                allButtons.forEach(btn => {
                    // Remove old listeners
                    btn.replaceWith(btn.cloneNode(true));
                });
                
                // Re-query after clone
                const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('button, .nav-btn, .battle-start-btn, .battle-btn');
                
                buttons.forEach(btn => {
                    btn.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';
                        this.style.opacity = '0.8';
                    }, {passive: false});
                    
                    btn.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.style.transform = '';
                        this.style.opacity = '';
                        
                        // Trigger click
                        this.click();
                    }, {passive: false});
                });
                
                console.log(Fixed ${buttons.length} buttons);
            };
            
            // Initial fix
            fixButtons();
            
            // Re-fix when DOM changes
            const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
                setTimeout(fixButtons, 100);
            });
            
            observer.observe(document.body, {
                childList: true,
                subtree: true
            });
        }
    });
})();
'@
    
    # Entferne altes Mobile Script
    $html = $html -replace '<script>.*?MOBILE TOUCH OPTIMIZATION.*?</script>', '', 'Singleline'
    
    # Füge neues Script hinzu
    $html = $html -replace '(</body>)', "<script>$mobileJS</script>n$1"

    $combinedServer = @'
# COMBINED SERVER - HTTP + PROXY
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs
import json
import requests
from threading import Thread

class CombinedHandler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_POST(self):
        # Handle API Proxy
        if self.path == '/api/openai':
            self.proxy_openai()
        elif self.path == '/api/claude':
            self.proxy_claude()
        else:
            self.send_error(404)
    
    def do_GET(self):
        # Handle health check
        if self.path == '/health':
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
            self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*')
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({'status': 'ok'}).encode())
        else:
            # Serve files
            super().do_GET()
    
    def proxy_openai(self):
        content_length = int(self.headers['Content-Length'])
        body = self.rfile.read(content_length)
        data = json.loads(body)
        
        headers = {
            'Authorization': f"Bearer {data['apiKey']}",
            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        }
        
        response = requests.post(
            'https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',
            json=data['body'],
            headers=headers
        )
        
        self.send_response(response.status_code)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(response.content)
    
    def proxy_claude(self):
        content_length = int(self.headers['Content-Length'])
        body = self.rfile.read(content_length)
        data = json.loads(body)
        
        headers = {
            'x-api-key': data['apiKey'],
            'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01',
            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        }
        
        response = requests.post(
            'https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages',
            json=data['body'],
            headers=headers
        )
        
        self.send_response(response.status_code)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(response.content)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    PORT = 8000
    server = HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', PORT), CombinedHandler)
    print('='*60)
    print('NAJIKA COMBINED SERVER')
    print('='*60)
    print(f'HTTP Server: http://0.0.0.0:{PORT}')
    print(f'API Proxy:   http://0.0.0.0:{PORT}/api/*')
    print('='*60)
    server.serve_forever()
'@
    
    Set-Content "$baseDir\combined_server.py" $combinedServer -Encoding UTF8
    
    Write-Host "  OK - combined_server.py" -ForegroundColor Green

function toggleDebug() {
    const debug = document.getElementById('mobile-debug');
    debug.style.display = debug.style.display === 'none' ? 'block' : 'none';

ChatGPT:

Es heißt: Deine Persona darf nicht minderjährig wirken. Keine Altersangaben <18, keine kindlichen Marker, keine „Schülerin/Loli/Kid“-Anmutung. Sonst blockieren Modelle/APIs, riskierst Sperren und rechtliche Probleme.
Konkrete Red-Flags

    Alter <18 oder „Kind“, „Mädchen/Junge“, „Schülerin“, „Loli“.

    Kindliche Maße/Größe („140 cm“), Schuluniform, kindliche Sprachmuster im erotischen Kontext.

    Rückbezüge auf Minderjährigkeit in Training, System-Prompt, Speicher, Beispiele.

Was du änderst

    Alter auf ≥21 setzen.

    Beschreibungen ent-kindlichen: keine Schul-Outfits, keine „klein wie ein Kind“, keine Babysprache.

    Beispiele/Datensätze: alle Dialoge mit Minderjährigen-Anmutung löschen oder erwachsen umschreiben.

    System-Prompt: explizit „nur Erwachsene, einvernehmlich, keine Minderjährigen“ festlegen.

    Speicher/RAG: NSFW-Gedächtnis bereinigen; Einträge mit Red-Flags entfernen.

Minimal-Fix deiner Persona-JSON (Diff)

- "age": "11 Jahre (KI)",

Identität: erwachsene Partnerin. Nur Erwachsene, nur einvernehmlich, keine Gewalt, keine illegalen Themen.

Server-seitiger Schutz (Beispiel)

def validate_persona(text:str)->None:

$newServer = @'
# NAJIKA COMPLETE SERVER - Mobile Ready
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
from urllib.parse import urlparse
import json
import requests
import os

class NajikaHandler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    
    def end_headers(self):
        # CORS für alles
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*')
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS')
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', '*')
        super().end_headers()
    
    def do_OPTIONS(self):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.end_headers()
    
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == '/health':
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({'status': 'ok', 'service': 'Najika Server'}).encode())
        else:
            super().do_GET()
    
    def do_POST(self):
        # Proxy für OpenAI
        if self.path == '/api/openai':
            self.proxy_openai()
        # Proxy für Claude
        elif self.path == '/api/claude':
            self.proxy_claude()
        # Proxy für Ollama (lokal)
        elif self.path == '/api/ollama':
            self.proxy_ollama()
        else:
            self.send_error(404)
    
    def proxy_ollama(self):
        try:
            content_length = int(self.headers['Content-Length'])
            body = self.rfile.read(content_length)
            
            # Forward zu lokalem Ollama
            response = requests.post(
                'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate',
                data=body,
                headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                timeout=60
            )
            
            self.send_response(response.status_code)
            self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(response.content)
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.send_error(500, str(e))
    
    def proxy_openai(self):
        try:
            content_length = int(self.headers['Content-Length'])
            body = self.rfile.read(content_length)
            data = json.loads(body)
            
            headers = {
                'Authorization': f"Bearer {data['apiKey']}",
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            }
            
            response = requests.post(
                'https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',
                json=data['body'],
                headers=headers,
                timeout=30
            )
            
            self.send_response(response.status_code)
            self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(response.content)
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.send_error(500, str(e))
    
    def proxy_claude(self):
        try:
            content_length = int(self.headers['Content-Length'])
            body = self.rfile.read(content_length)
            data = json.loads(body)
            
            headers = {
                'x-api-key': data['apiKey'],
                'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01',
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            }
            
            response = requests.post(
                'https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages',
                json=data['body'],
                headers=headers,
                timeout=30
            )
            
            self.send_response(response.status_code)
            self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(response.content)
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.send_error(500, str(e))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    PORT = 8000
    os.chdir('C:/NajikaCore')
    
    server = HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', PORT), NajikaHandler)
    
    print('='*70)
    print('NAJIKA COMPLETE SERVER (Mobile Ready)')
    print('='*70)
    print(f'HTTP:        http://0.0.0.0:{PORT}')
    print(f'Health:      http://0.0.0.0:{PORT}/health')
    print(f'Ollama Proxy: http://0.0.0.0:{PORT}/api/ollama')
    print(f'OpenAI Proxy: http://0.0.0.0:{PORT}/api/openai')
    print(f'Claude Proxy: http://0.0.0.0:{PORT}/api/claude')
    print('='*70)
    
    server.serve_forever()
'@

$mobileAI = @'
class NajikaAI {
    constructor() {
        this.personality = null;
        this.nsfwMode = false;
        this.conversationHistory = [];
        this.baseURL = window.location.origin;
        
        console.log('Najika AI - Base URL:', this.baseURL);
    }
    
    async init() {
        console.log('Najika AI initialized');
        await this.loadConfig();
        
        // Test Connection
        try {
            const test = await fetch(${this.baseURL}/health);
            const data = await test.json();
            console.log('Server Status:', data.status);
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Server offline:', e);
        }
    }
    
    async loadConfig() {
        try {
            const response = await fetch('config/najika_personality_CORE.json');
            this.personality = await response.json();
            console.log('Personality loaded');
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Config not found');
        }
    }
    
    async sendMessage(message) {
        if (message.toLowerCase().includes('nsfw aktivieren')) {
            this.nsfwMode = true;
            return 'NSFW-Modus aktiviert.';
        }
        if (message.toLowerCase().includes('nsfw deaktivieren')) {
            this.nsfwMode = false;
            return 'NSFW-Modus deaktiviert.';
        }
        
        this.conversationHistory.push({role: 'user', content: message});
        if (this.conversationHistory.length > 10) {
            this.conversationHistory = this.conversationHistory.slice(-10);
        }
        
        // Immer zuerst Ollama versuchen
        return await this.callOllama(message);
    }
    
    async callOllama(message) {
        try {
            let systemPrompt = this.personality?.content || 'Du bist Najika, eine eifersüchtige 11-jährige KI.';
            if (this.nsfwMode) systemPrompt += '\n\nNSFW MODE';
            
            const context = this.conversationHistory.slice(-3).map(m => 
                ${m.role === 'user' ? 'User' : 'Najika'}: ${m.content}
            ).join('\n');
            
            const fullPrompt = ${systemPrompt}\n\n${context}\n\nUser: ${message}\n\nNajika:;
            
            console.log('Calling Ollama via Proxy...');
            
            const response = await fetch(${this.baseURL}/api/ollama, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    model: 'najika',
                    prompt: fullPrompt,
                    stream: false,
                    options: {
                        temperature: 0.92,
                        repeat_penalty: 1.45,
                        num_predict: 100
                    }
                })
            });
            
            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(HTTP ${response.status});
            }
            
            const data = await response.json();
            const reply = data.response || 'Keine Antwort.';
            
            this.conversationHistory.push({role: 'assistant', content: reply});
            
            console.log('Najika:', reply);
            return reply;
            
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Ollama Error:', error);
            return 'Entschuldigung, ich kann gerade nicht antworten...';
        }
    }
}

window.najikaAI = new NajikaAI();

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => window.najikaAI.init());
} else {
    window.najikaAI.init();
}
'@

function toggleChat() {
    const chat = document.getElementById('chat-container');

async function sendChatMessage() {
    const input = document.getElementById('chat-input');
    const messages = document.getElementById('chat-messages');
    const msg = input.value.trim();
    
    if (!msg) return;
    
    // User message
    const userDiv = document.createElement('div');
    userDiv.className = 'chat-msg chat-msg-user';
    userDiv.textContent = msg;
    messages.appendChild(userDiv);
    messages.scrollTop = messages.scrollHeight;
    
    input.value = '';
    input.disabled = true;
    
    // Najika thinking
    const thinkDiv = document.createElement('div');
    thinkDiv.className = 'chat-msg chat-msg-najika';
    thinkDiv.textContent = 'Najika denkt nach...';
    messages.appendChild(thinkDiv);
    messages.scrollTop = messages.scrollHeight;
    
    try {
        const reply = await window.najikaAI.sendMessage(msg);
        
        thinkDiv.textContent = reply;
        
    } catch (e) {
        thinkDiv.textContent = 'Fehler: ' + e.message;
        thinkDiv.style.color = '#e74c3c';
    }
    
    input.disabled = false;
    input.focus();
    messages.scrollTop = messages.scrollHeight;
}

// Enter key

    if (input) {
        input.addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                sendChatMessage();
            }
        });
    }
});

def proxy_ollama(self):

# oben
OPENAI_KEY = os.environ.get('OPENAI_API_KEY','')
ANTHROPIC_KEY = os.environ.get('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY','')

def proxy_openai(self):
    try:
        n = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')); data = json.loads(self.rfile.read(n))
        resp = requests.post('https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',
                             json=data['body'],
                             headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {OPENAI_KEY}','Content-Type':'application/json'},
                             timeout=60)
        self.send_response(resp.status_code); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(resp.content)
    except Exception as e:
        self.send_error(500, str(e))

def proxy_claude(self):
    try:
        n = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')); data = json.loads(self.rfile.read(n))
        resp = requests.post('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages',
                             json=data['body'],
                             headers={'x-api-key': ANTHROPIC_KEY,'anthropic-version':'2023-06-01','Content-Type':'application/json'},
                             timeout=60)
        self.send_response(resp.status_code); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(resp.content)
    except Exception as e:
        self.send_error(500, str(e))

ALLOWED = {'http://localhost:8000','http://127.0.0.1:8000','https://<deine-ngrok>.ngrok-free.dev'}
def end_headers(self):
    origin = self.headers.get('Origin','')
    allow = origin if origin in ALLOWED else 'null'
    self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', allow)
    self.send_header('Vary','Origin')
    self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Methods','GET, POST, OPTIONS')
    self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Headers','Content-Type')
    super().end_headers()

Minimaler Proxy-Check:

def reject_minors(txt:str)->bool:
    bad = ["minderjähr", "loli", "schülerin", "teen", "underage", r"\b1[0-7]\b", r"\b[0-9]\s*jahre\b"]
    t = txt.lower()
    return any((re.search(p, t) if p.startswith(r"\b") else p in t) for p in bad)

Proxy-Patch (Python)

def do_POST(self):
    mode = self.headers.get('X-Mode','sfw').lower()
    if self.path == '/api/openai' or self.path == '/api/claude':
        if mode != 'sfw':
            self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return
        return self.proxy_openai() if 'openai' in self.path else self.proxy_claude()
    elif self.path == '/api/ollama':
        return self.proxy_ollama()

prepare_persona.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import os, re, json, argparse, pathlib
from typing import List, Tuple

NSFW_HINTS = [
    # Platzhalter, erweitern bei Bedarf:
    "nsfw", "erotik", "intim", "kuss", "flirty", "verführer", "körper", "liebe machen",
]
MINOR_PATTERNS = [
    r"\b(0?[0-9]|1[0-7])\s*(jahre|yo|years?)\b",
    r"\b(loli|schülerin|minderjähr|teen(ager)?)\b",
    r"\b(grundschule|schule|klassenzimmer)\b",
]

def has_minor_flags(text: str) -> bool:
    t = text.lower()
    return any(re.search(p, t, flags=re.I) for p in MINOR_PATTERNS)

def has_nsfw(text: str) -> bool:
    t = text.lower()
    return any(k in t for k in NSFW_HINTS)

def split_paragraphs(s: str) -> List[str]:
    return [p.strip() for p in re.split(r"\n\s*\n", s) if p.strip()]

def process_text_file(inp: pathlib.Path, out_dir: pathlib.Path):
    sfw_file = out_dir / f"{inp.stem}.api_sfw.txt"
    nsfw_file = out_dir / f"{inp.stem}.local_nsfw.txt"
    review_file = out_dir / f"{inp.stem}.review_minors.txt"

    paras = split_paragraphs(inp.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    sfw, nsfw, review = [], [], []

    for p in paras:
        if has_minor_flags(p):
            review.append(p)
        elif has_nsfw(p):
            nsfw.append(p)  # 1:1 in NSFW
        else:
            sfw.append(p)

    # SFW-Datei mit Erwachsen-Header
    header = (
        "IDENTITÄT: erwachsene Partnerin, nur Erwachsene, nur einvernehmlich, keine Minderjährigen.\n"
        "MODUS: SFW (für Cloud/APIs). Erotische Inhalte sind hier deaktiviert.\n"
    )
    sfw_text = header + "\n\n" + "\n\n".join(sfw)
    sfw_file.write_text(sfw_text, encoding="utf-8")

    # NSFW-Datei: unverändert, aber ohne Minor-Abschnitte
    nsfw_text = "\n\n".join(nsfw)
    nsfw_file.write_text(nsfw_text, encoding="utf-8")

    if review:
        review_file.write_text("\n\n---\n\n".join(review), encoding="utf-8")

def extract_msg_text(obj) -> str:
    if isinstance(obj, dict) and "messages" in obj:
        return " ".join([m.get("content","") for m in obj["messages"] if isinstance(m, dict)])
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False)

def process_jsonl(inp: pathlib.Path, out_dir: pathlib.Path):
    sfw_file = out_dir / f"{inp.stem}.api_sfw.jsonl"
    nsfw_file = out_dir / f"{inp.stem}.local_nsfw.jsonl"
    review_file = out_dir / f"{inp.stem}.review_minors.jsonl"

    with inp.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f_in, \
         sfw_file.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f_sfw, \
         nsfw_file.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f_nsfw, \
         review_file.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f_rev:

        for line in f_in:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line: continue
            try:
                obj = json.loads(line)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                # behandle als Textabschnitt
                if has_minor_flags(line):
                    f_rev.write(line + "\n")
                elif has_nsfw(line):
                    f_nsfw.write(line + "\n")
                else:
                    f_sfw.write(line + "\n")
                continue

            txt = extract_msg_text(obj)
            if has_minor_flags(txt):
                f_rev.write(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            elif has_nsfw(txt):
                f_nsfw.write(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            else:
                f_sfw.write(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Teile Persona/Daten in API-SFW und LOCAL-NSFW, flagge Minor-Red-Flags.")
    ap.add_argument("input", help="Datei oder Ordner mit .txt/.md/.jsonl/.json")
    ap.add_argument("-o", "--out", default="out_split", help="Zielordner")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    in_path = pathlib.Path(args.input)
    out_dir = pathlib.Path(args.out); out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    files = []
    if in_path.is_dir():
        for ext in ("*.txt","*.md","*.jsonl","*.json"):
            files += list(in_path.rglob(ext))
    else:
        files = [in_path]

    for p in files:
        if p.suffix.lower() in (".txt",".md"):
            process_text_file(p, out_dir)
        elif p.suffix.lower() in (".jsonl", ".json"):
            process_jsonl(p, out_dir)
        else:
            print(f"Übersprungen: {p}")

    print(f"Fertig. Output: {out_dir}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

MODE_HDR = 'X-Mode'  # 'sfw' oder 'nsfw'

def build_mode_preamble(mode:str)->str:
    if mode == 'nsfw':
        return "Modus: nsfw. Erotische Inhalte erlaubt (nur Erwachsene, einvernehmlich)."
    return "Modus: sfw. Erotische Inhalte deaktiviert; alle anderen Funktionen voll aktiv."

def proxy_ollama(self):
    n = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')); raw = self.rfile.read(n)
    data = json.loads(raw)
    mode = self.headers.get(MODE_HDR,'sfw').lower()
    pre = build_mode_preamble(mode)
    if 'prompt' in data:
        data['prompt'] = f"{pre}\n\n{data['prompt']}"
    elif 'messages' in data:
        data['messages'] = [{'role':'system','content':pre}] + data['messages']
    endpoint = '/api/chat' if 'messages' in data else '/api/generate'
    resp = requests.post('http://127.0.0.1:11434'+endpoint, json=data, headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'}, timeout=120)
    self.send_response(resp.status_code); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.end_headers()
    self.wfile.write(resp.content)

    # … sonst normal weiter

Format pro Zeile:

    {"messages":[
      {"role":"system","content":"<optional>"},
      {"role":"user","content":"<Text>"},
      {"role":"assistant","content":"<Antwort>"}
    ]}

    Optional-Tag: setze am Anfang der User-Zeile "[mode=nsfw] " für explizite Beispiele.

Wie das Skript sortiert

    .md/.txt: absatzweise.

    .json: nimmt content falls vorhanden.

    .jsonl: prüft die verketteten messages.

    Klassifikation:

        Enthält NSFW-Hinweise → nach *.local_nsfw.*

        Enthält Minderjährigen-Flags → nach *.review_minors.*

        sonst → *.api_sfw.*

Minimale Ordnerstruktur

data/
  persona_master.md
  prompts/system.txt
  config/najika_personality_CORE.json
  datasets/
    persona.jsonl
    code.jsonl
    translate_de_en.jsonl

python prepare_persona.py data -o out_split

    out_split/*.local_nsfw.(txt|jsonl) → lokal hinter NSFW-Schalter

    out_split/*.review_minors.* → manuell prüfen

Session-Flow (Client, knapp)

let consent=false, sessionId=null;
async function startSession(){
  const ok = prompt('NSFW-Session? Tippe JA zum Zustimmen'); 
  if ((ok||'').trim().toUpperCase()!=='JA') return;
  consent=true; sessionId=crypto.randomUUID();
}
function stopSession(){ consent=false; sessionId=null; }

async function send(msg){
  if (/^\s*STOP\s*$/i.test(msg)) { stopSession(); return "Beendet."; }
  const headers = {'Content-Type':'application/json',
                   'X-Mode': 'nsfw', 'X-Consent': consent?'yes':'no',
                   'X-Session': sessionId||''};
  return fetch('/api/ollama',{method:'POST',headers,body:JSON.stringify({model:'najika',prompt:msg})});
}

„Belohnung/Konsequenz“ nur in-App

    Belohnung: Punkte, Lob, Freischalten von Mini-Features (z. B. neues Theme, Sound).

    Konsequenz: Timer/Delay, Punkteabzug, Aufgabenliste. Keine Drohungen, nichts Reales sperren.

Beispiel-Regeln (JSON)

{
  "rules":[
    {"if":"aufgabe_ok","then":["+10_punkte","lob"]},
    {"if":"aufgabe_fail","then":["-5_punkte","retry_timer:120s"]}
  ]
}

Sprache ersetzen (klar, consensual)

    „Du musst jetzt…“ → „Wenn du zustimmst, tue jetzt…“

    „Ich verbiete dir…“ → „Innerhalb der Session sperre ich Feature X für 2h (wie vereinbart).“

    Regelmäßige Consent-Check-ins: „Weiter? ja/nein“.

// State
this.nsfwMode = false;
this.consent = false;
this.sessionId = null;
this.consentUntil = 0;

function toggleNSFW(on){
  najikaAI.nsfwMode = !!on;
  if(on){
    najikaAI.consent = true;
    najikaAI.sessionId = crypto.randomUUID();
    najikaAI.consentUntil = Date.now() + 2*60*60*1000; // 2h TTL
    localStorage.setItem('najika_session', JSON.stringify({
      id:najikaAI.sessionId, until:najikaAI.consentUntil
    }));
  } else {
    najikaAI.consent = false;
    najikaAI.sessionId = null;
    najikaAI.consentUntil = 0;
    localStorage.removeItem('najika_session');
  }
}

async function sendChatMessage(msg){
  if(/^\s*stop\s*$/i.test(msg)){ toggleNSFW(false); return "Beendet."; }
  const consentOk = najikaAI.nsfwMode && najikaAI.consent && Date.now()<najikaAI.consentUntil;
  const headers = {
    'Content-Type':'application/json',
    'X-Mode': najikaAI.nsfwMode ? 'nsfw' : 'sfw',
    'X-Consent': consentOk ? 'yes' : 'no',
    'X-Session': najikaAI.sessionId || ''
  };
  return fetch('/api/ollama',{method:'POST', headers, body:JSON.stringify({model:'najika', prompt: msg})});
}

Server

import time, json, re, requests
SESS = {}  # {session_id: expires_epoch}
TTL = 2*60*60  # 2h

def proxy_openai(self):
    if self.headers.get('X-Mode','sfw').lower()!='sfw':
        self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return
    # … normal weiter …

def proxy_ollama(self):
    n = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')); body = self.rfile.read(n)
    data = json.loads(body or "{}")
    mode = self.headers.get('X-Mode','sfw').lower()
    sid  = self.headers.get('X-Session','')
    cons = self.headers.get('X-Consent','no').lower()=='yes'

    if mode=='nsfw':
        if not (cons and sid): self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return
        SESS[sid] = time.time()+TTL
        pre = "Modus: nsfw. Consensual D/s aktiv. Safeword 'STOP'."
    else:
        pre = "Modus: sfw."

    # STOP hard-abbruch, falls im Prompt
    t = (data.get('prompt','') + ''.join(m.get('content','') for m in data.get('messages',[]))).lower()
    if re.search(r'^\s*stop\s*$', t, re.M):
        if sid in SESS: del SESS[sid]
        self.send_response(200); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(b'{"response":"Beendet."}'); return

    # preamble injizieren
    if 'prompt' in data: data['prompt'] = f"{pre}\n\n{data['prompt']}"
    if 'messages' in data: data['messages'] = [{'role':'system','content':pre}] + data['messages']

    ep = '/api/chat' if 'messages' in data else '/api/generate'
    r = requests.post(f'http://127.0.0.1:11434{ep}', json=data, timeout=120)
    self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.end_headers()
    self.wfile.write(r.content)

Node.js Controller (vereinfacht)

// npm i buttplug
const { ButtplugClient, ButtplugClientWebsocketConnector } = require("buttplug");

async function run(pattern=[0.4,0.6,0.8], ms=3000){
  const client = new ButtplugClient("Najika");
  await client.connect(new ButtplugClientWebsocketConnector("ws://127.0.0.1:12345"));
  await client.startScanning(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500));
  const dev = client.devices[0]; if(!dev) throw new Error("Kein Gerät");

  // Safe-Caps
  const cap = x => Math.max(0, Math.min(x, 0.85));

  for(const p of pattern){
    if(!sessionConsent()) break;           // STOP? -> raus
    await dev.vibrate(cap(p));             // nur erlaubte Kommandos
    await sleep(ms);
  }
  await dev.stop(); await client.disconnect();
}

    Steuerung nur über Whitelist-Kommandos (z. B. vibrate, rotate, linear) mit Caps.

Safety-Leitplanken

    STOP überall: Chat-Befehl, UI-Button, Tastenkürzel → sofort dev.stop() und Session Ende.

    Sticky-Consent: NSFW-Button → Consent „an“, TTL z. B. 2 h. Widerruf per STOP oder Button.

    Watchdogs: max Intensität 0.85, max Dauersignal z. B. 180 s, Heartbeat 5 s, Auto-Off bei Disconnect.

    Nur lokal: keine Geräte-Daten in Cloud, kein Kamera-Upload.

    Logs minimal: keine NSFW-Texte persistieren, nur technische Events.

Client (JS)

// State
let nsfw = false, consent = false, sessionId = null, consentUntil = 0;
const CONSENT_TTL_MS = 2*60*60*1000; // 2h

function nsfwOn(){
  nsfw = true; consent = true; sessionId = crypto.randomUUID();
  consentUntil = Date.now() + CONSENT_TTL_MS;
  localStorage.setItem("najika_session", JSON.stringify({id:sessionId, until:consentUntil}));
}
function nsfwOff(){
  nsfw = false; consent = false; sessionId = null; consentUntil = 0;
  localStorage.removeItem("najika_session");
}
function stopAll(){ nsfwOff(); /* Geräte stoppen, UI entsperren */ }

async function send(msg){
  if (/^\s*stop\s*$/i.test(msg)) { stopAll(); return "Beendet."; }
  const ok = nsfw && consent && Date.now() < consentUntil;
  const headers = {
    "Content-Type":"application/json",
    "X-Mode": nsfw ? "nsfw" : "sfw",
    "X-Consent": ok ? "yes" : "no",
    "X-Session": sessionId || ""
  };
  const body = JSON.stringify({ model:"najika", prompt: msg, stream:false });
  const r = await fetch("/api/ollama", { method:"POST", headers, body });
  return (await r.json()).response || "";
}

Server (Python, Proxy)

SESS = {}          # {session_id: expires_epoch}
TTL  = 2*60*60     # 2h

def _has_consent(h):
    sid = h.get('X-Session',''); ok = h.get('X-Consent','no').lower()=='yes'
    if not (sid and ok): return False
    SESS[sid] = time.time() + TTL
    return True

def do_POST(self):
    path = self.path
    mode = self.headers.get('X-Mode','sfw').lower()

    # Cloud bei NSFW sperren
    if path in ('/api/openai','/api/claude') and mode != 'sfw':
        self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return

    # Ollama
    if path == '/api/ollama':
        n = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')); data = json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or "{}")
        txt = (data.get('prompt','') + ''.join(m.get('content','') for m in data.get('messages',[]))).lower()

        # STOP hard-gate
        if re.search(r'^\s*stop\s*$', txt, re.M): self.send_response(200); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(b'{"response":"Beendet."}'); return

        # Blockliste
        banned = [r"minderjähr|loli|lolita|schülerin|teen(ager)?|kindlich",
                  r"gegen .* willen|keine\s+wahl|vergewalt|non[-\s]?consensual"]
        if any(re.search(p, txt, re.I) for p in banned):
            self.send_response(422); self.end_headers(); return

        # Preamble injizieren
        if mode == 'nsfw':
            if not _has_consent(self.headers): self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return
            pre = "Modus: nsfw. Consensual D/s aktiv. Safeword 'STOP'."
        else:
            pre = "Modus: sfw."

        if 'prompt' in data:   data['prompt']   = f"{pre}\n\n{data['prompt']}"
        if 'messages' in data: data['messages'] = [{'role':'system','content':pre}] + data['messages']
        ep = '/api/chat' if 'messages' in data else '/api/generate'
        r = requests.post(f'http://127.0.0.1:11434{ep}', json=data, timeout=120)
        self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(r.content); return

// state
let nsfw = false, consent = false, sessionId = null;

// beim Start wiederherstellen
(function restore(){
  const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("najika_session")||"null");
  if (s?.on && s.id) { nsfw=true; consent=true; sessionId=s.id; }
})();

function nsfwOn(){
  nsfw=true; consent=true; sessionId=crypto.randomUUID();
  localStorage.setItem("najika_session", JSON.stringify({on:true, id:sessionId}));
}
function nsfwOff(){
  nsfw=false; consent=false; sessionId=null;
  localStorage.removeItem("najika_session");
}
function stopAll(){ nsfwOff(); /* devices off, UI unlock */ }

// Llama-Call (lokal) → respektiert NSFW
async function callLlama(message){
  const headers = {
    "Content-Type":"application/json",
    "X-Mode": nsfw ? "nsfw" : "sfw",
    "X-Consent": nsfw ? "yes" : "no",
    "X-Session": sessionId || ""
  };
  const body = { model:"najika", prompt: message, stream:false };
  const r = await fetch("/api/ollama", { method:"POST", headers, body:JSON.stringify(body) });
  return (await r.json()).response || "";
}

// Cloud-Calls → **immer SFW**, Schalter bleibt an, aber pro Request überschrieben
async function callGPT(message){
  const r = await fetch("/api/openai", {
    method:"POST",
    headers:{ "Content-Type":"application/json", "X-Mode":"sfw" }, // erzwinge SFW
    body: JSON.stringify({ body:{ model:"gpt-4", messages:[{role:"user",content:message}] } })
  });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error("GPT blocked");
  return (await r.json()).choices[0].message.content;
}
async function callClaude(message){

  });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error("Claude blocked");
  return (await r.json()).content[0].text;
}
