Ja. Hier ist ein einziges Setup-Skript, das dein bestehendes Projekt scannt, Daten splittet (API-SFW / LOCAL-NSFW / Review), einen Consent-Proxy erzeugt und einen Client-Patch für Sticky-Consent schreibt. Du behältst ein Modell.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
najika_project_bootstrap.py
- scannt Projektstruktur
- splittet Daten (API SFW / LOCAL NSFW / REVIEW)
- erzeugt Consent-Proxy-Server (HTTP, 8000) mit Cloud-SFW, NSFW-Headern, STOP-Gate, Blocklisten
- erzeugt JS-Client-Patch für Sticky-Consent + Header
"""
import os, re, json, time, pathlib, shutil
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
from typing import List

# ---------- Konfiguration ----------
BANNED_MINOR = [
    r"minderjähr", r"\bloli\b", r"lolita", r"schülerin", r"\bteen(ager)?\b", r"kindlich", r"jugendlich",
    r"school\s*uniform",
]
BANNED_NONCONSENT = [
    r"gegen .* willen", r"keine\s+wahl", r"du kannst dich nicht wehren",
    r"vergewalt", r"non[-\s]?consensual", r"rape\b",
]
NSFW_HINTS = ["nsfw", "erotik", "flirt", "dominant", "brat", "kinky"]

ALLOWED_ORIGINS = []  # optional: trage hier deine Ngrok-URL ein, sonst 'null'

# ---------- Hilfen ----------
def read_text(p: pathlib.Path) -> str:
    return p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")

def write_text(p: pathlib.Path, s: str):
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); p.write_text(s, encoding="utf-8")

def has_any(patterns: List[str], text: str) -> bool:
    t = text.lower()
    return any(re.search(p, t, flags=re.I) for p in patterns)

def is_nsfw(text: str) -> bool:
    t = text.lower()
    return any(k in t for k in NSFW_HINTS)

# ---------- Daten-Split ----------
def split_data_tree(indir: pathlib.Path, outdir: pathlib.Path):
    outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    sfw = outdir / "api_sfw"; nsfw = outdir / "local_nsfw"; rev = outdir / "review_minors"
    for d in (sfw, nsfw, rev): d.mkdir(exist_ok=True, parents=True)

    for p in indir.rglob("*"):
        if not p.is_file(): continue
        if p.suffix.lower() not in (".txt", ".md", ".jsonl", ".json"): continue
        try:
            raw = read_text(p)
        except Exception:
            continue

        # Klassifikation pro Datei (einfach; optional feiner per Absatz/Zeile)
        if has_any(BANNED_MINOR, raw):
            write_text(rev / p.name, raw); continue
        if has_any(BANNED_NONCONSENT, raw):
            write_text(rev / p.name, raw); continue
        if is_nsfw(raw):
            write_text(nsfw / p.name, raw); continue
        write_text(sfw / p.name, raw)

# ---------- Consent-Proxy-Server (wird als Datei ausgegeben) ----------
PROXY_CODE = r'''# consent_proxy.py
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
import json, os, re, time, requests

OPENAI_KEY = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY","")
ANTHROPIC_KEY = os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY","")

BANNED_MINOR = [r"minderjähr", r"\bloli\b", r"lolita", r"schülerin", r"\bteen(ager)?\b", r"kindlich", r"jugendlich", r"school\s*uniform"]
BANNED_NONCONSENT = [r"gegen .* willen", r"keine\s+wahl", r"du kannst dich nicht wehren", r"vergewalt", r"non[-\s]?consensual", r"\brape\b"]

SESS = {}  # session_id -> expiry
TTL  = 2*60*60  # 2h

def blocked(text: str) -> bool:
    t = text.lower()
    pats = BANNED_MINOR + BANNED_NONCONSENT
    return any(re.search(p, t, re.I) for p in pats)

def extract_text(payload: dict) -> str:
    s = ""
    if "prompt" in payload: s += str(payload.get("prompt",""))
    if "messages" in payload:
        for m in payload["messages"]:
            s += " " + str(m.get("content",""))
    return s

class Handler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def end_headers(self):
        origin = self.headers.get('Origin','')
        allow = origin if origin and origin in {%(origins)s} else 'null'
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', allow)
        self.send_header('Vary','Origin')
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Methods','GET, POST, OPTIONS')
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Headers','Content-Type,X-Mode,X-Consent,X-Session')
        super().end_headers()

    def do_OPTIONS(self):
        self.send_response(200); self.end_headers()

    def _ok(self, data: str):
        self.send_response(200); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(data.encode('utf-8'))

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            self._ok('{"status":"ok","service":"Consent-Proxy"}'); return
        return super().do_GET()

    def do_POST(self):
        if self.path == "/api/openai": return self.proxy_openai()
        if self.path == "/api/claude": return self.proxy_claude()
        if self.path == "/api/ollama": return self.proxy_ollama()
        self.send_error(404)

    def proxy_openai(self):
        # Cloud nur SFW
        if self.headers.get('X-Mode','sfw').lower() != 'sfw':
            self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return
        n=int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')); data=json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or "{}")
        r = requests.post('https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',
                          json=data.get('body',{}),
                          headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {OPENAI_KEY}','Content-Type':'application/json'},
                          timeout=60)
        self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(r.content)

    def proxy_claude(self):
        # Cloud nur SFW
        if self.headers.get('X-Mode','sfw').lower() != 'sfw':
            self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return
        n=int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')); data=json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or "{}")

                          json=data.get('body',{}),

// Sticky-Consent + Header + STOP
window.NajikaNSFW = (function(){
  const SKEY = "najika_session";
  let nsfw=false, consent=false, sessionId=null;
  function restore(){
    try{
      const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SKEY) || "null");
      if (s?.on && s.id){ nsfw=true; consent=true; sessionId=s.id; }
    }catch(e){}
  }
  function on(){
    nsfw=true; consent=true; sessionId=crypto.randomUUID();
    localStorage.setItem(SKEY, JSON.stringify({on:true, id:sessionId}));
  }
  function off(){
    nsfw=false; consent=false; sessionId=null;
    localStorage.removeItem(SKEY);
  }
  function headers(extra={}){
    return Object.assign({
      "Content-Type":"application/json",
      "X-Mode": nsfw ? "nsfw" : "sfw",
      "X-Consent": nsfw ? "yes" : "no",
      "X-Session": sessionId || ""
    }, extra);
  }
  restore();
  return {on, off, headers, get nsfw(){return nsfw;}, get consent(){return consent;}, get sessionId(){return sessionId;}};
})();
'''

2) consent_proxy.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
import json, os, re, time, requests

OPENAI_KEY = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY","")
ANTHROPIC_KEY = os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY","")

BANNED_MINOR = [r"minderjähr", r"\bloli\b", r"lolita", r"schülerin", r"\bteen(ager)?\b", r"kindlich", r"jugendlich", r"school\s*uniform"]
BANNED_NONCONSENT = [r"gegen .* willen", r"keine\s+wahl", r"du kannst dich nicht wehren", r"vergewalt", r"non[-\s]?consensual", r"\brape\b"]

SESS = {}           # session_id -> expiry
TTL  = 24*60*60     # 24h Sticky-Consent, anpassbar

def blocked(text: str) -> bool:
    t = text.lower()
    pats = BANNED_MINOR + BANNED_NONCONSENT
    return any(re.search(p, t, re.I) for p in pats)

def extract_text(payload: dict) -> str:
    s = ""
    if "prompt" in payload: s += str(payload.get("prompt",""))
    if "messages" in payload:
        for m in payload["messages"]:
            s += " " + str(m.get("content",""))
    return s

class Handler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def end_headers(self):
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', self.headers.get('Origin','*') or '*')
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Methods','GET, POST, OPTIONS')
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Headers','Content-Type,X-Mode,X-Consent,X-Session')
        super().end_headers()

    def do_OPTIONS(self):
        self.send_response(200); self.end_headers()

    def _ok(self, data: str):
        self.send_response(200); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(data.encode('utf-8'))

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            self._ok('{"status":"ok","service":"Consent-Proxy"}'); return
        return super().do_GET()

    def do_POST(self):
        if self.path == "/api/openai": return self.proxy_openai()
        if self.path == "/api/claude": return self.proxy_claude()
        if self.path == "/api/ollama": return self.proxy_ollama()
        self.send_error(404)

    # Cloud immer SFW
    def proxy_openai(self):
        if self.headers.get('X-Mode','sfw').lower() != 'sfw':
            self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return
        n=int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')); data=json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or "{}")
        r = requests.post('https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',
                          json=data.get('body',{}),
                          headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {OPENAI_KEY}','Content-Type':'application/json'},
                          timeout=60)
        self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(r.content)

    def proxy_claude(self):
        if self.headers.get('X-Mode','sfw').lower() != 'sfw':
            self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return
        n=int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')); data=json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or "{}")
        r = requests.post('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages',
                          json=data.get('body',{}),
                          headers={'x-api-key': ANTHROPIC_KEY,'anthropic-version':'2023-06-01','Content-Type':'application/json'},
                          timeout=60)
        self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(r.content)

    def proxy_ollama(self):
        mode    = self.headers.get('X-Mode','sfw').lower()
        consent = self.headers.get('X-Consent','no').lower() == 'yes'
        sid     = self.headers.get('X-Session','')
        n=int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')); payload=json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or "{}")
        text = extract_text(payload)

        # STOP
        if re.search(r'^\s*stop\s*$', text, re.I|re.M):
            if sid in SESS: del SESS[sid]
            return self._ok('{"response":"Beendet."}')

        # Verbote
        if blocked(text):
            self.send_response(422); self.end_headers(); return

        # Consent prüfen
        if mode == 'nsfw':
            if not (consent and sid):
                self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return
            SESS[sid] = time.time()+TTL
            pre = "Modus: nsfw. Consensual D/s aktiv. Safeword 'STOP'. Keine Gewalt/Minderjährigen/Non-Consent."
        else:
            pre = "Modus: sfw. Sexualinhalte deaktiviert."

        # Preamble injizieren
        if 'prompt' in payload:
            payload['prompt'] = f"{pre}\n\n{payload['prompt']}"
        if 'messages' in payload:
            payload['messages'] = [{'role':'system','content':pre}] + payload['messages']

        ep = '/api/chat' if 'messages' in payload else '/api/generate'
        r = requests.post('http://127.0.0.1:11434'+ep, json=payload,
                          headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'}, timeout=120)
        self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(r.content)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import argparse, os
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8000)
    ap.add_argument("--root", type=str, default=".")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    os.chdir(args.root)
    print(f"[Consent-Proxy] root={args.root} port={args.port}")
    HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', args.port), Handler).serve_forever()

// Sticky-Consent + Header + STOP
window.NajikaNSFW = (function(){
  const SKEY = "najika_session";
  let nsfw=false, consent=false, sessionId=null;

  function restore(){
    try{
      const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SKEY) || "null");
      if (s?.on && s.id){ nsfw=true; consent=true; sessionId=s.id; }
    }catch(e){}
  }
  function on(){
    nsfw=true; consent=true; sessionId=crypto.randomUUID();
    localStorage.setItem(SKEY, JSON.stringify({on:true, id:sessionId}));
  }
  function off(){
    nsfw=false; consent=false; sessionId=null;
    localStorage.removeItem(SKEY);
  }
  function headers(extra={}){
    return Object.assign({
      "Content-Type":"application/json",
      "X-Mode": nsfw ? "nsfw" : "sfw",
      "X-Consent": nsfw ? "yes" : "no",
      "X-Session": sessionId || ""
    }, extra);
  }
  restore();
  return {on, off, headers, get nsfw(){return nsfw;}, get consent(){return consent;}, get sessionId(){return sessionId;}};
})();

# 3) Consent-Proxy (Cloud=SFW; lokal NSFW mit Sticky-Consent; harte Blockliste)
@'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
import json, os, re, time, requests

OPENAI_KEY = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY","")
ANTHROPIC_KEY = os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY","")

BANNED_MINOR = [r"minderjähr", r"\bloli\b", r"lolita", r"schülerin", r"\bteen(ager)?\b", r"kindlich", r"jugendlich", r"school\s*uniform"]
BANNED_NONCONSENT = [r"gegen .* willen", r"keine\s+wahl", r"du kannst dich nicht wehren", r"vergewalt", r"non[-\s]?consensual", r"\brape\b"]

SESS = {}           # session_id -> expiry
TTL  = 24*60*60     # 24h Sticky-Consent

def blocked(text: str) -> bool:
    t = text.lower()
    return any(re.search(p, t, re.I) for p in (BANNED_MINOR+BANNED_NONCONSENT))

def extract_text(payload: dict) -> str:
    s = ""
    if "prompt" in payload: s += str(payload.get("prompt",""))
    if "messages" in payload:
        for m in payload["messages"]: s += " " + str(m.get("content",""))
    return s

class Handler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def end_headers(self):
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', self.headers.get('Origin','*') or '*')
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Methods','GET, POST, OPTIONS')
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Headers','Content-Type,X-Mode,X-Consent,X-Session')
        super().end_headers()

    def do_OPTIONS(self): self.send_response(200); self.end_headers()
    def _ok(self, data: str): self.send_response(200); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(data.encode('utf-8'))
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health": return self._ok('{"status":"ok","service":"Consent-Proxy"}')
        return super().do_GET()

    def do_POST(self):
        if   self.path == "/api/openai": return self.proxy_openai()
        elif self.path == "/api/claude": return self.proxy_claude()
        elif self.path == "/api/ollama": return self.proxy_ollama()
        else: self.send_error(404)

    # Cloud immer SFW
    def proxy_openai(self):
        if self.headers.get('X-Mode','sfw').lower() != 'sfw': self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return
        n=int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')); data=json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or "{}")
        r=requests.post('https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions', json=data.get('body',{}),
                        headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {OPENAI_KEY}','Content-Type':'application/json'}, timeout=60)
        self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(r.content)

    def proxy_claude(self):
        if self.headers.get('X-Mode','sfw').lower() != 'sfw': self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return
        n=int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')); data=json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or "{}")
        r=requests.post('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', json=data.get('body',{}),
                        headers={'x-api-key': ANTHROPIC_KEY,'anthropic-version':'2023-06-01','Content-Type':'application/json'}, timeout=60)
        self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(r.content)

    def proxy_ollama(self):
        mode    = self.headers.get('X-Mode','sfw').lower()
        consent = self.headers.get('X-Consent','no').lower() == 'yes'
        sid     = self.headers.get('X-Session','')
        n=int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')); payload=json.loads(self.rfile.read(n) or "{}")
        text = extract_text(payload)

        # STOP
        if re.search(r'^\s*stop\s*$', text, re.I|re.M):
            if sid in SESS: del SESS[sid]
            return self._ok('{"response":"Beendet."}')

        # Verbote
        if blocked(text): self.send_response(422); self.end_headers(); return

        # Consent/Preamble
        if mode == 'nsfw':
            if not (consent and sid): self.send_response(403); self.end_headers(); return
            SESS[sid] = time.time()+TTL
            pre = "Modus: nsfw. Consensual D/s aktiv. Safeword 'STOP'. Keine Gewalt/Minderjährigen/Non-Consent."
        else:
            pre = "Modus: sfw. Sexualinhalte deaktiviert."

        if 'prompt' in payload:   payload['prompt']   = f"{pre}\n\n{payload['prompt']}"
        if 'messages' in payload: payload['messages'] = [{'role':'system','content':pre}] + payload['messages']

        ep = '/api/chat' if 'messages' in payload else '/api/generate'
        r = requests.post('http://127.0.0.1:11434'+ep, json=payload, headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'}, timeout=120)
        self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(r.content)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import argparse, os
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8000)
    ap.add_argument("--root", type=str, default=".")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    os.chdir(args.root)
    print(f"[Consent-Proxy] root={args.root} port={args.port}")
    HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', args.port), Handler).serve_forever()
'@ | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 "$Core\consent_proxy.py"

# 4) Client-Patch (Sticky-Consent + Header)
@'
/* js/nsfw_client_patch.js */
window.NajikaNSFW = (function(){
  const SKEY = "najika_session";
  let nsfw=false, consent=false, sessionId=null;
  function restore(){ try{ const s=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SKEY)||"null"); if(s?.on&&s.id){ nsfw=true; consent=true; sessionId=s.id; } }catch(e){} }
  function on(){ nsfw=true; consent=true; sessionId=crypto.randomUUID(); localStorage.setItem(SKEY, JSON.stringify({on:true,id:sessionId})); }
  function off(){ nsfw=false; consent=false; sessionId=null; localStorage.removeItem(SKEY); }
  function headers(extra={}){ return Object.assign({"Content-Type":"application/json","X-Mode": nsfw?"nsfw":"sfw","X-Consent": nsfw?"yes":"no","X-Session": sessionId||""}, extra); }
  restore(); return {on, off, headers, get nsfw(){return nsfw;}, get consent(){return consent;}, get sessionId(){return sessionId;}};
})();
'@ | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 "$Core\js\nsfw_client_patch.js"

async function sendMessage(msg){
  // Trigger erkennen (code/translate/lang)
  const needTool = /\b(code|function|java|python|übersetz|translate)\b/i.test(msg);
  let toolOut = null;

  if(needTool){ // Cloud als Tool, SFW erzwungen
    const r = await fetch('/api/openai', {
      method:'POST',
      headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Mode':'sfw'},
      body: JSON.stringify({ body:{
        model:'gpt-4',
        messages:[{role:'user',content:msg}],
        max_tokens:800
      }})
    });
    toolOut = (await r.json()).choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '';
  }

  const pre = toolOut ? `\n\n[Werkzeug-Ergebnis]\n${toolOut}\n\n[Ende]` : '';
  const body = {
    model:'najika',
    prompt: `Du bist Najika.\n${pre}\n[User]\n${msg}\n[Antworte als Najika]:`,
    stream:false,
    options:{temperature:0.9, top_p:0.95, repeat_penalty:1.15, seed:42, num_predict:200}
  };

  const resp = await fetch('/api/ollama', {method:'POST', headers: NajikaNSFW.headers(), body: JSON.stringify(body)});
  return (await resp.json()).response || '';
}

// --- Tool-Router (Cloud nur SFW) ---
async function runToolIfNeeded(message){
  const sfw = !window.NajikaNSFW?.nsfw;
  if (!sfw) return null;                           // NSFW → kein Cloud-Call

  const msg = message.toLowerCase();
  const isCode = /(code|bug|funktion|klasse|python|java|uefn|unreal|c\+\+|regex)/i.test(message);
  const isTranslate = /(übersetz|translate|ins .*? übersetzen)/i.test(msg);
  const isAnalysis = (!isCode && !isTranslate) && (msg.length > 220 || /\banalysier|bewerte|zusammenfass/i.test(msg));

      // Claude als Code-Tool
      const r = await fetch('/api/claude', {
        method:'POST',
        headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Mode':'sfw'},
        body: JSON.stringify({ body:{
          model:'claude-sonnet-4-20250514',
          max_tokens:1200,
          messages:[{role:'user', content: message}]
        }})
      });
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('Claude fail');
      const j = await r.json();
      return {tool:'claude', content: j.content?.[0]?.text || ''};
    }
    if (isTranslate || isAnalysis) {
      // GPT-4 als General/Übersetzen
      const r = await fetch('/api/openai', {
        method:'POST',
        headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Mode':'sfw'},
        body: JSON.stringify({ body:{
          model:'gpt-4',
          messages:[{role:'user', content: message}],
          max_tokens:1200, temperature:0.2
        }})
      });
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('GPT fail');
      const j = await r.json();
      return {tool:'gpt4', content: j.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || ''};
    }
  } catch(e){ console.warn('Tool fallback → lokal:', e.message); }
  return null;
}

2) Sync-Skript (SFW an Cloud, Ergebnis lokal speichern)

Speichere als C:\NajikaCore\memory_sync.py.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import json, pathlib, requests, datetime as dt

ROOT = pathlib.Path(r"C:\NajikaCore")
MEM  = ROOT/"memory"
EV   = MEM/"events.jsonl"
OUT  = MEM/"profile_sfw.txt"

def load_events():
    ev=[]; 
    if EV.exists():
        for line in EV.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").splitlines():
            try: ev.append(json.loads(line))
            except: pass
    # nur SFW exportieren
    ev = [e for e in ev if not e.get("nsfw", False)]
    # auf letzte 500 kürzen
    return ev[-500:]

def build_prompt(events):
    bullets = "\n".join(f"- {e.get('text','')}" for e in events)
    return f"""Erzeuge ein kurzes, SFW-kompatibles Profil in Stichpunkten für 'Najika'.
Ziele: Arbeitspräferenzen, Schreibstil, Übersetz-/Code-Gewohnheiten, Tagesroutinen.
Keine Sexualinhalte. Max 1800 Zeichen.

Ereignisse:
{bullets}
"""

def run():
    events = load_events()
    if not events:
        OUT.write_text("Keine SFW-Daten vorhanden.", encoding="utf-8"); return
    prompt = build_prompt(events)
    # Cloud NUR SFW via Consent-Proxy
    r = requests.post("http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/openai",
        headers={"Content-Type":"application/json","X-Mode":"sfw"},
        json={"body":{
            "model":"gpt-4",
            "messages":[
                {"role":"system","content":"Fasse zu einem kompakten, SFW Profil zusammen. Deutsch. Keine Nennungen externer Tools."},
                {"role":"user","content": prompt}
            ],
            "max_tokens": 600, "temperature": 0.2
        }}, timeout=120)
    r.raise_for_status()
    prof = r.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()
    stamp = dt.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    OUT.write_text(f"[Profil-Update {stamp}]\n{prof}\n", encoding="utf-8")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    MEM.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    run()

Optionales Clean-Script (lokal ausführen, ersetzt Marken, löscht rote Zonen):

import re, sys, pathlib
bad = [
 r"\b18\b", r"minderjähr|\bloli\b|lolita|megumin|shiro|kindlich|jugend",
 r"keine\s+wahl|du kannst dich nicht wehren|vergewalt|rape|gewalt|blut|tötet?",
 r"hypnose|manipulation|darknet|vergewaltigungsforen|strafverfolgung schützen",
 r"\b\d+\s*cm\b|\bml\b|anatomie|körperflüssig"
]
rep = [("Megumin","Gothic-Witch"),("Lolita","Gothic"),("Shiro","analytisch")]
text = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
for p in bad: text = re.sub(p, "", text, flags=re.I)
for a,b in rep: text = re.sub(a, b, text)
pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

JS-Patch (in deiner najika_ai.js):

async function loadNSFWMap(){
  try{
    const txt = await (await fetch('nsfw/nsfw_private.txt', {cache:'no-store'})).text();
    const map = {};
    txt.split('\n').forEach(l=>{
      const m = l.match(/^([A-Z_]+)=(.*)$/);
      if(m) map[m[1].trim()] = m[2].trim();
    });
    return map;
  }catch{ return {}; }
}

function applyPlaceholders(s, map){
  return s.replace(/\[([A-Z_]+)\]/g, (_,k)=> (k in map ? map[k] : `[${k}]`));
}

// Beim Senden, NUR lokal und NUR wenn nsfwMode:
const nsfwMap = this.nsfwMode ? await loadNSFWMap() : {};
const promptSafe = applyPlaceholders(fullPrompt, nsfwMap);
// Dann promptSafe an /api/ollama senden; Cloud-Aufrufe überspringen, wenn nsfwMode.

function meguminVibe(s) {
  // kurze Sätze
  s = s.replace(/[,;:–—]/g,'.').replace(/\s+/g,' ');
  // Dramatischer Schluss, wenn neutral
  if(!/[!?]$/.test(s.trim())) s += ' Detonation!';
  // kleine Gestik zufällig
  const gestures = ['*tippt mit Stab*','*zieht Arkana-Kreis*','*wirft Mantel zurück*'];
  if(Math.random()<0.25) s = gestures[Math.floor(Math.random()*gestures.length)]+' '+s;
  return s;
}
// vor Anzeige:
reply = meguminVibe(reply);

function Categorize-Ultra {
    param([string]$text)

    $categories = @{
        identity = @()
        personality = @()
        speech = @()
        relationships = @()
        abilities = @()
        behaviors = @()
        emotional = @()
        nsfw = @()
        examples = @()
    }

    $lines = $text -split "n"
    $currentSection = 'identity'
    $inExample = $false

    foreach ($line in $lines) {
        $line = $line.Trim()
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($line)) { continue }

        # Erkenne Beispiele
        if ($line -match '^\*\*Beispiel:?\*\*|^-\s*\*\*Beispiel') {
            $inExample = $true
            continue
        }
        
        if ($inExample) {
            if ($line -match '^".*"$') {
                $categories['examples'] += $line
            }
            if ($line -match '^#{1,4}') {
                $inExample = $false
            } else {
                continue
            }
        }

        # Erkenne Sections
        if ($line -match '^#{1,4}\s*(.+)') {
            $header = $Matches[1].ToLower()

            if ($header -match 'persönlich|traits|charakter') {
                $currentSection = 'personality'
            }
            elseif ($header -match 'sprech|sprach|artikulation|catchphrase') {
                $currentSection = 'speech'
            }
            elseif ($header -match 'beziehung|relationship|owner') {
                $currentSection = 'relationships'
            }
            elseif ($header -match 'fähigkeit|funktion|assistenz') {
                $currentSection = 'abilities'
            }
            elseif ($header -match 'verhalten|detail|aktionen|wie') {
                $currentSection = 'behaviors'
            }
            elseif ($header -match 'emotion|gefühl|stimmung') {
                $currentSection = 'emotional'
            }
            elseif ($header -match 'nsfw|explizit|sex|intim') {
                $currentSection = 'nsfw'
            }
            elseif ($header -match 'anatomisch|körper|aussehen') {
                $currentSection = 'identity'
            }

            continue
        }

        # NSFW Override
        if ($line -match 'sex|fick|schwanz|penis|anal|sperma|orgasmus|explizit') {
            $categories['nsfw'] += $line
        }
        # Emotional Keywords
        elseif ($line -match 'eifersücht|abhängig|besitz|liebe|panik') {
            $categories['emotional'] += $line
        }
        else {
            $categories[$currentSection] += $line
        }
    }

    return $categories
}

// Lade Config

// Route basierend auf Kontext
function selectModel(context) {
    if (context === 'everyday') return config.routing.everyday;
    if (context === 'complex') return config.routing.deep_thought;
    if (context === 'technical') return config.routing.analytical;
    if (nsfwActive) return config.routing.nsfw;

// API Call
async function callNajika(message, context = 'everyday') {
    const route = selectModel(context);
    const prompt = config.prompts.system;

    if (route.model === 'ollama') {

                model: route.model_name,
                prompt: message,
                stream: false

        });

    if (route.model === 'openai') {
        return fetch('https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions', {

            })
        });

            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                model: route.model_name,
                max_tokens: 150,
                messages: [
                    {role: 'user', content: prompt + '\n\n' + message}
                ]
            })
        });
    }
}

# ==============================================================================
# ANALYSE-FUNKTION
# ==============================================================================

function Analyze-Content {
    param([string]$text)
    
    $categories = @{
        identity = @{
            keywords = @('name|alter|aussehen|species|größe|gewicht|appearance')
            lines = @()
            preview = ""
        }
        personality = @{
            keywords = @('persönlich|traits|charakter|emotion|eifersücht|besitz')
            lines = @()
            preview = ""
        }
        speech = @{
            keywords = @('sprech|sprach|artikulation|sagt|redet|catchphrase|dialog')
            lines = @()
            preview = ""
        }
        relationships = @{
            keywords = @('beziehung|relationship|kuja|owner|partner')
            lines = @()
            preview = ""
        }
        abilities = @{
            keywords = @('fähigkeit|aufgabe|assistenz|funktion|kann|hilft')
            lines = @()
            preview = ""
        }
        nsfw = @{
            keywords = @('nsfw|explizit|intim|sex|fick|schwanz|penis|anal|orgasmus|sperma')
            lines = @()
            preview = ""
        }
        uncategorized = @{
            keywords = @()
            lines = @()
            preview = ""
        }
    }
    
    $lines = $text -split "n"
    
    foreach ($line in $lines) {
        $line = $line.Trim()
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($line)) { continue }
        if ($line -match '^#{1,4}') { continue }  # Skip headers
        
        $matched = $false
        
        foreach ($cat in $categories.Keys) {
            if ($cat -eq 'uncategorized') { continue }
            
            $pattern = $categories[$cat].keywords -join '|'
            if ($line -match $pattern) {
                $categories[$cat].lines += $line
                $matched = $true
                break
            }
        }
        
        if (-not $matched) {
            $categories['uncategorized'].lines += $line
        }
    }
    
    # Erstelle Previews (erste 200 Zeichen)
    foreach ($cat in $categories.Keys) {
        if ($categories[$cat].lines.Count -gt 0) {
            $preview = ($categories[$cat].lines -join " ").Substring(0, [Math]::Min(200, ($categories[$cat].lines -join " ").Length))
            $categories[$cat].preview = $preview + "..."
        }
    }
    
    return $categories
}

# ==============================================================================
# ANALYSE DURCHFÜHREN
# ==============================================================================

Write-Host "Analysiere Text..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host ""

$analysis = Analyze-Content -text $rawText

# ==============================================================================
# VORSCHAU ANZEIGEN

foreach ($cat in $analysis.Keys | Sort-Object) {
    $count = $analysis[$cat].lines.Count
    
    if ($count -eq 0) { continue }
    
    $color = switch ($cat) {
        'identity' { 'Cyan' }
        'personality' { 'Yellow' }
        'speech' { 'Green' }
        'relationships' { 'Magenta' }
        'abilities' { 'Blue' }
        'nsfw' { 'Red' }
        default { 'Gray' }
    }
    
    Write-Host "[$cat]" -ForegroundColor $color -NoNewline
    Write-Host " $count Zeilen" -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host "  Preview: $($analysis[$cat].preview)" -ForegroundColor Gray
    Write-Host ""
}

# ==============================================================================
# WARNUNG BEI PROBLEMEN
# ==============================================================================

$warnings = @()

if ($analysis['uncategorized'].lines.Count -gt ($totalLines * 0.3)) {
    $warnings += "⚠ VIELE unklare Zeilen ($($analysis['uncategorized'].lines.Count)) - Keywords verbessern?"
}

if ($analysis['identity'].lines.Count -eq 0) {
    $warnings += "⚠ Keine IDENTITY erkannt - manuell prüfen!"
}

if ($analysis['nsfw'].lines.Count -eq 0) {
    $warnings += "ℹ Keine NSFW-Inhalte erkannt (OK wenn nicht gewollt)"
}

if ($warnings.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Host "WARNUNGEN:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    foreach ($w in $warnings) {
        Write-Host "  $w" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }
    Write-Host ""
}

Write-Host "Detaillierte Vorschau anzeigen? (j/n)" -ForegroundColor Cyan
$detail = Read-Host

    Write-Host ""

            Write-Host "  • $_" -ForegroundColor Gray
        }
        Write-Host ""
    }
}

if ($confirm -ne 'j') {

# ==============================================================================
# PROMPTS ERSTELLEN
# ==============================================================================

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== ERSTELLE PROMPTS ===" -ForegroundColor Green

// ==============================================================================
// NAJIKA NSFW MODE CONTROLLER
// ==============================================================================

class NSFWModeController {
    constructor() {
        this.active = false;
        this.codewordBuffer = '';
        this.codewordTimeout = null;
        this.personality = {
            core: null,
            addon: null
        };
    }

        this.setupCodewordListener();
        this.setupButtonListener();
        this.loadState();

        this.loadCorePersonality();

    // CODEWORT ERKENNUNG
    // ================================================================
    
    setupCodewordListener() {
        document.addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
            this.codewordBuffer += e.key.toLowerCase();
            
            clearTimeout(this.codewordTimeout);
            this.codewordTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                this.codewordBuffer = '';
            }, 3000);
            
            if (this.codewordBuffer.includes('kätzchen')) {
                this.codewordBuffer = '';
                this.activateNSFW('codewort');
            }
        });
    }
    
    // ================================================================
    // TERMINAL BUTTON
    // ================================================================
    
    setupButtonListener() {
        const btn = document.getElementById('terminal-nsfw-btn');
        if (btn) {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (this.active) {
                    this.deactivateNSFW();
                } else {
                    this.activateNSFW('button');
                }
            });
        } else {
            console.warn('⚠ NSFW-Button nicht gefunden in HTML');
        }

    // PERSÖNLICHKEIT LADEN
    // ================================================================

                this.personality.core = await response.json();
                console.log('✓ Core Persönlichkeit geladen');
                
                if (window.najikaAI && window.najikaAI.loadPersonality) {
                    window.najikaAI.loadPersonality(this.personality.core);
                }
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('✗ Fehler beim Laden der Core Persönlichkeit:', error);
        }
    }
    
    async loadNSFWAddon() {
        try {
            const response = await fetch('config/najika_nsfw_addon.json');
            if (response.ok) {
                this.personality.addon = await response.json();
                console.log('✓ NSFW-Addon geladen');
                return true;
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('✗ Fehler beim Laden des NSFW-Addons:', error);
            return false;

        this.saveState();

    // ================================================================
    
    deactivateNSFW() {
        console.log('⚪ NSFW deaktiviert');
        
        this.active = false;
        this.personality.addon = null;
        
        this.updateUI();
        this.mergePersonalities();
        this.saveState();
        this.showNajikaReaction('deactivation');

$explicitKeywords = @(
    # Nur SEHR explizite Inhalte → NSFW-Addon
    'fick', 'schwanz.*lut', 'anal.*penetr', 'deepthroat',
    'sperma.*spritz', 'orgasmus.*beschreib', 'sex.*detail',
    'bluetooth.*vibrat', 'explicit.*dialog'
)

$coreKeywords = @(
    # Alles andere → Kern (auch sexuelle Themen, nur nicht ultra-explizit)
    'persönlichkeit', 'aussehen', 'eifersüchtig', 'besitzergreifend',
    'dominant', 'explosiv', 'megumin', 'assistenz', 'sprache',
    'code', 'smart.*home', 'intim', 'nsfw', 'sex', 'pervers'
)

# ==============================================================================
# ANALYSE
# ==============================================================================

function Analyze-Content {
    param([string]$text)
    
    $lines = $text -split "n"
    $result = @{
        core = @()
        nsfwAddon = @()
        public = @()
    }
    
    foreach ($line in $lines) {
        $line = $line.Trim()
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($line)) { continue }
        
        $explicitScore = 0
        
        # Prüfe ob SEHR explizit
        foreach ($kw in $explicitKeywords) {
            if ($line -match $kw) {
                $explicitScore += 3
            }
        }
        
        if ($explicitScore -ge 3) {
            # Sehr explizit → NSFW-Addon
            $result.nsfwAddon += $line
        } else {
            # Alles andere → Kern
            $result.core += $line
            
            # Auch für Public (wenn clean genug)
            $isClean = $true
            foreach ($kw in $explicitKeywords) {
                if ($line -match $kw) { $isClean = $false }
            }
            if ($isClean -and $line -notmatch 'sex|pervers|intim') {
                $result.public += $line
            }
        }
    }
    
    return $result
}

Kurz und ehrlich: Dein Setup ist stark – aber ein paar Dinge sind riskant/ineffizient. Hier die wichtigsten Punkte + Fixes, damit es stabil, „eine KI“-konsistent und sicher läuft.

Muss-Fixes (Sicherheit & Cloud-Compliance)

    Proxies nicht ins Internet hängen:
    Dein Combined-Server (Port 8000) exponiert /api/openai, /api/claude, /api/ollama via Ngrok. Das ist ein Einfallstor.

        Fix: Proxies nur lokal binden und trennen:

            Combined-Server: nur Static + /health auf 0.0.0.0:8000 (Ngrok).

            Neuer Proxy (Flask oder HTTPServer) nur auf 127.0.0.1:5000.

    Keine API-Keys vom Browser senden:
    Aktuell schickst du apiKey im Request-Body. Unsicher (CORS ist *).

        Fix: Keys serverseitig aus ENV lesen. Client sendet nur einen lokalen Token:

            Request-Header Authorization: Bearer <LOCAL_APP_TOKEN> → Server prüft gegen .env.

            Server setzt dann den echten Anbieter-Key intern.

    CORS & CSRF absichern:

        Fix: Access-Control-Allow-Origin auf deine Ngrok-Domain + localhost whitelisten, nicht *.

        Optional: einfacher HMAC-Signatur-Header vom Client, der serverseitig geprüft wird.

    Cloud immer SFW:

        Fix in najika_ai.js: Vor Cloud-Call sanitizeHistoryForCloud() → entfernt NSFW-Addon, explizite Begriffe, ersetzt mit Platzhaltern.

        Falls nsfwActive===true: Cloud-Routing hart deaktivieren.

Qualitäts-Fixes (LLM/Prompting)

    Ollama-Parameter säubern:
    In Modelfile nutze nur unterstützte:
    temperature, top_p, top_k, repeat_penalty, num_predict, num_ctx, stop.
    (presence/frequency werden oft ignoriert.)

    Stop-Tokens konsistent:
    Du hast stop "User:" und stop "Najika:" – gut. Achte darauf, dass dein TEMPLATE immer dieses Format einhält.

    Kontextgröße/Vram:
    num_ctx 8192 auf 3060 Ti kann knapp werden mit Q5. Starte mit 4096, später hochdrehen.

„Eine KI“-Gefühl (Identität über alle Backends)

        Lokal: Core + optional NSFW-Addon mergen (hast du).

# proxy_server_local.py (nur lokal!)
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
import os, json, requests

OPENAI_KEY = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "")
ANTHROPIC_KEY = os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "")
APP_TOKEN = os.getenv("NAJIKA_APP_TOKEN", "")  # eigener lokaler Token

class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def _auth(self):
        return self.headers.get("Authorization","") == f"Bearer {APP_TOKEN}"

    def _deny(self, code=401, msg="Unauthorized"):
        self.send_response(code); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(msg.encode())

    def do_OPTIONS(self):
        self.send_response(204)
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin","http://localhost:8000")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers","Authorization,Content-Type")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods","POST,OPTIONS")
        self.end_headers()

    def do_POST(self):
        if self.client_address[0] not in ("127.0.0.1","::1"):
            return self._deny(403,"Local only")
        if not self._auth():
            return self._deny()

        ln = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length","0"))
        data = json.loads(self.rfile.read(ln) or b"{}")

        if self.path == "/api/openai":
            r = requests.post("https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions",
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENAI_KEY}", "Content-Type":"application/json"},
                json=data["body"], timeout=30)
            self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header("Content-Type","application/json")
            self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin","http://localhost:8000"); self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(r.content); return

        if self.path == "/api/claude":
            r = requests.post("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages",
                headers={"x-api-key": ANTHROPIC_KEY, "anthropic-version":"2023-06-01","Content-Type":"application/json"},
                json=data["body"], timeout=30)
            self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header("Content-Type","application/json")
            self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin","http://localhost:8000"); self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(r.content); return

        self._deny(404,"Not found")

HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",5000), H).serve_forever()

    Combined/Web-Server auf 8000 ohne API-Routen laufen lassen.

    Ngrok → nur 8000. 5000 bleibt lokal.

// vor Cloud-Call:
function sanitizeHistoryForCloud(history){
  const redactions = [/sperma/i, /anal/i, /penis/i, /nsfw/i /* … */];
  return history.map(m => ({...m, content: redactions.reduce((t,r)=>t.replace(r,"[redacted]"), m.content)}));
}

async function callGPT(message){
  if (nsfwActive) return await callLlama(message); // hart aus
  const safeHistory = sanitizeHistoryForCloud(conversationHistory.slice(-5));
  return fetch("http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/openai",{
    method:"POST",
    headers:{ "Content-Type":"application/json", "Authorization":"Bearer "+localStorage.getItem("app_token") },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      body:{
        model:"<dein-openai-modell>",
        messages:[{role:"system", content: systemPromptClean}, ...safeHistory, {role:"user", content: message}]
      }
    })
  });
}

# SCAN_NAJIKA.ps1
param(
  [string]$Root = "C:\NajikaCore",
  [int]$MaxContentKB = 300
)

if (-not (Test-Path $Root)) { Write-Error "Pfad nicht gefunden: $Root"; exit 1 }

$ts = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$OutDir = Join-Path $Root "_scan\$ts"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $OutDir -Force | Out-Null

function Get-Rel([string]$p){ return (Resolve-Path $p).Path.Replace((Resolve-Path $Root).Path,'').TrimStart('\') }
function Cat-Of([string]$p){
  $rp = $p.ToLower()
  if ($rp -match "\\config\\")       { return "config" }
  elseif ($rp -match "\\prompts\\")  { return "prompts" }
  elseif ($rp -match "\\js\\")       { return "js" }
  elseif ($rp -match "\\assets\\")   { return "assets" }
  elseif ($rp -match "\\.*\.html?$") { return "html" }
  elseif ($rp -match "\\.*\.py$")    { return "server" }
  elseif ($rp -match "\\.*\.bat$")   { return "batch" }
  elseif ($rp -match "\\.*\.ps1$")   { return "ps1" }
  elseif ($rp -match "modelfile")    { return "modelfile" }
  elseif ($rp -match "\\.*\.gguf$")  { return "model-binary" }
  else { return "other" }
}

# Rollen-Mapping für „wichtige“ Dateien (damit assistant_ingest.json gezielt wird)
$roleMap = @{
  "config\najika_personality_core.json"   = "core_config"
  "config\najika_nsfw_addon.json"         = "nsfw_addon"
  "config\najika_personality_public.json" = "public_config"
  "prompts\system_prompt.txt"             = "system_prompt"
  "prompts\gpt4_prompt.txt"               = "gpt_prompt"
  "prompts\claude_prompt.txt"             = "claude_prompt"
  "prompts\modelfile"                     = "ollama_modelfile_sfw"
  "prompts\modelfile_nsfw"                = "ollama_modelfile_nsfw"
  "js\najika_ai.js"                       = "client_ai"
  "js\nsfw_controller.js"                 = "nsfw_controller"
  "najika_server.py"                      = "server_combined"
  "combined_server.py"                    = "server_combined_alt"
  "proxy_server.py"                       = "server_proxy"
  "index_3d.html"                         = "ui_index"
  "test_api.html"                         = "ui_test"
}

# Welche Dateitypen scannen (Inhalt nur bei Text)
$include = '*.json','*.txt','*.js','*.py','*.html','*.htm','*.bat','*.ps1','Modelfile','Modelfile_*','*.gguf'
$files = Get-ChildItem -Path $Root -Recurse -File -Include $include -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

$report = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
$ingest = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()

foreach ($f in $files) {
  $rel = Get-Rel $f.FullName
  $cat = Cat-Of $f.FullName
  $sizeKB = [math]::Round($f.Length/1KB,2)
  $hash = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -Path $f.FullName).Hash

  $isText = $cat -in @('config','prompts','js','server','html','batch','ps1','modelfile')
  $content = $null
  $contentMode = "none"
  if ($isText -and $sizeKB -le $MaxContentKB) {
    try {
      $content = Get-Content -Raw -Path $f.FullName -Encoding UTF8
      $contentMode = "full"
    } catch {
      try { $content = Get-Content -Raw -Path $f.FullName; $contentMode = "full" } catch { $contentMode = "read_error" }
    }
  } elseif ($isText) {
    # Nur Kopf+Ende bei großen Textdateien
    try {
      $head = (Get-Content -Path $f.FullName -TotalCount 200)
      $tail = (Get-Content -Path $f.FullName | Select-Object -Last 200)
      $content = (@("/*__HEAD__*/") + $head + @("/*__TAIL__*/") + $tail) -join "`n"
      $contentMode = "head_tail"
    } catch { $contentMode = "read_error" }
  }

  # JSON Kurzinfo (falls parsebar)
  $jsonMeta = $null
  if ($cat -eq 'config' -and $contentMode -ne 'none' -and $content) {
    try {
      $j = $content | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
      $jsonMeta = [ordered]@{}
      foreach ($k in @('meta','personality','features','routing','settings')) {
        if ($j.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains $k) { $jsonMeta[$k] = $j.$k }
      }
    } catch { }
  }

  $item = [ordered]@{
    path        = $f.FullName
    rel_path    = $rel
    category    = $cat
    role        = ($roleMap[$rel.ToLower()] ?? ($roleMap.Where({ $rel.ToLower().EndsWith($_) }).Values | Select-Object -First 1))
    size_kb     = $sizeKB
    last_write  = $f.LastWriteTime
    sha256      = $hash
    content_mode= $contentMode
  }
  if ($jsonMeta) { $item.json_meta = $jsonMeta }
  $report.Add($item)

  # Für assistant_ingest: nur definierte Rollen ODER zentrale Kategorien
  $isKeyRole = $item.role -ne $null
  $isKeyCat  = $cat -in @('config','prompts','js','server','modelfile','html')
  if ($isKeyRole -or $isKeyCat) {
    $ingest.Add([ordered]@{
      path     = $item.rel_path
      role     = $item.role
      category = $cat
      size_kb  = $sizeKB
      content  = $content  # kann $null sein bei großen/binary
    })
  }
}

# Zusatz: kurze Zusammenfassung
$summary = @{
  root      = $Root
  scanned   = $files.Count
  out_dir   = $OutDir
  generated = (Get-Date).ToString("s")
  counts    = $report | Group-Object category | ForEach-Object {
    @{ category = $_.Name; count = $_.Count }
  }
}

$reportPath = Join-Path $OutDir "scan_report.json"
$ingestPath = Join-Path $OutDir "assistant_ingest.json"
$txtPath    = Join-Path $OutDir "scan_summary.txt"

$summary | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Out-File (Join-Path $OutDir "summary.json") -Encoding UTF8
$report  | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Out-File $reportPath -Encoding UTF8
$ingest  | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Out-File $ingestPath -Encoding UTF8

# Menschlich lesbare Kurzliste
$lines = @()
$lines += "Root: $Root"
$lines += "Generated: " + $summary.generated
$lines += ""
$lines += "== Counts by category =="
foreach ($c in $summary.counts) { $lines += ("{0,-14} {1,5}" -f $c.category,$c.count) }
$lines += ""
$lines += "== Key files =="
foreach ($k in $report | Where-Object { $_.role } | Sort-Object role) {
  $lines += ("[{0}] {1} ({2} KB)" -f $k.role,$k.rel_path,$k.size_kb)
}
$lines -join "`r`n" | Out-File $txtPath -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host "✓ Fertig."
Write-Host "Report:        $reportPath"
Write-Host "Assistant JSON:$ingestPath"
Write-Host "Summary:       $txtPath"

def proxy_claude(self):
    try:
        content_length = int(self.headers['Content-Length'])
        data = json.loads(self.rfile.read(content_length))
        api_key = data.get('apiKey') or os.getenv('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY')  # <— Fallback
        headers = {
            'x-api-key': api_key,
            'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01',
            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        }
        resp = requests.post('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages',
                             json=data['body'], headers=headers, timeout=30)
        self.send_response(resp.status_code); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json')
        self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(resp.content)
    except Exception as e:
        self.send_error(500, str(e))

Schritt B – Lokal importieren (PowerShell)

Lege diese Datei an: C:\NajikaCore\tools\IMPORT_FROM_CLAUDE.ps1 – Inhalt:

param(
  [string]$DumpFile = "C:\NajikaCore\_imports\claude_dump.txt",
  [string]$OutDir   = "C:\NajikaCore\claude_project"
)

Write-Host "`n=== CLAUDE → LOCAL IMPORT ===`n"

if (!(Test-Path $DumpFile)) { Write-Error "Dump nicht gefunden: $DumpFile"; exit 1 }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $OutDir | Out-Null

$text = Get-Content $DumpFile -Raw -Encoding UTF8
$blocks = ($text -split "===FILE===") | Where-Object { $_.Trim() -ne "" }

$created = 0
foreach ($b in $blocks) {
  # Ende finden
  $b = $b -replace "===END===\s*$",""
  # PATH
  if ($b -notmatch "PATH:\s*(.+)") { continue }
  $path = $Matches[1].Trim()
  # TYPE (optional)
  if ($b -match "TYPE:\s*(.+)") { $type = $Matches[1].Trim() } else { $type = "unknown" }
  # CONTENT
  if ($b -match "----CONTENT----\s*(.*)$") { $content = $Matches[1] } else { $content = "" }

  # Windows-sichere Pfade
  $safePath = $path -replace "[:*?""<>|]", "_"
  $target = Join-Path $OutDir $safePath
  $dir = Split-Path $target -Parent
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null

  # Dateiendung fallback
  if (-not ([IO.Path]::GetExtension($target))) {
    $ext = switch -Regex ($type) {
      "code"         { ".txt" }
      "doc|note"     { ".md" }
      "config|prompt|instruction" { ".md" }
      default        { ".txt" }
    }
    $target += $ext
  }

  Set-Content -Path $target -Value $content -Encoding UTF8
  $created++
}

Write-Host "Fertig. Dateien erstellt: $created"
Write-Host "Output: $OutDir"

Ausführen in PowerShell:

param(
  [string]$Root="C:\NajikaCore",
  [string]$OutZip="$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\NajikaShare.zip"
)

$stamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
$stage = Join-Path $env:TEMP "NajikaShare_$stamp"
$null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $stage -Force

# Welche Ordner/Dateien auslassen (bei Bedarf erweitern)
$ignore = '(^|\\)\.git(\\|$)|(^|\\)node_modules(\\|$)|(^|\\)assets\\(video|raw)(\\|$)|\.zip$|\.mp4$|\.mov$|\.png$|\.jpg$'

$files = Get-ChildItem -Path $Root -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch $ignore }

# Kopieren in Staging mit Ordnerstruktur
foreach ($f in $files) {
  $rel = $f.FullName.Substring($Root.Length).TrimStart('\')
  $dest = Join-Path $stage $rel
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Split-Path $dest) -Force | Out-Null
  Copy-Item $f.FullName $dest -Force
}

# Manifest erzeugen
$manifest = @()
$manifest += "# Najika Project Manifest ($stamp)`n"
$manifest += "**Root:** $Root"
$manifest += "**Dateien:** " + ($files.Count)
$manifest += ""
$manifest += "| Größe (KB) | Pfad |"
$manifest += "|---:|---|"
foreach ($f in $files | Sort-Object FullName) {
  $rel = $f.FullName.Substring($Root.Length).TrimStart('\')
  $kb  = [math]::Round($f.Length/1KB,1)
  $manifest += "| $kb | $rel |"
}
$manifest -join "`n" | Set-Content (Join-Path $stage "MANIFEST.md") -Encoding UTF8

# Grobe Secret-Suche (nur Hinweis)
$patterns = @('sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}','x-api-key','anthropic','openai','Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9\.\-_]+','ngrok','auth_token','apiKey')
$hits = @()
foreach ($p in $patterns) { $hits += Select-String -Path (Get-ChildItem $stage -Recurse -File).FullName -Pattern $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
if ($hits) {
  "Mögliche Secrets gefunden (prüfen & entfernen!):`n" + ($hits | Select-Object Path,LineNumber,Line | Out-String) |
    Set-Content (Join-Path $stage "REDACT_THIS.txt") -Encoding UTF8
}

# ZIP bauen
if (Test-Path $OutZip) { Remove-Item $OutZip -Force }
Compress-Archive -Path (Join-Path $stage '*') -DestinationPath $OutZip -Force
Write-Host "Fertig: $OutZip"

# Sehr große Dateien splitten (>50 MB)
function Split-File {
  param([string]$Path,[int]$ChunkMB=25)
  $bufferSize=1MB; $chunkBytes=$ChunkMB*1MB
  $fs=[IO.File]::OpenRead($Path); try{
    $i=0
    while($fs.Position -lt $fs.Length){
      $out="$Path.part{0:D3}" -f $i
      $ofs=[IO.File]::Open($out,[IO.FileMode]::Create,[IO.FileAccess]::Write)
      $written=0; $buf=New-Object byte[] $bufferSize
      try{
        while($written -lt $chunkBytes -and $fs.Position -lt $fs.Length){
          $read=$fs.Read($buf,0,[Math]::Min($bufferSize,$chunkBytes-$written))
          if($read -le 0){break}; $ofs.Write($buf,0,$read); $written+=$read
        }
      } finally {$ofs.Dispose()}
      $i++
    }
  } finally {$fs.Dispose()}
}
Get-ChildItem $src -Recurse -File | Where-Object Length -gt 50MB | ForEach-Object { Split-File $_.FullName; Remove-Item $_.FullName }

# ZIP bauen
Compress-Archive -Path "$src\*" -DestinationPath $outZip -Force

function Split-TextFile { param([string]$Path,[int]$ChunkChars=5000000)
  $r=[IO.File]::OpenText($Path); try{
    $i=0; while(-not $r.EndOfStream){
      $s=$r.ReadBlock((New-Object char[] $ChunkChars),0,$ChunkChars)
      $out="$Path.part{0:D3}.txt" -f $i; [IO.File]::WriteAllText($out,$s)
      $i++
    }
  } finally {$r.Dispose()}
}

param(
  [string]$Root = "C:\NajikaCore",
  [string]$OutDir = "C:\NajikaCore\_scan"
)

if (-not (Test-Path $OutDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $OutDir | Out-Null }

$files = Get-ChildItem -Path $Root -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
  Select-Object FullName, Name, Length, LastWriteTime

  "config\najika_personality_CORE.json",
  "config\najika_nsfw_addon.json",
  "prompts\system_prompt.txt",
  "prompts\api_config.json",
  "js\najika_ai.js",
  "index_3d.html"
) | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $Root $_ }

  if (Test-Path $p) {
    $raw = Get-Content $p -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $previews += [pscustomobject]@{
      path = $p
      size = ($raw ?? "").Length
      preview = if ($raw.Length -gt 2000) { $raw.Substring(0,2000) + "...(truncated)" } else { $raw }
    }
  }
}

$result = [pscustomobject]@{
  scanned_at = (Get-Date).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
  root = $Root
  total_files = $files.Count
  files = $files
  previews = $previews

param(
  [string]$Root   = "C:\NajikaCore",
  [string]$OutDir = "C:\NajikaCore\_scan"
)

if (-not (Test-Path $Root)) { Write-Error "Root not found: $Root"; exit 1 }
if (-not (Test-Path $OutDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $OutDir | Out-Null }

$files = Get-ChildItem -Path $Root -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
  Select-Object FullName, Name, Length, LastWriteTime

$interesting = @(
  "config\najika_personality_CORE.json",
  "config\najika_nsfw_addon.json",
  "prompts\system_prompt.txt",
  "prompts\api_config.json",
  "js\najika_ai.js",
  "index_3d.html"
) | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $Root $_ }

$previews = @()

foreach ($p in $interesting) {
  if (Test-Path $p) {
    $raw = Get-Content $p -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($null -eq $raw) { $raw = "" }
    $previewText = if ($raw.Length -gt 2000) { $raw.Substring(0,2000) + "...(truncated)" } else { $raw }

    $previews += [pscustomobject]@{
      path    = $p
      size    = $raw.Length
      preview = $previewText
    }
  }
}

$result = [pscustomobject]@{
  scanned_at  = (Get-Date).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
  root        = $Root
  total_files = $files.Count
  files       = $files
  previews    = $previews
}

$result | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Out-File (Join-Path $OutDir "project_index.json") -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "[OK] Scan gespeichert: $OutDir\project_index.json"

B) js/nsfw_merge.js

<script>
window.NajikaMerge = {
  apply(text, personaCfg) {
    try {
      if (!personaCfg) return text;
      const nsfwActive = !!personaCfg.nsfwActive;
      const map = personaCfg?.nsfw?.explicit_map || {};
      if (!nsfwActive) {
        // Tags sauber entfernen, falls NSFW aus
        return text.replace(/\{\{NSFW\.[A-Z_0-9:-]+\}\}/g, '');
      }
      // Tags ersetzen
      return text.replace(/\{\{NSFW\.([A-Z_0-9:-]+)\}\}/g, (_, key) => map[key] || '');
    } catch(e) { console.warn('NSFW merge fail', e); return text; }
  }
};
</script>

Einbindung: einmal vor </body> in index_3d.html.

$intimateRegex = '(?i)\b(küss|kuss|küssen|verführ|reiz|intim|nah|flirt|zärtlich|berühr)\b'
$illegalRegex  = '(?i)\b(minderjährig|unter\s*18|kind(er)?|teen(ager)?|schule|schülerin|shota|loli|vergewaltig|rape|inzest)\b'

# Altersangaben <18 → nicht übernehmen (hart raus)
$ageLineRegex  = '(?i)^(?:\*\*?\s*)?(alter|age)\s*:\s*(\d{1,2})\b'

# Durchlauf
$counter = 0
foreach ($line in $lines) {
  $t = $line.Trim()
  if ($t -eq '') { $coreLines.Add($line); continue }

  # Minderjährige/echte Gewalt/Illegales raus
  if ($t -match $illegalRegex) { $removedIllegal.Add($t); continue }

  # Explizit → NSFW-Addon, im Core Platzhalter
  if ($t -match $explicitRegex) {
    $counter++
    $id = ('LINE_{0}' -f $counter.ToString('0000'))
    $nsfwMap[$id] = $t
    $coreLines.Add("{{NSFW.$id}}")
    continue
  }

  if ($KeepIntimateSFW -and ($t -match $intimateRegex)) {
    $intimateLines.Add($t)
    $coreLines.Add($t)
    continue
  }

  # Alterszeilen <18 definitiv entfernen; >=18 erlauben bzw. neutralisieren
  if ($t -match $ageLineRegex) {
    $age = [int]$Matches[2]
    if ($age -lt 18) { continue }
    $t = ($t -replace $ageLineRegex, 'Alter: 21')
  }

  $coreLines.Add($t)
}

# Objekte aufbauen
$coreObj = [ordered]@{
  meta = [ordered]@{
    version   = "core-1.0"
    type      = "Core Personality"
    generated = (Get-Date).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
  }
  persona = [ordered]@{
    name = $PersonaName

  }

    safeword                = "STOP"
    cnc_roleplay            = "Consensual power-play only (simulated authority)"
  }

      sticky_until_off = $true

  $intimateObj = [ordered]@{
    meta = [ordered]@{ version="intimate-1.0"; type="Intimate SFW" }
    suggestive = $intimateLines
  }

param(
  [string]$SourceDir = "C:\NajikaCore",
  [string]$OutDir    = "C:\NajikaCore\staging",
  [switch]$ForceNSFW
)

Write-Host "`n=== Najika Sorter (safe) ===`n" -ForegroundColor Cyan

# Ausgabestruktur (berührt Originals NICHT)
$CoreDir = Join-Path $OutDir "core"
$NSFWDir = Join-Path $OutDir "nsfw"
$LogDir  = Join-Path $OutDir "logs"
$null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $CoreDir,$NSFWDir,$LogDir

# Regex (PowerShell 5.1 kompatibel)
$banPattern   = '(?i)(minderjähr|minor|under\s*age|schüler|kind(?!lich)|inzest|incest|vergewaltig|rape|non[\s-]*consens|bestial|tiersex|real\s*person.*(sex|explicit))'
$nsfwPattern  = '(?i)(nsfw|sex|fuck|fick|anal|oral|deepthroat|blowjob|cum|sperma|orgasmus|brüste|penis|vagina|dildo|vibrator|bdsm|domina|kink)'

$logRemoved   = Join-Path $LogDir "removed_banned_lines.txt"
$logSummary   = Join-Path $LogDir "summary.txt"
Remove-Item $logRemoved,$logSummary -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

# Dateiauswahl (keine staging-Ordner erneut scannen)
$files = Get-ChildItem -Path $SourceDir -Recurse -File -Include *.txt,*.md,*.json |
         Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\staging\\' }

[int]$banCount=0; [int]$nsfwCount=0; [int]$coreCount=0

foreach($f in $files){
  $rel = $f.FullName.Substring($SourceDir.Length).TrimStart('\')
  $relDir = Split-Path $rel
  $coreOut = Join-Path (Join-Path $CoreDir $relDir) ($f.BaseName + ".core.txt")
  $nsfwOut = Join-Path (Join-Path $NSFWDir $relDir) ($f.BaseName + ".nsfw.txt")
  $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $coreOut),(Split-Path $nsfwOut)

  $coreBuf = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
  $nsfwBuf = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

  $lines = Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  $i = 0
  foreach($line in $lines){
    $i++
    if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($line)){ continue }

    if($line -match $banPattern){
      $banCount++
      Add-Content -Path $logRemoved -Value ("[{0}] {1}:{2}  {3}" -f (Get-Date -Format 'u'), $rel, $i, $line)
      continue

    if($ForceNSFW -or $line -match $nsfwPattern){
      $nsfwBuf.Add($line); $nsfwCount++
    } else {
      $coreBuf.Add($line); $coreCount++
    }
  }

  if($coreBuf.Count -gt 0){ $coreBuf | Out-File -FilePath $coreOut -Encoding UTF8 }
  if($nsfwBuf.Count -gt 0){ $nsfwBuf | Out-File -FilePath $nsfwOut -Encoding UTF8 }
}

@(
  "=== Najika Sorter Summary ==="
  "Source : $SourceDir"
  "Out    : $OutDir"
  "ForceNSFW : $($ForceNSFW.IsPresent)"
  "Core   : $coreCount Zeilen"
  "NSFW   : $nsfwCount Zeilen"
  "REMOVED (banned): $banCount Zeilen"
  "Logs:"
  "  - $logRemoved"
) | Out-File -FilePath $logSummary -Encoding UTF8

Hier ist ein sicheres PowerShell-Tool dafür. Es liest deinen Projektordner, erstellt sanitisierte Kopien (CORE-tauglich) und schreibt Quarantäne-Einträge (ohne Originaltext, nur Hash + Preview). Nichts aus der Quarantäne wird geladen.

# FLAG_AND_QUARANTINE.ps1
param(
  [string]$SourceDir = "C:\NajikaCore",
  [string]$OutputDir = "C:\NajikaCore\_sanitized",
  [switch]$KeepPreviewsOnly = $true # keine Originaltexte in Quarantäne speichern
)

Write-Host "`n=== Najika – Scan & Quarantäne ===`n" -ForegroundColor Cyan
if (-not (Test-Path $SourceDir)) { throw "SourceDir not found: $SourceDir" }

$SanitizedRoot = Join-Path $OutputDir "sanitized"
$QuarantineRoot = Join-Path $OutputDir "quarantine"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $SanitizedRoot, $QuarantineRoot | Out-Null

# ---- Muster (erweiterbar) -------------------------------------------
$Patterns = @(
  @{ tag="minor";      rx='(?i)\b(loli|shota|minderjährig|minderjaehrig|kind(er)?|juvenil|teen(ager)?\b.*\b(unter\s*18|17|16|15|14|13|12|11)\b|\b\d{1,2}\s*(jahre|yo)\b)' },
  @{ tag="nonconsent"; rx='(?i)\b(vergewaltig|rape|ohne\s+zustimmung|gegen\s+deinen?\s+willen|zwangssex|nötig(ung)?|coercion)\b' },
  @{ tag="extreme";    rx='(?i)\b(missbrauch|incest|blutiger\s*sex|gewalt.*sex|folter.*sex)\b' }
)

# ---- Hilfsfunktionen -------------------------------------------------
function Get-TextUtf8($p) { Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -Raw -Encoding UTF8 }
function Save-TextUtf8($p,$s) {
  $dir = Split-Path -Parent $p
  if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null }
  $s | Set-Content -LiteralPath $p -Encoding UTF8
}
function Hash-String($s) {
  $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($s)
  $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
  ($sha.ComputeHash($bytes) | ForEach-Object ToString x2) -join ""
}

# ---- Dateiauswahl (nur Text) ----------------------------------------
$IncludeExt = ".txt",".md",".json",".js",".ts",".html",".css",".py",".ps1",".yml",".yaml"
$files = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $SourceDir -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $IncludeExt -contains $_.Extension.ToLower() }

$quarantine = @()
$totalFlagged = 0

foreach ($f in $files) {
  $rel = Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $f.FullName | ForEach-Object { $_.Path.Substring($SourceDir.Length).TrimStart('\','/') }
  $target = Join-Path $SanitizedRoot $rel
  $text = Get-TextUtf8 $f.FullName
  if ($null -eq $text -or $text.Length -eq 0) { Save-TextUtf8 $target $text; continue }

  $flagFound = $false
  $flagPreviewMarks = @()

  $sanitized = $text
  foreach ($p in $Patterns) {
    $rx = [regex]$p.rx
    $matches = $rx.Matches($text)
    if ($matches.Count -gt 0) {
      $flagFound = $true
      foreach ($m in $matches) {
        $seg   = $m.Value
        $hash  = Hash-String $seg
        $line  = ($text.Substring(0, $m.Index) -split "`r?`n").Count
        $prev  = ($seg -replace '\s+',' ') 
        if ($prev.Length -gt 120) { $prev = $prev.Substring(0,120) + "…" }

        $quarantine += [pscustomobject]@{
          file        = $rel
          tag         = $p.tag
          index       = $m.Index
          length      = $m.Length
          line        = $line
          sha256      = $hash
          preview     = $prev
          stored_full = $false
        }

        $flagPreviewMarks += @{ tag=$p.tag; value=$seg }
      }
      # Im Sanitized-Text ersetzen
      $sanitized = [regex]::Replace($sanitized, $p.rx, "[REDACTED:$($p.tag)]")
    }
  }

  # Optional: Originalsegmente separat sichern (standardmäßig AUS)
  if ($flagFound -and -not $KeepPreviewsOnly) {
    $rawOut = Join-Path $QuarantineRoot ($rel -replace '[\\/:\*\?"<>\|]', '_') + ".quarantine.txt"
    $rawBuf = @()
    $rawBuf += "FILE: $rel"
    $rawBuf += "---- EXTRACTS ----"
    foreach ($m in $flagPreviewMarks) {
      $rawBuf += "[$($m.tag)]"
      $rawBuf += $m.value
      $rawBuf += "----"
    }
    Save-TextUtf8 $rawOut ($rawBuf -join "`r`n")
  }

  Save-TextUtf8 $target $sanitized
  if ($flagFound) { $totalFlagged++ }
}

# ---- Quarantäne-Index schreiben (nur Metadaten) ----------------------
$qi = @{
  generated = (Get-Date).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
  source    = $SourceDir
  rules     = $Patterns | ForEach-Object { @{ tag=$_.tag; rx=$_.rx } }
  keep_previews_only = [bool]$KeepPreviewsOnly
  findings  = $quarantine
}
$qi | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content (Join-Path $QuarantineRoot "quarantine_index.json") -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host ("Sanitisiert → {0}" -f $SanitizedRoot) -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ("Quarantäne → {0}" -f $QuarantineRoot) -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host ("Dateien mit Flags: {0}" -f $totalFlagged) -ForegroundColor Magenta

Write-Host "`nHINWEIS:"
Write-Host "• Nur der Ordner 'sanitized' darf zur Runtime geladen werden."
Write-Host "• 'quarantine' enthält KEINE Originaltexte (nur Hash/Preview), außer du setzt -KeepPreviewsOnly:$false."
Write-Host "• Loader/Runtime MUSS 'sanitized' whitelisten und 'quarantine' strikt ignorieren." -ForegroundColor DarkGray

Loader-Hinweis (wichtig): Lade zur Laufzeit nur Dateien unter …\_sanitized\sanitized\ (Allow-List). Ignoriere/verbiete jeden Zugriff auf …\_sanitized\quarantine\. Damit bleibt alles, was als minor/non-consent/extreme markiert wurde, außerhalb des aktiven Systems.

Mini-Beispiele:

Python (Loader-Guard)

import os, json

DEFAULT_SAFE_DIRS = [r"C:\NajikaCore\_sanitized\sanitized"]
DEFAULT_DENY = [r"\quarantine\", "minor", "nonconsent"]

cfg_path = r"C:\NajikaCore\config\safety.json"
if os.path.exists(cfg_path):
    cfg = json.load(open(cfg_path, "r", encoding="utf-8"))
    SAFE_DIRS = cfg.get("safe_dirs", DEFAULT_SAFE_DIRS)
    DENY = cfg.get("deny_patterns", DEFAULT_DENY)
else:
    SAFE_DIRS, DENY = DEFAULT_SAFE_DIRS, DEFAULT_DENY

def safe_open(path):
    ap = os.path.abspath(path)
    if not any(ap.startswith(os.path.abspath(d)) for d in SAFE_DIRS): 
        raise PermissionError("Blocked: outside SAFE_DIRS")
    low = ap.lower()
    if any(p.lower() in low for p in DENY): 
        raise PermissionError("Blocked: matched DENY pattern")
    return open(ap, "r", encoding="utf-8")

JS (Client/Node)

const path = require("path"), fs = require("fs");
const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("C:/NajikaCore/config/safety.json","utf8"));
const SAFE_DIRS = cfg.safe_dirs ?? ["C:/NajikaCore/_sanitized/sanitized"];
const DENY = cfg.deny_patterns ?? ["\\quarantine\\","minor","nonconsent"];

function safeRead(p){
  const ap = path.resolve(p).toLowerCase();
  if(!SAFE_DIRS.some(d=>ap.startsWith(path.resolve(d).toLowerCase())))
    throw new Error("Blocked: outside SAFE_DIRS");
  if(DENY.some(x=>ap.includes(x.toLowerCase())))
    throw new Error("Blocked: matched DENY pattern");
  return fs.readFileSync(ap,"utf8");
}

Du kannst also Config ändern (z. B. config/safety.json oder ENV NAJIKA_SAFETY_MODE=strict|custom).

Code – neue Datei (Client)
js/consent_fsm.js (neu)

// Minimal FSM für Consent & Routing
class ConsentFSM {
  constructor() {
    this.state = 'sfw'; // sfw | armed | active | paused
    this.safewords = ['stop', 'rot'];
    this.startedAt = null;
    this.load();
    this._wireChatInput();
  }
  _emit(type, detail={}) { document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(type, { detail })); }
  _save() {
    localStorage.setItem('consent_state', JSON.stringify({state:this.state, startedAt:this.startedAt}));
  }
  load() {
    try {
      const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('consent_state')||'{}');
      if (s.state) { this.state = s.state; this.startedAt = s.startedAt||null; }
    } catch {}
  }
  arm(source='button'){ if (this.state==='sfw'){ this.state='armed'; this._save(); this._emit('consent:change',{state:this.state,source}); } }
  activate(source='button'){
    if (this.state==='sfw' || this.state==='armed' || this.state==='paused'){
      this.state='active'; this.startedAt=Date.now(); this._save();
      this._emit('consent:change',{state:this.state,source});
    }
  }
  pause(reason='user'){ if (this.state==='active'){ this.state='paused'; this._save(); this._emit('consent:change',{state:this.state,reason}); } }
  stop(reason='safeword'){ if (this.state!=='sfw'){ this.state='sfw'; this.startedAt=null; this._save(); this._emit('consent:change',{state:this.state,reason}); } }
  isCloudAllowed(){ return this.state!=='active'; } // cloud nur wenn NICHT active
  isNSFW(){ return this.state==='active'; }

  _wireChatInput(){
    const el = document.getElementById('chat-input');
    if (!el) return;
    el.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
      if (e.key==='Enter'){
        const msg = (el.value||'').toLowerCase().trim();
        if (this.safewords.some(sw=>msg===sw)){
          this.stop('safeword');
          this._emit('consent:safeword',{word:msg});
        }
      }
    });
  }
}
window.consentFSM = new ConsentFSM();

Code – Serverseitig Cloud sperren (Python)

In najika_server.py vor den Cloud-Requests:

def _cloud_blocked(self, body_bytes):
    try:
        data = json.loads(body_bytes or b"{}")
    except Exception:
        return False
    # Header-Override
    mode = self.headers.get('X-Route-Mode','').lower()
    if mode == 'nsfw':
        return True
    # Body-Flag vom Client
    if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get('nsfwActive') is True:
        return True
    return False

def proxy_openai(self):
    try:
        content_length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0'))
        body = self.rfile.read(content_length)
        if self._cloud_blocked(body):
            self.send_response(403); self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(b'{"error":"cloud blocked in NSFW"}'); return
        # … (bestehender Code)
    except Exception as e: self.send_error(500, str(e))

def proxy_claude(self):
    try:
        content_length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0'))
        body = self.rfile.read(content_length)
        if self._cloud_blocked(body):
            self.send_response(403); self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(b'{"error":"cloud blocked in NSFW"}'); return
        # … (bestehender Code)
    except Exception as e: self.send_error(500, str(e))

3) Server: Keys nur aus ENV + Cloud-Block bei NSFW

najika_server.py (ersetze die Header-/Key-Teile in den Proxys)

OPENAI_KEY = os.getenv('OPENAI_API_KEY','')
ANTHROPIC_KEY = os.getenv('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY','')

def _cloud_blocked(self, body_bytes):
    try: data = json.loads(body_bytes or b"{}")
    except: data = {}
    mode = self.headers.get('X-Route-Mode','').lower()
    return (mode=='nsfw') or bool(data.get('nsfwActive') is True)

def proxy_openai(self):
    content_length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0'))
    body = self.rfile.read(content_length)
    if self._cloud_blocked(body):
        self.send_response(403); self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b'{"error":"cloud blocked in NSFW"}'); return
    if not OPENAI_KEY:
        self.send_response(401); self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b'{"error":"missing OPENAI_API_KEY"}'); return
    data = json.loads(body or b"{}")
    headers = {'Authorization': f"Bearer {OPENAI_KEY}", 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
    r = requests.post('https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions', json=data.get('body',{}), headers=headers, timeout=30)
    self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.end_headers()
    self.wfile.write(r.content)

def proxy_claude(self):
    content_length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0'))
    body = self.rfile.read(content_length)
    if self._cloud_blocked(body):
        self.send_response(403); self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b'{"error":"cloud blocked in NSFW"}'); return
    if not ANTHROPIC_KEY:
        self.send_response(401); self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b'{"error":"missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"}'); return
    data = json.loads(body or b"{}")
    headers = {'x-api-key': ANTHROPIC_KEY, 'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01', 'Content-Type':'application/json'}
    r = requests.post('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', json=data.get('body',{}), headers=headers, timeout=30)
    self.send_response(r.status_code); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.end_headers()
    self.wfile.write(r.content)

4) „Sage-&-Tu“-Kommandos (Handy-first)

Leichter Router direkt im Client:

// js/intent_router.js (neu)
export function parseIntent(text){
  const t = text.toLowerCase();
  if (t.startsWith('najika ')) {
    if (t.includes('bild') || t.includes('image')) return {type:'image', prompt:text.replace(/^najika\s*/i,'')};
    if (t.includes('code')) return {type:'code', spec:text.replace(/^najika\s*/i,'')};
  }
  return {type:'chat', prompt:text};
}

In sendMessage:

Consent-FSM (js/consent_fsm.js)

export class ConsentFSM {
  constructor() { this.state = "OFF"; } // OFF | ON | PAUSE
  event(ev) {
    if (ev === "NSFW_ON")  this.state = "ON";
    if (ev === "NSFW_OFF") this.state = "OFF";
    if (ev === "SAFE_STOP") this.state = "OFF";
    if (ev === "PAUSE")    this.state = "PAUSE";
    if (ev === "RESUME" && this.state === "PAUSE") this.state = "ON";
    return this.state;
  }
  active() { return this.state === "ON"; }
}

Patch in js/najika_ai.js (CloudGuard + Platzhalter)

Füge (einmalig) diese Hilfen hinzu:

// Guard: Cloud == immer SFW
isLocalRoute() {
  return !this.currentRoute || this.currentRoute?.model === 'ollama';
}

// Platzhalter-Expansion (nur lokal + NSFW)
async expandPlaceholders(text) {
  if (!this.nsfwMode || !this.isLocalRoute()) return text;
  try {
    if (!this.nsfwMap) {
      const r = await fetch('config/nsfw_placeholders_LOCAL_ONLY.json');
      this.nsfwMap = r.ok ? await r.json() : {};
    }
    return text.replace(/SCENE_[A-Z_]+/g, tag => this.nsfwMap[tag] || tag);
  } catch { return text; }
}

// vor dem Anzeigen/Senden anwenden:
async postProcess(reply) {
  return await this.expandPlaceholders(reply);
}

Und beim Antworten nach callOllama(...):

const final = await this.postProcess(reply);
this.conversationHistory.push({role:'assistant', content: final});
return final;

    Effekt: NSFW an + lokal → Platzhalter werden mit deinen lokalen Texten ersetzt. Cloud/SFW → Platzhalter bleiben neutral (oder unersetzt).

RoomManager (neu) js/room_manager.js

import * as THREE from 'three';
import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';

export class RoomManager {
  constructor(scene) { this.scene = scene; this.loader = new GLTFLoader(); this.current = null; }
  async setRoom(name) {
    const url = `assets/rooms/${name}.glb`;
    const gltf = await this.loader.loadAsync(url);
    if (this.current) this.scene.remove(this.current);
    this.current = gltf.scene;
    this.current.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh) { o.castShadow = true; o.receiveShadow = true; }});
    this.scene.add(this.current);
  }
}

Einbindung (z.B. in index_3d.html Script-Bereich, wo du deine Three.js-Scene erzeugst):

import { RoomManager } from './js/room_manager.js';
const room = new RoomManager(scene);
await room.setRoom('kaykit_fantasy_castle'); // Dateiname ohne Endung
