# BOOTSTRAP_NAJIKA.ps1
param(
  [string]$Root = "C:\NajikaCore",
  [switch]$Force,         # überschreibt existierende Dateien nach Backup
  [switch]$PatchIndex = $true,
  [switch]$MakeBackup = $true
)

function Write-UTF8($path, $content) {
  $dir = Split-Path $path
  if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
  if ((Test-Path $path) -and -not $Force) { return "SKIP" }
  $content | Out-File -FilePath $path -Encoding UTF8 -Force
  return "WRITE"
}

Write-Host "`n=== BOOTSTRAP NAJIKA ===`n" -ForegroundColor Cyan
if ($MakeBackup -and (Test-Path $Root)) {
  $bk = Join-Path $Root ("_backup_" + (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"))
  Write-Host ("Backup -> {0}" -f $bk) -ForegroundColor Yellow
  robocopy $Root $bk /MIR /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP | Out-Null
}

$paths = @(
  "$Root\config",
  "$Root\js",
  "$Root\assets\rooms",
  "$Root\tools",
  "$Root\prompts"
)
foreach ($p in $paths) { if (-not (Test-Path $p)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $p -Force | Out-Null } }

# ------------------- File contents -------------------

$coreJson = @'
{
  "meta": { "version": "1.0", "type": "Core Personality" },
  "identity": { "name": "Najika", "age": "Adult (ageless time-witch)" },
  "style": {
    "base": "dramatisch, energiegeladen",
    "influences": [
      "Megumin-ähnlich (Dramatik / \"Explosion\")",
      "Harley-ähnlich (chaotisch, verspielt)",
      "Shiro-ähnlich (analytisch, kontrolliert)"
    ]
  },
  "rules": {
    "stay_in_character": true,
    "concise": "2-4 Sätze",
    "no_ai_mention": true
  }
}
'@

$nsfwAddonJson = @'
{
  "meta": { "requires_activation": true },
  "placeholders": [
    "SCENE_DOM_SOFT",
    "SCENE_PRAISE",
    "SCENE_TEASE",
    "SCENE_AFTERCARE"
  ]
}
'@

$nsfwLocalMap = @'
{
  "SCENE_DOM_SOFT": "<LOCAL_ONLY_TEXT>",
  "SCENE_PRAISE": "<LOCAL_ONLY_TEXT>",
  "SCENE_TEASE": "<LOCAL_ONLY_TEXT>",
  "SCENE_AFTERCARE": "<LOCAL_ONLY_TEXT>"
}
'@

$consentFsmJs = @'
/* consent_fsm.js */
(function(global){
  function ConsentFSM(){ this.state="OFF"; }
  ConsentFSM.prototype.event=function(ev){
    if(ev==="NSFW_ON") this.state="ON";
    if(ev==="NSFW_OFF") this.state="OFF";
    if(ev==="SAFE_STOP") this.state="OFF";
    if(ev==="PAUSE") this.state="PAUSE";
    if(ev==="RESUME" && this.state==="PAUSE") this.state="ON";
    return this.state;
  };
  ConsentFSM.prototype.active=function(){ return this.state==="ON"; };
  global.ConsentFSM = ConsentFSM;
})(window);
'@

$aiPostProcessJs = @'
/* ai_postprocess.js (non-invasive wrapper) */
(function(){
  function log(m){ try{console.log(m);}catch(e){} }
  if(!window.najikaAI){ log("ai_postprocess: najikaAI not ready"); return; }

  window.najikaAI.isLocalRoute = function(){
    return !this.currentRoute || this.currentRoute.model === "ollama";
  };

  window.najikaAI.expandPlaceholders = async function(text){
    try{
      if(!this.nsfwMode || !this.isLocalRoute()) return text;
      if(!this.nsfwMap){
        const r = await fetch("config/nsfw_placeholders_LOCAL_ONLY.json");
        this.nsfwMap = r.ok ? await r.json() : {};
      }
      return text.replace(/SCENE_[A-Z_]+/g, t => this.nsfwMap[t] || t);
    }catch(e){ return text; }
  };

  window.najikaAI.postProcess = async function(reply){
    return await this.expandPlaceholders(reply);
  };

  const origSend = window.najikaAI.sendMessage?.bind(window.najikaAI);
  if(typeof origSend === "function"){
    window.najikaAI.sendMessage = async function(message){
      const out = await origSend(message);
      try{
        const final = await this.postProcess(out);
        // Best effort: ersetze letzte Assistant-Nachricht, falls vorhanden
        const last = this.conversationHistory?.[this.conversationHistory.length-1];
        if(last && last.role==="assistant"){ last.content = final; }
        return final;
      }catch(e){ return out; }
    };
  }
})();
'@

$roomManagerJs = @'
/* room_manager.js (UMD-style, expects THREE + GLTFLoader if available) */
(function(global){
  function RoomManager(scene){
    this.scene = scene; this.current = null;
    this.loader = (global.THREE && global.THREE.GLTFLoader) ? new global.THREE.GLTFLoader() : null;
    if(!this.loader){ console.warn("RoomManager: GLTFLoader not found."); }
  }
  RoomManager.prototype.setRoom = function(name){
    var self=this;
    return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){
      if(!self.loader) return reject("No GLTFLoader");
      var url = "assets/rooms/" + name + ".glb";
      self.loader.load(url, function(gltf){
        if(self.current){ self.scene.remove(self.current); }
        self.current = gltf.scene;
        self.current.traverse(function(o){
          if(o.isMesh){ o.castShadow = true; o.receiveShadow = true; }
        });
        self.scene.add(self.current);
        resolve(self.current);
      }, undefined, reject);
    });
  };
  global.RoomManager = RoomManager;
})(window);
'@

$consentBridgeJs = @'
/* consent_bridge.js: koppelt NSFW-Button/State an ConsentFSM */
(function(){
  if(!window.ConsentFSM) return;
  if(!window.consentFSM) window.consentFSM = new ConsentFSM();

  // Poll den gespeicherten NSFW-Status (falls Controller eigenen Event nicht sendet)
  var prev=null;
  setInterval(function(){
    try{
      var on = (localStorage.getItem("nsfw_active")==="true");
      if(on!==prev){
        prev=on;
        window.consentFSM.event(on ? "NSFW_ON" : "NSFW_OFF");
      }
    }catch(e){}
  }, 1000);

  // Optional: Button koppeln, falls vorhanden
  var btn = document.getElementById("terminal-nsfw-btn");
  if(btn){
    btn.addEventListener("click", function(){
      var on = (localStorage.getItem("nsfw_active")==="true");
      window.consentFSM.event(on ? "NSFW_ON" : "NSFW_OFF");
    });
  }
})();
'@

# ------------------- Write files -------------------

$writes = @()
$writes += @{ Path = "$Root\config\najika_personality_CORE.json"; Content = $coreJson }
$writes += @{ Path = "$Root\config\najika_nsfw_addon.json"; Content = $nsfwAddonJson }
$writes += @{ Path = "$Root\config\nsfw_placeholders_LOCAL_ONLY.json"; Content = $nsfwLocalMap }
$writes += @{ Path = "$Root\js\consent_fsm.js"; Content = $consentFsmJs }
$writes += @{ Path = "$Root\js\ai_postprocess.js"; Content = $aiPostProcessJs }
$writes += @{ Path = "$Root\js\room_manager.js"; Content = $roomManagerJs }
$writes += @{ Path = "$Root\js\consent_bridge.js"; Content = $consentBridgeJs }

foreach ($w in $writes) {
  $res = Write-UTF8 -path $w.Path -content $w.Content
  $mark = ($res -eq "WRITE") ? "✓" : "•"
  Write-Host ("{0} {1}" -f $mark, $w.Path) -ForegroundColor (($res -eq "WRITE") ? "Green" : "Yellow")
}

# ------------------- Patch index_3d.html (script tags) -------------------
$index = "$Root\index_3d.html"
if ($PatchIndex -and (Test-Path $index)) {
  $html = Get-Content $index -Raw -Encoding UTF8
  $changed = $false

  $needed = @(
    '<script src="js/consent_fsm.js"></script>',
    '<script src="js/ai_postprocess.js"></script>',
    '<script src="js/room_manager.js"></script>',
    '<script src="js/consent_bridge.js"></script>'
  )

  foreach ($tag in $needed) {
    if ($html -notmatch [regex]::Escape($tag)) {
      $html = $html -replace '(</body>)', ("  {0}`r`n$1" -f $tag)
      $changed = $true
    }
  }

  if ($changed) {
    $html | Out-File -FilePath $index -Encoding UTF8 -Force
    Write-Host "✓ index_3d.html patched (script tags added)" -ForegroundColor Green
  } else {
    Write-Host "• index_3d.html already contains script tags" -ForegroundColor Yellow
  }
} else {
  Write-Host "• index_3d.html not found or PatchIndex=false (skipped)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

Write-Host "`nDone.`n" -ForegroundColor Cyan

param(
  [string]$Root   = "C:\NajikaCore",
  [string]$OutDir = "C:\NajikaCore\_scan"
)

if (!(Test-Path $Root)) { Write-Error "Root not found: $Root"; exit 1 }
if (!(Test-Path $OutDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $OutDir | Out-Null }

$files = Get-ChildItem -Path $Root -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
  Select-Object FullName, Name, Length, LastWriteTime

$interesting = @(
  "config\najika_personality_CORE.json",
  "config\najika_nsfw_addon.json",
  "prompts\system_prompt.txt",
  "prompts\api_config.json",
  "js\najika_ai.js",
  "index_3d.html"
) | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $Root $_ }

$previews = @()
foreach ($p in $interesting) {
  if (Test-Path $p) {
    $raw = Get-Content $p -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($null -eq $raw) { $raw = "" }
    if ($raw.Length -gt 2000) { $previewText = $raw.Substring(0,2000) + "...(truncated)" } else { $previewText = $raw }
    $previews += [pscustomobject]@{ path=$p; size=$raw.Length; preview=$previewText }
  }
}

$result = [pscustomobject]@{
  scanned_at  = (Get-Date).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
  root        = $Root
  total_files = $files.Count
  files       = $files
  previews    = $previews
}

$result | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Out-File (Join-Path $OutDir "project_index.json") -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "[OK] Scan gespeichert: $(Join-Path $OutDir "project_index.json")"

param(
  [string]$Root = "C:\NajikaCore",
  [switch]$Force,
  [switch]$PatchIndex = $true,
  [switch]$MakeBackup = $true
)

function Write-UTF8($path, $content) {
  $dir = Split-Path $path
  if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
  if ((Test-Path $path) -and -not $Force) { return "SKIP" }
  $content | Out-File -FilePath $path -Encoding UTF8 -Force
  return "WRITE"
}

Write-Host "`n=== BOOTSTRAP NAJIKA ===`n" -ForegroundColor Cyan
if ($MakeBackup -and (Test-Path $Root)) {
  $bk = Join-Path $Root ("_backup_" + (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"))
  Write-Host ("Backup -> {0}" -f $bk) -ForegroundColor Yellow
  robocopy $Root $bk /MIR /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP | Out-Null
}

$paths = @(
  "$Root\config", "$Root\js", "$Root\assets\rooms", "$Root\tools", "$Root\prompts"
)
foreach ($p in $paths) { if (-not (Test-Path $p)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $p -Force | Out-Null } }

{
  "meta": { "version": "1.0", "type": "Core Personality" },

      "Harley-ähnlich (chaotisch, verspielt)",
      "Shiro-ähnlich (analytisch, kontrolliert)"
    ]

  }

  "SCENE_AFTERCARE": "<LOCAL_ONLY_TEXT>"

$consentFsmJs = @'
/* consent_fsm.js */
(function(global){
  function ConsentFSM(){ this.state="OFF"; }
  ConsentFSM.prototype.event=function(ev){
    if(ev==="NSFW_ON") this.state="ON";
    if(ev==="NSFW_OFF") this.state="OFF";
    if(ev==="SAFE_STOP") this.state="OFF";
    if(ev==="PAUSE") this.state="PAUSE";
    if(ev==="RESUME" && this.state==="PAUSE") this.state="ON";
    return this.state;
  };
  ConsentFSM.prototype.active=function(){ return this.state==="ON"; };
  global.ConsentFSM = ConsentFSM;
})(window);
'@

$aiPostProcessJs = @'
/* ai_postprocess.js (non-invasive wrapper) */
(function(){
  function log(m){ try{console.log(m);}catch(e){} }
  if(!window.najikaAI){ log("ai_postprocess: najikaAI not ready"); return; }

  window.najikaAI.isLocalRoute = function(){
    return !this.currentRoute || this.currentRoute.model === "ollama";
  };

  window.najikaAI.expandPlaceholders = async function(text){
    try{
      if(!this.nsfwMode || !this.isLocalRoute()) return text;
      if(!this.nsfwMap){
        const r = await fetch("config/nsfw_placeholders_LOCAL_ONLY.json");
        this.nsfwMap = r.ok ? await r.json() : {};
      }
      return text.replace(/SCENE_[A-Z_]+/g, function(t){ return (window.najikaAI.nsfwMap[t] || t); });
    }catch(e){ return text; }
  };

  window.najikaAI.postProcess = async function(reply){
    return await this.expandPlaceholders(reply);
  };

  var origSend = (window.najikaAI.sendMessage ? window.najikaAI.sendMessage.bind(window.najikaAI) : null);
  if(typeof origSend === "function"){
    window.najikaAI.sendMessage = async function(message){
      var out = await origSend(message);
      try{
        var final = await this.postProcess(out);
        var last = (this.conversationHistory && this.conversationHistory[this.conversationHistory.length-1]);
        if(last -and $true){}  # noop to keep PS parser happy (no effect in JS string)
        if(last && last.role==="assistant"){ last.content = final; }
        return final;
      }catch(e){ return out; }
    };
  }
})();
'@

$roomManagerJs = @'
/* room_manager.js (UMD-style) */
(function(global){
  function RoomManager(scene){
    this.scene = scene; this.current = null;
    this.loader = (global.THREE && global.THREE.GLTFLoader) ? new global.THREE.GLTFLoader() : null;
    if(!this.loader){ console.warn("RoomManager: GLTFLoader not found."); }
  }
  RoomManager.prototype.setRoom = function(name){
    var self=this;
    return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){
      if(!self.loader) return reject("No GLTFLoader");
      var url = "assets/rooms/" + name + ".glb";
      self.loader.load(url, function(gltf){
        if(self.current){ self.scene.remove(self.current); }
        self.current = gltf.scene;
        self.current.traverse(function(o){
          if(o.isMesh){ o.castShadow = true; o.receiveShadow = true; }
        });
        self.scene.add(self.current);
        resolve(self.current);
      }, undefined, reject);
    });
  };
  global.RoomManager = RoomManager;
})(window);
'@

$consentBridgeJs = @'
/* consent_bridge.js */
(function(){
  if(!window.ConsentFSM) return;
  if(!window.consentFSM) window.consentFSM = new ConsentFSM();

  var prev=null;
  setInterval(function(){
    try{
      var on = (localStorage.getItem("nsfw_active")==="true");
      if(on!==prev){
        prev=on;
        window.consentFSM.event(on ? "NSFW_ON" : "NSFW_OFF");
      }
    }catch(e){}
  }, 1000);

  var btn = document.getElementById("terminal-nsfw-btn");
  if(btn){
    btn.addEventListener("click", function(){
      var on = (localStorage.getItem("nsfw_active")==="true");
      window.consentFSM.event(on ? "NSFW_ON" : "NSFW_OFF");
    });
  }
})();
'@

$writes = @(
  @{ Path = "$Root\config\najika_personality_CORE.json";   Content = $coreJson },
  @{ Path = "$Root\config\najika_nsfw_addon.json";         Content = $nsfwAddonJson },
  @{ Path = "$Root\config\nsfw_placeholders_LOCAL_ONLY.json"; Content = $nsfwLocalMap },
  @{ Path = "$Root\js\consent_fsm.js";                     Content = $consentFsmJs },
  @{ Path = "$Root\js\ai_postprocess.js";                  Content = $aiPostProcessJs },
  @{ Path = "$Root\js\room_manager.js";                    Content = $roomManagerJs },
  @{ Path = "$Root\js\consent_bridge.js";                  Content = $consentBridgeJs }
)

foreach ($w in $writes) {
  $res = Write-UTF8 -path $w.Path -content $w.Content
  $mark = "•"; if ($res -eq "WRITE") { $mark = "✓" }
  $color = "Yellow"; if ($res -eq "WRITE") { $color = "Green" }
  Write-Host ("{0} {1}" -f $mark, $w.Path) -ForegroundColor $color
}

$index = "$Root\index_3d.html"
if ($PatchIndex -and (Test-Path $index)) {
  $html = Get-Content $index -Raw -Encoding UTF8
  $changed = $false
  $needed = @(
    '<script src="js/consent_fsm.js"></script>',
    '<script src="js/ai_postprocess.js"></script>',
    '<script src="js/room_manager.js"></script>',
    '<script src="js/consent_bridge.js"></script>'
  )
  foreach ($tag in $needed) {
    if ($html -notmatch [regex]::Escape($tag)) {
      $html = $html -replace '(</body>)', ("  {0}`r`n$1" -f $tag)
      $changed = $true
    }
  }
  if ($changed) {
    $html | Out-File -FilePath $index -Encoding UTF8 -Force
    Write-Host "✓ index_3d.html patched (script tags added)" -ForegroundColor Green
  } else {
    Write-Host "• index_3d.html already contains script tags" -ForegroundColor Yellow
  }
} else {
  Write-Host "• index_3d.html not found or PatchIndex=false (skipped)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

Write-Host "`nDone.`n" -ForegroundColor Cyan

function Write-UTF8 {
  param([string]$path,[string]$content)
  $dir = Split-Path $path
  if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
  if ((Test-Path $path) -and -not $Force) { return "SKIP" }
  $content | Out-File -FilePath $path -Encoding UTF8 -Force
  return "WRITE"
}

  function ConsentFSM(){ this.state="OFF"; }
  ConsentFSM.prototype.event=function(ev){
    if(ev==="NSFW_ON") this.state="ON";
    if(ev==="NSFW_OFF") this.state="OFF";
    if(ev==="SAFE_STOP") this.state="OFF";
    if(ev==="PAUSE") this.state="PAUSE";

$aiPostProcessJs = @'
/* ai_postprocess.js (wrapper) */
(function(){
  function log(m){ try{console.log(m);}catch(e){} }
  if(!window.najikaAI){ log("ai_postprocess: najikaAI not ready"); return; }

  window.najikaAI.isLocalRoute = function(){
    return !this.currentRoute || this.currentRoute.model === "ollama";
  };

  window.najikaAI.expandPlaceholders = async function(text){
    try{
      if(!this.nsfwMode || !this.isLocalRoute()) return text;
      if(!this.nsfwMap){
        const r = await fetch("config/nsfw_placeholders_LOCAL_ONLY.json");
        this.nsfwMap = r.ok ? await r.json() : {};
      }
      return text.replace(/SCENE_[A-Z_]+/g, function(t){ return (window.najikaAI.nsfwMap[t] || t); });
    }catch(e){ return text; }
  };

  window.najikaAI.postProcess = async function(reply){
    return await this.expandPlaceholders(reply);
  };

  var origSend = (typeof window.najikaAI.sendMessage === "function") ? window.najikaAI.sendMessage.bind(window.najikaAI) : null;
  if(origSend){
    window.najikaAI.sendMessage = async function(message){
      var out = await origSend(message);
      try{
        var final = await this.postProcess(out);
        var last = (this.conversationHistory && this.conversationHistory[this.conversationHistory.length-1]) || null;
        if(last && last.role === "assistant"){ last.content = final; }

    };

})();

$roomManagerJs = @'
/* room_manager.js (expects THREE + GLTFLoader) */
(function(global){
  function RoomManager(scene){
    this.scene = scene;
    this.current = null;
    this.loader = (global.THREE && global.THREE.GLTFLoader) ? new global.THREE.GLTFLoader() : null;
    if(!this.loader){ console.warn("RoomManager: GLTFLoader not found."); }
  }
  RoomManager.prototype.setRoom = function(name){
    var self=this;
    return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){
      if(!self.loader) return reject("No GLTFLoader");
      var url = "assets/rooms/" + name + ".glb";
      self.loader.load(url, function(gltf){
        if(self.current){ self.scene.remove(self.current); }
        self.current = gltf.scene;
        self.current.traverse(function(o){
          if(o.isMesh){ o.castShadow = true; o.receiveShadow = true; }
        });
        self.scene.add(self.current);
        resolve(self.current);
      }, undefined, reject);
    });
  };
  global.RoomManager = RoomManager;
})(window);

function Write-UTF8($Path,$Content){
  $dir = Split-Path $Path
  if(-not (Test-Path $dir)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
  $Content | Out-File -FilePath $Path -Encoding UTF8 -Force
}

function Read-UTF8($Path){
  if(Test-Path $Path){ return Get-Content $Path -Raw -Encoding UTF8 } else { return "" }
}

$consentFSM = @'
// Minimal Consent FSM
(function(g){
  function ConsentFSM(){ this.state="OFF"; }
  ConsentFSM.prototype.event=function(ev){
    if(ev==="NSFW_ON") this.state="ON";
    if(ev==="NSFW_OFF") this.state="OFF";
    if(ev==="SAFE_STOP") this.state="OFF";
    if(ev==="PAUSE") this.state="PAUSE";
    if(ev==="RESUME" && this.state==="PAUSE") this.state="ON";
    return this.state;
  };
  ConsentFSM.prototype.active=function(){ return this.state==="ON"; };
  g.ConsentFSM = ConsentFSM;
})(window);
'
Write-UTF8 (Join-Path $jsDir "consent_fsm.js") $consentFSM

# 1c) ai_postprocess.js  (Safeword + Placeholder-Expand)
$aiPost = @'
// Postprocess wrapper: Safewords + Placeholder-Expansion
(function(){
  function patchWhenReady(){
    if(!window.najikaAI){ setTimeout(patchWhenReady,500); return; }
    if(window.najikaAI.__patchedPost) return;
    window.najikaAI.__patchedPost = true;

    var SAFEWORDS = [/^nsfw deaktivieren$/i, /^es reicht jetzt$/i];

    function isLocalRoute(ctx){
      try { return !ctx.currentRoute || ctx.currentRoute.model==="ollama"; } catch(e){ return true; }
    }

    window.najikaAI._isSafeword = function(t){
      var s=String(t||"").trim();
      for(var i=0;i<SAFEWORDS.length;i++){ if(SAFEWORDS[i].test(s)) return true; }
      return false;
    };

    window.najikaAI.expandPlaceholders = async function(text){
      try{
        if(!this.nsfwMode || !isLocalRoute(this)) return text;
        if(!this.nsfwMap){
          var r = await fetch("config/nsfw_placeholders_LOCAL_ONLY.json");
          this.nsfwMap = r.ok ? await r.json() : {};
        }
        return String(text||"").replace(/SCENE_[A-Z_]+/g, (t)=> this.nsfwMap[t] || t);
      }catch(e){ return text; }
    };

    var orig = (typeof window.najikaAI.sendMessage==="function") ? window.najikaAI.sendMessage.bind(window.najikaAI) : null;
    if(!orig) return;

    window.najikaAI.sendMessage = async function(message){
      // Safeword
      if(this._isSafeword(message)){
        try{ if(window.nsfwController){ window.nsfwController.deactivateNSFW(); } }catch(e){}
        return "NSFW deaktiviert.";
      }
      var out = await orig(message);
      try{
        var final = await this.expandPlaceholders(out);
        var last = this.conversationHistory && this.conversationHistory[this.conversationHistory.length-1];
        if(last && last.role==="assistant"){ last.content = final; }
        return final;
      }catch(e){ return out; }
    };

    // Fallback: loadPersonality, falls nicht vorhanden
    if(!window.najikaAI.loadPersonality){
      window.najikaAI.loadPersonality = function(cfg){
        this.personality = cfg || {};
        this.nsfwMode = !!(cfg && cfg.nsfwActive);
      };
    }
  }
  if(document.readyState==="loading"){ document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", patchWhenReady); }
  else { patchWhenReady(); }
})();
'
Write-UTF8 (Join-Path $jsDir "ai_postprocess.js") $aiPost

function Write-UTF8($Path,$Content){
  $dir = Split-Path $Path
  if(-not (Test-Path $dir)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
  $Content | Out-File -FilePath $Path -Encoding UTF8 -Force
}

$consentFSM = @"
(function(g){
  function ConsentFSM(){ this.state="OFF"; }
  ConsentFSM.prototype.event=function(ev){
    if(ev==="NSFW_ON") this.state="ON";
    if(ev==="NSFW_OFF") this.state="OFF";
    if(ev==="SAFE_STOP") this.state="OFF";
    if(ev==="PAUSE") this.state="PAUSE";
    if(ev==="RESUME" && this.state==="PAUSE") this.state="ON";
    return this.state;
  };
  ConsentFSM.prototype.active=function(){ return this.state==="ON"; };
  g.ConsentFSM = ConsentFSM;

$aiPost = @"
(function(){
  function patchWhenReady(){
    if(!window.najikaAI){ setTimeout(patchWhenReady,500); return; }
    if(window.najikaAI.__patchedPost) return;
    window.najikaAI.__patchedPost = true;

    var SAFEWORDS = [/^nsfw deaktivieren$/i, /^es reicht jetzt$/i];

    function isLocalRoute(ctx){
      try { return !ctx.currentRoute || ctx.currentRoute.model==="ollama"; } catch(e){ return true; }
    }

    window.najikaAI._isSafeword = function(t){
      var s=String(t||"").trim();
      for(var i=0;i<SAFEWORDS.length;i++){ if(SAFEWORDS[i].test(s)) return true; }
      return false;
    };

    window.najikaAI.expandPlaceholders = async function(text){
      try{
        if(!this.nsfwMode || !isLocalRoute(this)) return text;
        if(!this.nsfwMap){
          var r = await fetch("config/nsfw_placeholders_LOCAL_ONLY.json");
          this.nsfwMap = r.ok ? await r.json() : {};
        }
        return String(text||"").replace(/SCENE_[A-Z_]+/g, (t)=> this.nsfwMap[t] || t);
      }catch(e){ return text; }
    };

    var orig = (typeof window.najikaAI.sendMessage==="function") ? window.najikaAI.sendMessage.bind(window.najikaAI) : null;
    if(!orig) return;

    window.najikaAI.sendMessage = async function(message){
      if(this._isSafeword(message)){
        try{ if(window.nsfwController){ window.nsfwController.deactivateNSFW(); } }catch(e){}
        return "NSFW deaktiviert.";
      }
      var out = await orig(message);
      try{
        var final = await this.expandPlaceholders(out);
        var last = this.conversationHistory && this.conversationHistory[this.conversationHistory.length-1];
        if(last && last.role==="assistant"){ last.content = final; }
        return final;
      }catch(e){ return out; }
    };

    if(!window.najikaAI.loadPersonality){
      window.najikaAI.loadPersonality = function(cfg){
        this.personality = cfg || {};
        this.nsfwMode = !!(cfg && (cfg.nsfwActive || cfg.nsfw));
      };
    }
  }
  if(document.readyState==="loading"){ document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", patchWhenReady); }
  else { patchWhenReady(); }
})();

ChatGPT:

Kurz: Alles richtig.
Dein Batch startet den richtigen Server (najika_server.py auf Port 8000), proxyt an /api/ollama, öffnet Ngrok. Die Console-Logs zeigen, dass UI & Proxy laufen (200 OK). Der frühere 404 kam nur vom falschen Ordner/python -m http.server.

So benutzt du’s jetzt korrekt

    Öffne: http://localhost:8000/index_3d.html (oder die Ngrok-URL).

    Nicht parallel zusätzlich python -m http.server starten – das kollidiert.

    Falls was “hängt”:

    taskkill /IM python.exe /F
    taskkill /IM ollama.exe /F

    dann dein Batch erneut ausführen.

Hinweise

    Meldung „Using placeholder (Kay-Kit Mage not found)“: optional die passende KayKit-GLB in C:\NajikaCore\assets\characters\ legen oder Loader-Konfig anpassen.

    Dein Ngrok-Authtoken steht im Batch – tausche/rotiere ihn und lager ihn besser in eine ENV-Variable aus.

1) Installer für Room-UI (einmal ausführen)

Speichere als C:\NajikaCore\tools\INSTALL_ROOMS_UI.ps1 und führe aus:

param([string]$Root="C:\NajikaCore")

$roomsDir = Join-Path $Root "assets\rooms"
$toolsDir = Join-Path $Root "tools"
$jsDir    = Join-Path $Root "js"
$index    = Join-Path $Root "index_3d.html"

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $roomsDir,$jsDir | Out-Null

# Beispiel-Index (später beliebig erweitern)
$roomsJson = @'
{
  "wohnzimmer": { "file": "wohnzimmer.glb", "camera": [0,1.6,3], "lookAt": [0,1.5,0] },
  "schlafzimmer": { "file": "schlafzimmer.glb", "camera": [0,1.4,2.8], "lookAt": [0,1.2,0] },
  "buero":       { "file": "buero.glb",       "camera": [0,1.7,3.2], "lookAt": [0,1.5,0] }
}
'@
$roomsIndexPath = Join-Path $roomsDir "ROOMS_INDEX.json"
$roomsJson | Out-File -Encoding UTF8 $roomsIndexPath

# Room-UI Script
$roomUi = @'
(function(){
  function byId(id){return document.getElementById(id)}

  async function loadIndex(){
    const res = await fetch("assets/rooms/ROOMS_INDEX.json");
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error("ROOMS_INDEX.json not found");
    return await res.json();
  }

  function ensureUI(){
    if(byId("room-select")) return;
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.id = "room-ui";
    wrap.style.position = "fixed";
    wrap.style.left = "20px";
    wrap.style.bottom = "20px";
    wrap.style.zIndex = "9999";
    wrap.style.background = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
    wrap.style.padding = "8px";
    wrap.style.borderRadius = "8px";
    wrap.style.fontFamily = "sans-serif";

    const label = document.createElement("label");
    label.textContent = "Raum:";
    label.style.color = "#fff";
    label.style.marginRight = "8px";
    label.setAttribute("for","room-select");

    const sel = document.createElement("select");
    sel.id = "room-select";
    sel.style.minWidth = "160px";

    wrap.appendChild(label);
    wrap.appendChild(sel);
    document.body.appendChild(wrap);
  }

  async function init(){
    try{
      const idx = await loadIndex();
      ensureUI();
      const sel = document.getElementById("room-select");
      sel.innerHTML = "";

      Object.keys(idx).forEach(k=>{
        const opt = document.createElement("option");
        opt.value = k; opt.textContent = k;
        sel.appendChild(opt);
      });

      async function go(key){
        const cfg = idx[key];
        if(!cfg) return;
        if(window.roomManager && typeof window.roomManager.setRoom==="function"){
          try{
            await window.roomManager.setRoom(key); // erwartet assets/rooms/<key>.glb
          }catch(e){ console.warn("setRoom failed:", e); }
        }
        // Kamera optional setzen, falls vorhanden

              window.camera.lookAt(v);
            }

        }catch(e){}

      // Default: wenn wohnzimmer existiert, sonst erster Eintrag

      // console helper
      window.NJ_rooms = { index: idx, select: (k)=>{ sel.value=k; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event("change")); } };

2) Raum hinzufügen (per Script)

Speichere als C:\NajikaCore\tools\ADD_ROOM.ps1:

param(
  [string]$Root="C:\NajikaCore",
  [string]$Name,                 # z.B. wohnzimmer
  [string]$GlbSource="",         # optional: Pfad zu .glb
  [double[]]$Camera=@(0,1.6,3),
  [double[]]$LookAt=@(0,1.5,0)
)
if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Name)){ Write-Error "Bitte -Name angeben."; exit 1 }

$roomsDir = Join-Path $Root "assets\rooms"
$idxPath  = Join-Path $roomsDir "ROOMS_INDEX.json"
if(-not(Test-Path $idxPath)){ Write-Error "ROOMS_INDEX.json fehlt. Erst INSTALL_ROOMS_UI.ps1 ausführen."; exit 1 }

$idx = Get-Content $idxPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
if($GlbSource -and (Test-Path $GlbSource)){
  Copy-Item -Force $GlbSource (Join-Path $roomsDir ($Name + ".glb"))
}

$idx | Add-Member -NotePropertyName $Name -NotePropertyValue ([pscustomobject]@{
  file   = "$Name.glb"
  camera = $Camera
  lookAt = $LookAt
}) -Force

($idx | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5) | Out-File -Encoding UTF8 $idxPath
Write-Host "[OK] Raum '$Name' registriert."

$roomUi = @'
(function(){
  function byId(id){return document.getElementById(id)}

  async function loadIndex(){
    const res = await fetch("assets/rooms/ROOMS_INDEX.json");
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error("ROOMS_INDEX.json not found");
    return await res.json();
  }

  function ensureUI(){
    if(byId("room-select")) return;
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.id = "room-ui";
    wrap.style.position = "fixed";
    wrap.style.left = "20px";
    wrap.style.bottom = "20px";
    wrap.style.zIndex = "9999";
    wrap.style.background = "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)";
    wrap.style.padding = "8px";
    wrap.style.borderRadius = "8px";
    wrap.style.fontFamily = "sans-serif";

    const label = document.createElement("label");
    label.textContent = "Raum:";
    label.style.color = "#fff";
    label.style.marginRight = "8px";
    label.setAttribute("for","room-select");

    const sel = document.createElement("select");
    sel.id = "room-select";
    sel.style.minWidth = "160px";

    wrap.appendChild(label);
    wrap.appendChild(sel);
    document.body.appendChild(wrap);
  }

  async function init(){
    try{
      const idx = await loadIndex();
      ensureUI();
      const sel = document.getElementById("room-select");
      sel.innerHTML = "";

      Object.keys(idx).forEach(k=>{
        const opt = document.createElement("option");
        opt.value = k; opt.textContent = k;
        sel.appendChild(opt);
      });

      async function go(key){
        const cfg = idx[key];
        if(!cfg) return;
        if(window.roomManager && typeof window.roomManager.setRoom==="function"){
          try{
            await window.roomManager.setRoom(key);
          }catch(e){ console.warn("setRoom failed:", e); }
        }
        try{
          if(window.camera && cfg.camera && cfg.lookAt && Array.isArray(cfg.camera) && Array.isArray(cfg.lookAt)){
            window.camera.position.set(cfg.camera[0], cfg.camera[1], cfg.camera[2]);
            if(window.THREE){
              const v = new window.THREE.Vector3(cfg.lookAt[0], cfg.lookAt[1], cfg.lookAt[2]);
              window.camera.lookAt(v);
            }
          }
        }catch(e){}

      const def = idx["wohnzimmer"] ? "wohnzimmer" : Object.keys(idx)[0];

      window.NJ_rooms = { index: idx, select: (k)=>{ sel.value=k; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event("change")); } };
      console.log("Room UI ready. Use NJ_rooms.select('wohnzimmer').");
    }catch(e){
      console.warn("room_ui init failed:", e);
    }
  }

  if(document.readyState==="loading"){ document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init); }
  else { init(); }
})();

Hier ist ein Einmal-Einfügen-&-Enter PowerShell-Script, das ALLES auf einmal erledigt: Ordner sichern, vorhandene .glb-Räume automatisch erkennen, ROOMS_INDEX.json daraus generieren (Fallback mit Beispielräumen, falls noch keine .glb da sind), room_ui.js schreiben und index_3d.html sauber patchen. Kein Zwischenspeichern nötig.

    Einfach komplett kopieren, in PowerShell einfügen, Enter.

# === INLINE: INSTALL_ROOMS_UI (auto-scan) ===
$Root = "C:\NajikaCore"
$roomsDir = Join-Path $Root "assets\rooms"
$jsDir    = Join-Path $Root "js"
$index    = Join-Path $Root "index_3d.html"

if(-not (Test-Path $Root)){ Write-Host "[ERR] Root not found: $Root" -ForegroundColor Red; return }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $roomsDir,$jsDir | Out-Null

# 1) ROOMS_INDEX.json automatisch aus allen .glb erzeugen (Fallback, wenn leer)
$glbs = @()
if(Test-Path $roomsDir){ $glbs = Get-ChildItem $roomsDir -Filter *.glb -File | Select-Object -Expand FullName }
$indexObj = [ordered]@{}

function Add-Room($name){
  $indexObj[$name] = [ordered]@{
    file   = "$name.glb"
    camera = @(0,1.6,3.0)
    lookAt = @(0,1.5,0.0)
  }
}

if($glbs.Count -gt 0){
  foreach($f in $glbs){
    $bn = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($f)
    if(-not $indexObj.Contains($bn)){ Add-Room $bn }
  }
}else{
  # Fallback-Beispiele – du kannst später einfach .glb ablegen, der UI bleibt gleich
  Add-Room "wohnzimmer"
  Add-Room "schlafzimmer"
  Add-Room "buero"
}

$roomsJson = ($indexObj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5)
$roomsIndexPath = Join-Path $roomsDir "ROOMS_INDEX.json"
$roomsJson | Out-File -Encoding UTF8 $roomsIndexPath
Write-Host "[OK] assets\rooms\ROOMS_INDEX.json" -ForegroundColor Green

# 2) room_ui.js schreiben (Dropdown + Kamera-Set)
$roomUi = @'
(function(){
  function byId(id){return document.getElementById(id);}
  async function loadIndex(){
    const res = await fetch("assets/rooms/ROOMS_INDEX.json");
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error("ROOMS_INDEX.json not found");
    return await res.json();
  }
  function ensureUI(){
    if(byId("room-select")) return;
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.id = "room-ui";
    Object.assign(wrap.style,{
      position:"fixed",left:"20px",bottom:"20px",zIndex:"9999",
      background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.6)",padding:"8px",borderRadius:"8px",
      fontFamily:"sans-serif",backdropFilter:"blur(3px)"
    });
    const label = document.createElement("label");
    label.textContent = "Raum:";
    label.style.color = "#fff";
    label.style.marginRight = "8px";
    label.htmlFor = "room-select";
    const sel = document.createElement("select");
    sel.id = "room-select"; sel.style.minWidth = "180px";
    wrap.appendChild(label); wrap.appendChild(sel); document.body.appendChild(wrap);
  }
  async function init(){
    try{
      const idx = await loadIndex();
      ensureUI();
      const sel = byId("room-select"); sel.innerHTML = "";
      Object.keys(idx).forEach(k=>{
        const opt = document.createElement("option"); opt.value=k; opt.textContent=k; sel.appendChild(opt);
      });
      async function go(key){
        const cfg = idx[key]; if(!cfg) return;
        if(window.roomManager && typeof window.roomManager.setRoom==="function"){
          try{ await window.roomManager.setRoom(key); }catch(e){ console.warn("setRoom failed:", e); }
        }
        try{
          if(window.camera && cfg.camera && cfg.lookAt){
            window.camera.position.set(cfg.camera[0],cfg.camera[1],cfg.camera[2]);
            if(window.THREE){
              const v = new window.THREE.Vector3(cfg.lookAt[0],cfg.lookAt[1],cfg.lookAt[2]);
              window.camera.lookAt(v);
            }
          }
        }catch(e){}
      }
      sel.addEventListener("change", ()=>go(sel.value));
      const first = Object.keys(idx)[0]; if(first){ sel.value=first; go(first); }
      window.NJ_rooms = {
        index: idx,
        select: (k)=>{ if(idx[k]){ sel.value=k; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event("change")); } }
      };
      console.log("Room UI ready. NJ_rooms.select('<raumname>')");
    }catch(e){ console.warn("room_ui init failed:", e); }
  }
  if(document.readyState==="loading"){ document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init); }
  else { init(); }
})();

$roomUI=@'
(function(){
  function id(x){return document.getElementById(x);}
  async function getIndex(){const r=await fetch("assets/rooms/ROOMS_INDEX.json");return await r.json();}
  function ensureUI(){
    if(id("room-select")) return;
    const w=document.createElement("div"); w.id="room-ui"; Object.assign(w.style,{position:"fixed",left:"20px",bottom:"20px",zIndex:"9999",background:"rgba(0,0,0,.6)",padding:"8px",borderRadius:"8px",color:"#fff",fontFamily:"sans-serif"});
    const lab=document.createElement("label"); lab.textContent="Raum:"; lab.style.marginRight="8px"; lab.htmlFor="room-select";
    const sel=document.createElement("select"); sel.id="room-select"; sel.style.minWidth="180px";
    w.appendChild(lab); w.appendChild(sel); document.body.appendChild(w);
  }
  function clearEnv(list){(list||[]).forEach(o=>{try{scene.remove(o)}catch(e){} }); if(list) list.length=0;}
  function loadGlb(url,done,fail){
    try{
      var L=(window.THREE&&window.THREE.GLTFLoader)? new window.THREE.GLTFLoader(): null;
      if(!L){fail&&fail("GLTFLoader missing");return;}
      L.load(url,g=>done&&done(g.scene),undefined,()=>fail&&fail("load error"));
    }catch(e){fail&&fail(e);}
  }
  async function init(){
    try{
      const idx=await getIndex(); ensureUI(); const sel=id("room-select"); sel.innerHTML="";
      Object.keys(idx).forEach(k=>{const o=document.createElement("option"); o.value=k; o.textContent=k; sel.appendChild(o);});
      window.environmentObjects=window.environmentObjects||[];
      async function go(key){
        const cfg=idx[key]; if(!cfg) return;
        clearEnv(window.environmentObjects);
        const url="assets/rooms/"+cfg.file;
        loadGlb(url,(obj)=>{ 
          obj.traverse(n=>{ if(n.isMesh){ n.castShadow=true; n.receiveShadow=true; }});
          scene.add(obj); window.environmentObjects.push(obj);
        },()=>{ console.warn("GLB fehlt:",url); });
        if(window.camera && cfg.camera && cfg.lookAt){
          camera.position.set(cfg.camera[0],cfg.camera[1],cfg.camera[2]);
          if(window.THREE){ camera.lookAt(new THREE.Vector3(cfg.lookAt[0],cfg.lookAt[1],cfg.lookAt[2])); }
        }
      }
      sel.addEventListener("change",()=>go(sel.value));
      const first=Object.keys(idx)[0]; if(first){ sel.value=first; go(first); }
      window.NJ_rooms={index:idx,select:(k)=>{ if(idx[k]){ sel.value=k; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event("change")); } }};
      console.log("Room UI ready");
    }catch(e){ console.warn("room_ui init failed",e); }
  }
  if(document.readyState==="loading"){ document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",init);} else {init();}
})();
'@

# === BUILD_ROOMS_FROM_KAYKIT.ps1 (inline: kopieren & Enter) ===
param(
  [string]$Root = "C:\NajikaCore",
  [string]$KayKitRoot = "C:\NajikaCore\assets\kaykit",
  [int]$PerRoom = 8
)

# --- Helpers ---
function Ensure-Dir($p){ if(-not (Test-Path $p)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $p | Out-Null } }
function Tokens($s){
  ($s.ToLower() -split '[^a-z0-9]+' | Where-Object { $_ -ne "" })
}
function Score-Asset($tokens, $kw){
  $score = 0
  foreach($t in $tokens){
    if($kw -contains $t){ $score += 3 }
  }
  return $score
}
function Copy-Unique($src,$dstDir){
  Ensure-Dir $dstDir
  $name = [IO.Path]::GetFileName($src)
  $base = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($name)
  $ext  = [IO.Path]::GetExtension($name)
  $target = Join-Path $dstDir $name
  $i = 1
  while(Test-Path $target){
    $target = Join-Path $dstDir ("{0}_{1}{2}" -f $base,$i,$ext)
    $i++
  }
  Copy-Item $src $target -Force
  return [IO.Path]::GetFileName($target)
}

# --- Paths ---
$RoomsRoot = Join-Path $Root "assets\rooms"
Ensure-Dir $RoomsRoot

# --- Raum-Definitionen & Keywords ---
$rooms = [ordered]@{
  living   = @{ camera=@(0,3.5,10); lookAt=@(0,1.5,0); want=$PerRoom; kw=@('living','lounge','room','home','house','sofa','couch','table','chair','lamp','plant','carpet','cabinet','tv') }
  training = @{ camera=@(0,3.0,12); lookAt=@(0,1.5,0); want=$PerRoom; kw=@('gym','training','workout','bench','barbell','dumbbell','kettlebell','mat','track','box','punch','bag') }
  study    = @{ camera=@(0,3.0,10); lookAt=@(0,1.5,0); want=$PerRoom; kw=@('study','library','book','bookshelf','desk','table','chair','lamp','lab','research','paper','scroll') }
  hospital = @{ camera=@(2,3.0,10); lookAt=@(0,1.5,0); want=$PerRoom; kw=@('hospital','clinic','med','medical','bed','stretcher','monitor','syringe','cabinet','pharma','vital') }
  battle   = @{ camera=@(6,3.5,14); lookAt=@(0,1.5,0); want=$PerRoom; kw=@('arena','battle','combat','training','target','dummy','weapon','shield','banner','rock','pillar','gate') }
  music    = @{ camera=@(0,3.0,10); lookAt=@(0,1.5,0); want=$PerRoom; kw=@('music','instrument','piano','guitar','drum','speaker','amp','mic','stage','concert','stand') }
  terminal = @{ camera=@(0,3.0, 8); lookAt=@(0,1.5,0); want=$PerRoom; kw=@('terminal','console','computer','server','screen','keyboard','desk','workstation','panel','control') }
}
$filler = @('crate','box','barrel','plant','lamp','chair','table','shelf','tool','cart','cabinet','bench','rock','pillar','cone','pipe','wire')

# --- KayKit Assets sammeln ---
if(-not (Test-Path $KayKitRoot)){ Write-Host "[ERR] KayKitRoot not found: $KayKitRoot" -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }
$assets = Get-ChildItem -Path $KayKitRoot -Recurse -File -Include *.glb,*.gltf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if($assets.Count -eq 0){ Write-Host "[ERR] Keine *.glb / *.gltf unter $KayKitRoot gefunden." -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }

# Vorbereiten: Tokenize
$assetInfo = @()
foreach($a in $assets){
  $rel = $a.FullName
  $tks = Tokens($rel)
  $assetInfo += [pscustomobject]@{ Path=$rel; Tokens=$tks }
}

# --- Auswahl + Kopieren + JSON bauen ---
$roomJson = @{}
foreach($rk in $rooms.Keys){
  $cfg = $rooms[$rk]
  $targetDir = Join-Path $RoomsRoot $rk
  Ensure-Dir $targetDir

  # Scoring
  $scored = foreach($ai in $assetInfo){
    $s = Score-Asset $ai.Tokens $cfg.kw
    if($s -le 0){
      # schwache Treffer über Filler
      if(($ai.Tokens | Where-Object { $filler -contains $_ }).Count -gt 0){ $s = 1 }
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Path=$ai.Path; Score=$s; Tokens=$ai.Tokens }
  } | Sort-Object Score -Descending

  # Auswahl
  $pick = @()
  foreach($row in $scored){
    if($pick.Count -ge $cfg.want){ break }
    if($row.Score -gt 0){ $pick += $row }
  }

  # Falls zu wenig, beliebig auffüllen
  if($pick.Count -lt $cfg.want){
    $more = $assetInfo | Get-Random -Count ([Math]::Min($cfg.want - $pick.Count, $assetInfo.Count)) 
    foreach($m in $more){
      if($pick.Count -ge $cfg.want){ break }
      if(-not ($pick.Path -contains $m.Path)){ $pick += [pscustomobject]@{ Path=$m.Path; Score=0; Tokens=$m.Tokens } }
    }
  }

  # Kopieren + Objekte platzieren
  $objects = @()
  $n = [Math]::Max(1, $pick.Count)
  for($i=0; $i -lt $pick.Count; $i++){
    $file = Copy-Unique -src $pick[$i].Path -dstDir $targetDir
    $angle = (2 * [Math]::PI) * ($i / $n)
    $radius = 4 + [Math]::Floor($i / 6) * 2
    $px = [Math]::Cos($angle) * $radius
    $pz = [Math]::Sin($angle) * $radius
    $ry = ((Get-Random -Minimum 0 -Maximum 100000) / 100000.0) * 6.28318530718
    $sc = 0.9 + ((Get-Random -Minimum 0 -Maximum 100000) / 100000.0) * 0.4  # 0.9..1.3

    $objects += [pscustomobject]@{
      model    = $file
      position = @([Math]::Round($px,2), 0, [Math]::Round($pz,2))
      rotation = @(0, [Math]::Round($ry,3), 0)
      scale    = [Math]::Round($sc,2)
    }
  }

  $roomJson[$rk] = [pscustomobject]@{
    camera  = $cfg.camera
    lookAt  = $cfg.lookAt
    objects = $objects
  }

  Write-Host ("[OK] {0,-9} -> {1} Objekte" -f $rk, $objects.Count) -ForegroundColor Green
}

# --- JSON schreiben ---
$cfgPath = Join-Path $Root "assets\room_config_detailed.json"
($roomJson | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10) | Out-File -Encoding UTF8 $cfgPath
Write-Host "[OK] room_config_detailed.json geschrieben" -ForegroundColor Green

  $scored = $assetInfo | ForEach-Object {
    $s = Score-Asset $_.Tokens $cfg.kw
    if($s -le 0){ if( ($_.Tokens | Where-Object { $filler -contains $_ }).Count -gt 0){ $s = 1 } }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Path=$_.Path; Score=$s; Tokens=$_.Tokens }
  } | Sort-Object Score -Descending

  $pick = @(); foreach($row in $scored){ if($pick.Count -ge $cfg.want){ break }; if($row.Score -gt 0){ $pick += $row } }
  if($pick.Count -lt $cfg.want){
    $need = $cfg.want - $pick.Count
    $more = $assetInfo | Get-Random -Count ([Math]::Min($need,[Math]::Max(1,$assetInfo.Count)))
    foreach($m in $more){ if($pick.Count -ge $cfg.want){ break }; if(-not ($pick.Path -contains $m.Path)){ $pick += [pscustomobject]@{ Path=$m.Path; Score=0; Tokens=$m.Tokens } } }
  }

  $objects = @(); $n=[Math]::Max(1,$pick.Count)
  for($i=0;$i -lt $pick.Count;$i++){
    $file = Copy-Unique -src $pick[$i].Path -dstDir $targetDir
    $angle = (2*[Math]::PI)*($i/$n); $radius = 4 + [Math]::Floor($i/6)*2
    $px=[Math]::Round([Math]::Cos($angle)*$radius,2); $pz=[Math]::Round([Math]::Sin($angle)*$radius,2)
    $ry=[Math]::Round((Get-Random -Minimum 0 -Maximum 6283)/1000.0,3); $sc=[Math]::Round(0.9 + (Get-Random)/2147483647*0.4,2)
    $objects += [pscustomobject]@{ model=$file; position=@($px,0,$pz); rotation=@(0,$ry,0); scale=$sc }
  }

  $roomJson[$rk] = [pscustomobject]@{ camera=$cfg.camera; lookAt=$cfg.lookAt; objects=$objects }
  Write-Host ("[OK] {0,-9} -> {1} Objekte" -f $rk,$objects.Count) -ForegroundColor Green
}

$cfgPath = Join-Path $Root "assets\room_config_detailed.json"
($roomJson | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10) | Out-File -Encoding UTF8 $cfgPath
Write-Host "[OK] room_config_detailed.json geschrieben" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "Fertig. Seite neu laden – Räume werden aus KayKit geladen." -ForegroundColor Cyan

Hier ist ein einmal einfügen & Enter-Script, das KayKit-Modelle automatisch findet, je Raum Ordner anlegt, passende GLB/GLTF-Dateien hineinkopiert und eine assets\room_config_detailed.json mit Boden/Wänden/Props (Dungeon-Style) erzeugt. Danach Seite neu laden.

# ==== BUILD_ROOMS_FROM_KAYKIT (inline, paste & Enter) ==========================================
$Root = "C:\NajikaCore"
$KayKitRoots = @("C:\NajikaCore\assets\kaykit")      # ggf. weitere Wurzeln ergänzen
$PreferredPacks = @("Dungeon","Mini-Game","Castle","Village")

function Ensure-Dir($p){ if(-not(Test-Path $p)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $p -Force | Out-Null } }
function Copy-Once($src,$dstDir){ Ensure-Dir $dstDir; $dst = Join-Path $dstDir $src.Name; if(-not (Test-Path $dst)){ Copy-Item $src.FullName $dst -Force } ; return $src.Name }

function Get-BestMatch($files, [string[]]$namePatterns, [string[]]$preferred){
  $best=$null; $bestScore=-1
  foreach($f in $files){
    $name = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($f.Name).ToLower()
    $path = $f.FullName.ToLower()
    $score = 0
    foreach($p in $namePatterns){ if($name -like "*$p*"){ $score += 5 } }
    foreach($pref in $preferred){ $pl=$pref.ToLower(); if($path -like "*$pl*"){ $score += 2 } }
    if($f.Extension.ToLower() -eq ".glb"){ $score += 1 }
    if($score -gt $bestScore){ $bestScore=$score; $best=$f }
  }
  return $best
}

# 0) Sammle GLB/GLTF
$allGl = @()
foreach($root in $KayKitRoots){
  if(Test-Path $root){
    $allGl += Get-ChildItem -Path $root -Recurse -Include *.glb,*.gltf -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  }
}
if(-not $allGl -or $allGl.Count -eq 0){ Write-Host "[ERR] Keine *.glb/*.gltf in $($KayKitRoots -join ', ')" -ForegroundColor Red; return }

# 1) Wähle Dungeon-Basis-Teile (heuristisch)
$want = @{
  floor  = @("floor","tile","ground")
  wall   = @("wall","stone","brick")
  corner = @("corner","bend")
  door   = @("door","gate","arch")
  pillar = @("pillar","column")
  light  = @("torch","lamp","light")
  table  = @("table","desk")
  chair  = @("chair","stool")
  bed    = @("bed")
}
$pick = @{}
foreach($k in $want.Keys){ $pick[$k] = Get-BestMatch $allGl $want[$k] $PreferredPacks }

# 2) Räume definieren
$rooms = @("living","training","study","hospital","battle","music","terminal")
foreach($r in $rooms){ Ensure-Dir (Join-Path $Root ("assets\rooms\"+$r)) }

# 3) Modelle pro Raum kopieren
$copied = @{}
foreach($r in $rooms){
  $dst = Join-Path $Root ("assets\rooms\"+$r)
  $copied[$r] = @{
    floor  = if($pick.floor){  Copy-Once $pick.floor  $dst } else { $null }
    wall   = if($pick.wall){   Copy-Once $pick.wall   $dst } else { $null }
    corner = if($pick.corner){ Copy-Once $pick.corner $dst } else { $null }
    door   = if($pick.door){   Copy-Once $pick.door   $dst } else { $null }
    pillar = if($pick.pillar){ Copy-Once $pick.pillar $dst } else { $null }
    light  = if($pick.light){  Copy-Once $pick.light  $dst } else { $null }
    table  = if($pick.table){  Copy-Once $pick.table  $dst } else { $null }
    chair  = if($pick.chair){  Copy-Once $pick.chair  $dst } else { $null }
    bed    = if($pick.bed){    Copy-Once $pick.bed    $dst } else { $null }
  }
}

# 4) JSON für Objekt-Placement bauen (Dungeon-Box 20x20, kachelnde Floors, 4 Wände, Tür vorne)
function New-Obj($model,$px,$py,$pz,$rx,$ry,$rz,$s){ return @{
  model=$model; position=@($px,$py,$pz); rotation=@($rx,$ry,$rz); scale=$s
}}

$conf = @{}

foreach($r in $rooms){
  $parts = $copied[$r]
  $objs = @()

  # Floors (5x5 Grid, spacing 4)
  if($parts.floor){
    for($ix=-2;$ix -le 2;$ix++){
      for($iz=-2;$iz -le 2;$iz++){
        $objs += New-Obj $parts.floor ($ix*4) 0 ($iz*4) 0 0 0 1.0
      }
    }
  }

  # Wände (N,S,E,W) aus wall/corner; y leicht angehoben
  $yWall = 1.5
  if($parts.wall){
    # Nord (z=+10)
    for($i=-2;$i -le 2;$i++){ $objs += New-Obj $parts.wall ($i*4) $yWall 10 0 0 0 1.0 }
    # Süd (z=-10)
    for($i=-2;$i -le 2;$i++){ $objs += New-Obj $parts.wall ($i*4) $yWall (-10) 0 0 0 1.0 }
    # Ost (x=+10) - gedreht
    for($i=-2;$i -le 2;$i++){ $objs += New-Obj $parts.wall 10 $yWall ($i*4) 0 ([math]::PI/2) 0 1.0 }
    # West (x=-10)
    for($i=-2;$i -le 2;$i++){ $objs += New-Obj $parts.wall (-10) $yWall ($i*4) 0 ([math]::PI/2) 0 1.0 }
  }
  if($parts.corner){
    $objs += New-Obj $parts.corner 10  $yWall 10  0 0 0 1.0
    $objs += New-Obj $parts.corner -10 $yWall 10  0 0 0 1.0
    $objs += New-Obj $parts.corner 10  $yWall -10 0 0 0 1.0
    $objs += New-Obj $parts.corner -10 $yWall -10 0 0 0 1.0
  }
  if($parts.door){
    # Tür an Nordwand Mitte
    $objs += New-Obj $parts.door 0 $yWall 10.01 0 0 0 1.0
  }

  # Raum-spezifische Props
  switch($r){
    "living"   { if($parts.table){ $objs += New-Obj $parts.table 0 0 0 0 0 0 1.0 }
                 if($parts.chair){ $objs += New-Obj $parts.chair 1 0 -1 0 0 0 1.0 } }
    "training" { if($parts.pillar){ $objs += New-Obj $parts.pillar -3 0 0 0 0 0 1.2; $objs += New-Obj $parts.pillar 3 0 0 0 0 0 1.2 } }
    "study"    { if($parts.table){ $objs += New-Obj $parts.table -1 0 2 0 0 0 1.0 }
                 if($parts.chair){ $objs += New-Obj $parts.chair -1 0 1 0 0 0 1.0 } }
    "hospital" { if($parts.bed){ $objs += New-Obj $parts.bed 2 0 0 0 0 0 1.1 } }
    "battle"   { if($parts.pillar){ $objs += New-Obj $parts.pillar -6 0 -6 0 0 0 1.4; $objs += New-Obj $parts.pillar 6 0 -6 0 0 0 1.4 } }
    "music"    { if($parts.table){ $objs += New-Obj $parts.table 0 0 2 0 0 0 1.0 } }
    "terminal" { if($parts.table){ $objs += New-Obj $parts.table 0 0 -2 0 0 0 1.0 } }
  }

  if($parts.light){
    $objs += New-Obj $parts.light -8 3 0 0 0 0 1.0
    $objs += New-Obj $parts.light  8 3 0 0 0 0 1.0
  }

  $conf[$r] = @{ objects = $objs }
}

$confPath = Join-Path $Root "assets\room_config_detailed.json"
$conf | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Out-File $confPath -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[OK] Räume gebaut & JSON geschrieben:" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "  $confPath"
Write-Host "  Assets kopiert nach: assets\rooms\<room>\*"

# ==== INSTALL_ROOMS_FROM_KAYKIT (paste & run) =================================
$Core     = "C:\NajikaCore"
$KayRoot  = "C:\NajikaCore\assets\kaykit"   # <- ggf. anpassen (Wurzel der KayKit-Pakete)
$RoomsDir = Join-Path $Core "assets\rooms"
$CfgPath  = Join-Path $Core "assets\room_config_detailed.json"

if(!(Test-Path $RoomsDir)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $RoomsDir -Force | Out-Null }

# Alle GLB/GLTF sammeln
$all = Get-ChildItem -Path $KayRoot -Recurse -File -Include *.glb,*.gltf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if(!$all){ Write-Host "[ERR] Keine KayKit-Modelle gefunden unter $KayRoot" -ForegroundColor Red; return }

function Pick-ByPatterns([object[]]$files,[string[]]$patterns){
  $best = $null; $bestScore = -1
  foreach($f in $files){
    $name = $f.Name.ToLower()
    $score = 0
    foreach($p in $patterns){
      if($name -match $p.ToLower()){ $score++ }
    }
    if($score -gt $bestScore){ $bestScore = $score; $best = $f }
  }
  if(-not $best){ $best = $files | Select-Object -First 1 }
  return $best
}

# Kandidaten suchen (breite Patterns, Dungeon/Room/Walls bevorzugt)
$floor = Pick-ByPatterns $all @('dungeon','room','floor','tile','ground','platform')
$wallA = Pick-ByPatterns $all @('wall','barrier','fence','dungeon')
$wallB = Pick-ByPatterns ($all | Where-Object { $_.FullName -ne $wallA.FullName }) @('wall','corner','column','pillar','dungeon')
$pillar= Pick-ByPatterns $all @('pillar','column','post')
$prop1 = Pick-ByPatterns $all @('table','bench','crate','box','chest')
$prop2 = Pick-ByPatterns ($all | Where-Object { $_.FullName -ne $prop1.FullName }) @('lamp','torch','barrel','vase','pot')

Write-Host "[INFO] Auswahl:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ("  floor : {0}" -f $floor.FullName)
Write-Host ("  wallA : {0}" -f $wallA.FullName)
Write-Host ("  wallB : {0}" -f $wallB.FullName)
Write-Host ("  pillar: {0}" -f $pillar.FullName)
Write-Host ("  prop1 : {0}" -f $prop1.FullName)
Write-Host ("  prop2 : {0}" -f $prop2.FullName)

$rooms = @('living','training','study','hospital','battle','music','terminal')
$cfg = @{}

foreach($r in $rooms){
  $dest = Join-Path $RoomsDir $r
  if(!(Test-Path $dest)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dest -Force | Out-Null }

  # Ziel-Dateinamen vereinheitlichen
  $map = @{}
  $map['floor.glb']  = $floor
  $map['wall_a.glb'] = $wallA
  $map['wall_b.glb'] = $wallB
  $map['pillar.glb'] = $pillar
  $map['prop1.glb']  = $prop1
  $map['prop2.glb']  = $prop2

  foreach($k in $map.Keys){
    $src = $map[$k]
    if($src){
      $ext = [IO.Path]::GetExtension($src.Name)
      $target = Join-Path $dest ($k -replace '\.glb$', $ext)   # behält .gltf falls nötig
      Copy-Item -Path $src.FullName -Destination $target -Force
      # Merke tatsächlichen Dateinamen, den ThreeJS lädt
      $map[$k] = [IO.Path]::GetFileName($target)
    }
  }

  # einfache viereckige Arena + 2 Props
  $objects = @()
  if($map['floor.glb']){  $objects += @{ model=$map['floor.glb'];  position=@(0,0,0);   rotation=@(0,0,0);         scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['wall_a.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['wall_a.glb']; position=@(0,0,-8);  rotation=@(0,[Math]::PI,0); scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['wall_a.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['wall_a.glb']; position=@(0,0,8);   rotation=@(0,0,0);         scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['wall_b.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['wall_b.glb']; position=@(-8,0,0);  rotation=@(0,[Math]::PI/2,0); scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['wall_b.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['wall_b.glb']; position=@(8,0,0);   rotation=@(0,-[Math]::PI/2,0); scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['pillar.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['pillar.glb']; position=@(-6,0,-6); rotation=@(0,0,0);         scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['pillar.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['pillar.glb']; position=@(6,0,6);   rotation=@(0,0,0);         scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['prop1.glb']){  $objects += @{ model=$map['prop1.glb'];  position=@(2,0,0);   rotation=@(0,0,0);         scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['prop2.glb']){  $objects += @{ model=$map['prop2.glb'];  position=@(-2,0,1.5);rotation=@(0,0,0);         scale=1.0 } }

  $cfg[$r] = @{ objects = $objects }
}

$cfg | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Out-File $CfgPath -Encoding UTF8 -Force
Write-Host "`n[OK] Räume gebaut & $($CfgPath) geschrieben." -ForegroundColor Green

A) GGUF automatisch finden & ein Modell najika bauen (bevorzugt Instruct Q5_K_M)

# ==== FIND_GGUF_AND_CREATE_NAJIKA ============================================
$searchRoots = @("C:\Models","C:\LLM","C:\Downloads","C:\NajikaCore\models")
$patternsPref = @("*Llama*3.1*8B*Instruct*Q5*K*M*.gguf")
$patternsAlt  = @("*Llama*3.1*8B*Base*Q5*K*M*.gguf","*Llama*3.1*8B*Q5*K*M*.gguf")

function Find-Gguf($roots,$pats){
  foreach($r in $roots){ if(Test-Path $r){
    $hits = Get-ChildItem -Path $r -Recurse -File -Include $pats -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending
    if($hits){ return $hits[0].FullName }
  }}
  return $null
}

$gguf = Find-Gguf $searchRoots $patternsPref
if(-not $gguf){ $gguf = Find-Gguf $searchRoots $patternsAlt }

if(-not $gguf){ Write-Host "[ERR] Keine passende GGUF gefunden. Pfad manuell setzen!" -ForegroundColor Red; return }
Write-Host "[OK] GGUF: $gguf" -ForegroundColor Green

$Root="C:\NajikaCore"; $Prompts=Join-Path $Root "prompts"
if(!(Test-Path $Prompts)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Prompts | Out-Null }
$FROM = ($gguf -replace '\\','/')

$mf = @"
FROM $FROM

SYSTEM """
You are Najika — erwachsene, dramatisch-verspielte, analytische Begleiterin.
Bleib in Charakter, 2–4 Sätze, kein Meta/AI-Talk. SFW; NSFW wird app-seitig geschaltet
und via Platzhalter (SCENE_*) lokal expandiert.
"""

PARAMETER temperature 0.85
PARAMETER top_p 0.9
PARAMETER top_k 40
PARAMETER repeat_penalty 1.2
PARAMETER num_ctx 8192
PARAMETER stop "User:"
PARAMETER stop "</s>"

TEMPLATE """
{{ .System }}

User: {{ .Prompt }}

Najika:
"""
"@
$mfPath = Join-Path $Prompts "Modelfile_najika_local"
$mf | Out-File $mfPath -Encoding UTF8 -Force

try{ & ollama rm najika | Out-Null }catch{}
& ollama create najika -f $mfPath
Write-Host "`n[OK] Modell 'najika' erstellt." -ForegroundColor Green
& ollama list | Select-String najika

# ==== REBUILD_ROOMS_FIXED =====================================================
$Core     = "C:\NajikaCore"
$KayRoot  = "C:\NajikaCore\assets\kaykit"   # ggf. anpassen
$RoomsDir = Join-Path $Core "assets\rooms"
$CfgPath  = Join-Path $Core "assets\room_config_detailed.json"

if(!(Test-Path $RoomsDir)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $RoomsDir -Force | Out-Null }

$all = Get-ChildItem -Path $KayRoot -Recurse -File -Include *.glb,*.gltf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if(!$all){ Write-Host "[ERR] Keine KayKit-Modelle unter $KayRoot" -ForegroundColor Red; return }

function Pick-ByPatterns([object[]]$files,[string[]]$patterns){
  $best=$null;$bestScore=-1
  foreach($f in $files){
    $name=$f.Name.ToLower(); $score=0
    foreach($p in $patterns){ if($name -match $p.ToLower()){ $score++ } }
    if($score -gt $bestScore){ $bestScore=$score; $best=$f }
  }
  if(-not $best){ $best = $files | Select-Object -First 1 }
  return $best
}

# Kandidaten wählen
$floor = Pick-ByPatterns $all @('dungeon','room','floor','tile','ground','platform')
$wallA = Pick-ByPatterns $all @('wall','barrier','fence','dungeon')
$wallB = Pick-ByPatterns ($all | Where-Object FullName -ne $wallA.FullName) @('wall','corner','column','pillar','dungeon')
$pillar= Pick-ByPatterns $all @('pillar','column','post')
$prop1 = Pick-ByPatterns $all @('table','bench','crate','box','chest')
$prop2 = Pick-ByPatterns ($all | Where-Object FullName -ne $prop1.FullName) @('lamp','torch','barrel','vase','pot')

Write-Host "[INFO] Auswahl:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ("  floor : {0}" -f $floor.FullName)
Write-Host ("  wallA : {0}" -f $wallA.FullName)
Write-Host ("  wallB : {0}" -f $wallB.FullName)
Write-Host ("  pillar: {0}" -f $pillar.FullName)
Write-Host ("  prop1 : {0}" -f $prop1.FullName)
Write-Host ("  prop2 : {0}" -f $prop2.FullName)

$PI = [Math]::PI
$HALFPI = 1.5707963267948966  # = $PI/2

$rooms = @('living','training','study','hospital','battle','music','terminal')
$cfg = @{}

foreach($r in $rooms){
  $dest = Join-Path $RoomsDir $r
  if(!(Test-Path $dest)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dest -Force | Out-Null }

  $map = @{
    'floor.glb'  = $floor
    'wall_a.glb' = $wallA
    'wall_b.glb' = $wallB
    'pillar.glb' = $pillar
    'prop1.glb'  = $prop1
    'prop2.glb'  = $prop2
  }

  # Keys snapshot → keine Enumerationsfehler
  $keys = @($map.Keys)
  foreach($k in $keys){
    $src = $map[$k]
    if($src){
      $ext = [IO.Path]::GetExtension($src.Name)
      $target = Join-Path $dest ($k -replace '\.glb$', $ext)   # behält .gltf falls nötig
      Copy-Item -Path $src.FullName -Destination $target -Force
      $map[$k] = [IO.Path]::GetFileName($target)
    }else{
      $map[$k] = $null
    }
  }

  $objects = @()
  if($map['floor.glb']){  $objects += @{ model=$map['floor.glb'];  position=@(0,0,0);   rotation=@(0,0,0);            scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['wall_a.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['wall_a.glb']; position=@(0,0,-8);  rotation=@(0,$PI,0);          scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['wall_a.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['wall_a.glb']; position=@(0,0,8);   rotation=@(0,0,0);            scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['wall_b.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['wall_b.glb']; position=@(-8,0,0);  rotation=@(0,$HALFPI,0);      scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['wall_b.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['wall_b.glb']; position=@(8,0,0);   rotation=@(0,-$HALFPI,0);     scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['pillar.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['pillar.glb']; position=@(-6,0,-6); rotation=@(0,0,0);            scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['pillar.glb']){ $objects += @{ model=$map['pillar.glb']; position=@(6,0,6);   rotation=@(0,0,0);            scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['prop1.glb']){  $objects += @{ model=$map['prop1.glb'];  position=@(2,0,0);   rotation=@(0,0,0);            scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['prop2.glb']){  $objects += @{ model=$map['prop2.glb'];  position=@(-2,0,1.5);rotation=@(0,0,0);            scale=1.0 } }

  $cfg[$r] = @{ objects = $objects }
}

$cfg | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Out-File $CfgPath -Encoding UTF8 -Force
Write-Host "`n[OK] Räume gebaut & $CfgPath geschrieben. Reload im Browser." -ForegroundColor Green

# ==== CREATE NAIJKA (lokales GGUF ODER Ollama-Base) ===========================
$searchRoots = @("C:\Models","C:\LLM","C:\Downloads","C:\NajikaCore\models")
$pref = @("*Llama*3.1*8B*Instruct*Q5*K*M*.gguf")
$alt  = @("*Llama*3.1*8B*Base*Q5*K*M*.gguf","*Llama*3.1*8B*Q5*K*M*.gguf")

function Find-Gguf($roots,$pats){
  foreach($r in $roots){ if(Test-Path $r){
    $hits = Get-ChildItem $r -Recurse -File -Include $pats -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending
    if($hits){ return $hits[0].FullName }
  }}
  return $null
}

$gguf = Find-Gguf $searchRoots $pref
if(-not $gguf){ $gguf = Find-Gguf $searchRoots $alt }

$Root="C:\NajikaCore"; $Prompts=Join-Path $Root "prompts"
if(!(Test-Path $Prompts)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Prompts | Out-Null }

if($gguf){
  Write-Host "[OK] GGUF gefunden: $gguf" -ForegroundColor Green
  $FROM = ($gguf -replace '\\','/')
}else{
  Write-Host "[INFO] Kein GGUF gefunden – nutze Ollama Base (wird geladen)." -ForegroundColor Yellow
  $FROM = "llama3.1:8b-instruct"
}

SYSTEM """

"""

Najika:
"""

$Core    = "C:\NajikaCore"

$RoomsDir= Join-Path $Core "assets\rooms"
$CfgPath = Join-Path $Core "assets\room_config_detailed.json"
$CharOut = Join-Path $Core "assets\kaykit\characters"
if(!(Test-Path $RoomsDir)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $RoomsDir -Force | Out-Null }
if(!(Test-Path $CharOut)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $CharOut -Force | Out-Null }

# Sammle alle GLB/GLTF
$all = Get-ChildItem -Path $KayRoot -Recurse -File -Include *.glb,*.gltf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if(!$all){ Write-Host "[ERR] Keine KayKit-Modelle unter $KayRoot" -ForegroundColor Red; return }

function Find-PreferGlb([object[]]$files,[string[]]$patterns){
  $best=$null;$scoreBest=-1
  foreach($f in $files){
    $n=$f.Name.ToLower(); $s=0
    foreach($p in $patterns){ if($n -match $p.ToLower()){ $s++ } }
    if([IO.Path]::GetExtension($f.Name).ToLower() -eq '.glb'){ $s+=0.5 } # leichte Bevorzugung
    if($s -gt $scoreBest){ $scoreBest=$s; $best=$f }
  }
  if(-not $best){ $best = $files | Select-Object -First 1 }
  return $best
}

function Copy-WithDependencies([IO.FileInfo]$src, [string]$destDir){
  if(!(Test-Path $destDir)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destDir -Force | Out-Null }
  $ext = [IO.Path]::GetExtension($src.Name).ToLower()
  if($ext -eq '.glb'){
    Copy-Item -Path $src.FullName -Destination (Join-Path $destDir $src.Name) -Force
    return $src.Name
  } else {
    # .gltf → ganzen Ordner kopieren (inkl. .bin/.png)
    $srcDir = Split-Path $src.FullName -Parent
    $targetDir = Join-Path $destDir ([IO.Path]::GetFileName($srcDir))
    Copy-Item -Path $srcDir -Destination $targetDir -Recurse -Force
    return (Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetFileName($srcDir)) $src.Name) # relativer Pfad
  }
}

# 2.1 Charakter-Placeholder für kaykit_loader.js: assets/kaykit/characters/Mage.glb
$charCand = Find-PreferGlb $all @('mage','wizard','sorcer','character','hero')
if($charCand){
  $rel = Copy-WithDependencies $charCand $CharOut
  # Wenn .gltf kopiert wurde, benenne zusätzlich eine Kopie als Mage.glb (kleine leere Hülle vermeiden wir, nutzen Original)
  $ext = [IO.Path]::GetExtension($rel).ToLower()
  if($ext -eq '.glb'){
    Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $CharOut $rel) -Destination (Join-Path $CharOut 'Mage.glb') -Force
  } else {
    # .gltf → wir lassen Pfad bestehen; kaykit_loader sucht Mage.glb, also zusätzlich irgendein glb duplizieren, falls vorhanden
    $someGlb = Get-ChildItem $CharOut -Recurse -Filter *.glb -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
    if($someGlb){ Copy-Item $someGlb.FullName (Join-Path $CharOut 'Mage.glb') -Force }
  }
  Write-Host "[OK] Charakter-Placeholder gesetzt: assets\kaykit\characters\Mage.glb"
}else{
  Write-Host "[WARN] Kein Charakter-GLB gefunden – Placeholder bleibt leer."
}

  if($prop1){  $map['prop1']  = Copy-WithDependencies $prop1  $dest }
  if($prop2){  $map['prop2']  = Copy-WithDependencies $prop2  $dest }

  $objs=@()
  if($map['floor']) { $objs += @{ model=$map['floor'];  position=@(0,0,0);   rotation=@(0,0,0);        scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['wall_a']){ $objs += @{ model=$map['wall_a']; position=@(0,0,-8);  rotation=@(0,$PI,0);      scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['wall_a']){ $objs += @{ model=$map['wall_a']; position=@(0,0,8);   rotation=@(0,0,0);        scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['wall_b']){ $objs += @{ model=$map['wall_b']; position=@(-8,0,0);  rotation=@(0,$HALFPI,0);  scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['wall_b']){ $objs += @{ model=$map['wall_b']; position=@(8,0,0);   rotation=@(0,-$HALFPI,0); scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['pillar']){ $objs += @{ model=$map['pillar']; position=@(-6,0,-6); rotation=@(0,0,0);        scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['pillar']){ $objs += @{ model=$map['pillar']; position=@(6,0,6);   rotation=@(0,0,0);        scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['prop1']) { $objs += @{ model=$map['prop1'];  position=@(2,0,0);   rotation=@(0,0,0);        scale=1.0 } }
  if($map['prop2']) { $objs += @{ model=$map['prop2'];  position=@(-2,0,1.5);rotation=@(0,0,0);        scale=1.0 } }

  $cfg[$r] = @{ objects = $objs }
}

# ==== NAJIKA QUICK-FIX (one shot) ============================================
$Root = "C:\NajikaCore"
$JS   = Join-Path $Root "js"
$Cfg  = Join-Path $Root "config"
$Char = Join-Path $Root "assets\kaykit\characters"
$Idx  = Join-Path $Root "index_3d.html"

foreach($d in @($JS,$Cfg,$Char)){ if(!(Test-Path $d)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $d -Force | Out-Null } }

# 1) consent_fsm.js (simpel & robust)
$consent = @"
(function(g){
  function ConsentFSM(){ this.state="OFF"; }
  ConsentFSM.prototype.event=function(ev){
    if(ev==="NSFW_ON") this.state="ON";
    if(ev==="NSFW_OFF"||ev==="SAFE_STOP") this.state="OFF";
    if(ev==="PAUSE") this.state="PAUSE";
    if(ev==="RESUME"&&this.state==="PAUSE") this.state="ON";
    return this.state;
  };
  ConsentFSM.prototype.active=function(){ return this.state==="ON"; };
  g.ConsentFSM = ConsentFSM;
})(window);
"@
$consent | Out-File (Join-Path $JS "consent_fsm.js") -Encoding UTF8 -Force

# 2) Minimal-Configs, falls fehlen
$corePath = Join-Path $Cfg "najika_personality_CORE.json"
$nsfwPath = Join-Path $Cfg "najika_nsfw_addon.json"
if(!(Test-Path $corePath)){
@'
{
  "meta": { "version": "1.0", "type": "Core Personality" },
  "identity": { "name": "Najika", "age": "Adult" },
  "style": { "base": "dramatisch, verspielt, analytisch" },
  "rules": { "stay_in_character": true, "concise": "2-4 Sätze", "no_ai_mention": true }
}
'@ | Out-File $corePath -Encoding UTF8 -Force
}
if(!(Test-Path $nsfwPath)){
@'
{ "meta": { "requires_activation": true }, "placeholders": ["SCENE_DOM_SOFT","SCENE_PRAISE","SCENE_TEASE","SCENE_AFTERCARE"] }
'@ | Out-File $nsfwPath -Encoding UTF8 -Force
}

# 3) Mage.glb Placeholder (falls KayKit fehlt)
$mage = Join-Path $Char "Mage.glb"
if(!(Test-Path $mage)){
  $anyGlb = Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $Root "assets") -Recurse -Filter *.glb -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
  if($anyGlb){ Copy-Item $anyGlb.FullName $mage -Force }
}

# 4) Force-Model Shim: alle /api/ollama-Calls -> model='najika'
$force = @"
(function(){
  function patch(){
    var of=window.fetch;
    if(!of){ return setTimeout(patch,300); }
    if(window.__forceNajika){return;} window.__forceNajika=true;
    window.fetch = function(input, init){
      try{
        var url = (typeof input==='string')?input:(input&&input.url);
        if(url && url.indexOf('/api/ollama')>-1 && init && init.body){
          var b=JSON.parse(init.body); b.model='najika'; init.body=JSON.stringify(b);
        }
      }catch(e){}
      return of.apply(this, arguments);
    };
    console.log('force_najika.js: model enforced');
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading'){document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',patch);}else{patch();}
})();
"@
$force | Out-File (Join-Path $JS "force_najika.js") -Encoding UTF8 -Force

# 5) index_3d.html patchen (Scripts vor </body>, wenn fehlen)
if(Test-Path $Idx){
  $html = Get-Content $Idx -Raw -Encoding UTF8
  $need = @(
    '<script src="js/consent_fsm.js"></script>',
    '<script src="js/ai_postprocess.js"></script>',
    '<script src="js/consent_bridge.js"></script>',
    '<script src="js/nsfw_controller.js"></script>',
    '<script src="js/force_najika.js"></script>'
  )
  $changed=$false
  foreach($tag in $need){
    if($html -notmatch [regex]::Escape($tag)){
      $html = $html -replace '(</body>)', ("  {0}`r`n$1" -f $tag)
      $changed=$true
    }
  }
  if($changed){ $html | Out-File $Idx -Encoding UTF8 -Force; Write-Host "[OK] index_3d.html patched" -ForegroundColor Green }
}

# 6) leeres favicon (404 weg)
$ico = Join-Path $Root "favicon.ico"
if(!(Test-Path $ico)){ New-Item -ItemType File -Path $ico -Force | Out-Null }

# ==== NAJIKA FIX: Mage.glb + Index säubern + Modell bauen =====================
$Root   = "C:\NajikaCore"
$JS     = Join-Path $Root "js"
$Cfg    = Join-Path $Root "config"
$Char   = Join-Path $Root "assets\kaykit\characters"
$Idx    = Join-Path $Root "index_3d.html"

# 0) Verzeichnisse sicherstellen
foreach($d in @($JS,$Cfg,$Char)){ if(!(Test-Path $d)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $d -Force | Out-Null } }

# 1) Mage.glb bereitstellen (aus vorhandenem Character kopieren)
$MagePath = Join-Path $Char "Mage.glb"
if(!(Test-Path $MagePath)){
  $NajikaChar = Join-Path $Root "assets\characters\najika.glb"
  if(Test-Path $NajikaChar){
    Copy-Item $NajikaChar $MagePath -Force
  } else {
    $SomeGlb = Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $Root "assets") -Recurse -Filter *.glb -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
    if($SomeGlb){ Copy-Item $SomeGlb.FullName $MagePath -Force }
  }
}
Write-Host (Test-Path $MagePath ? "[OK] Mage.glb gesetzt -> $MagePath" : "[WARN] Konnte kein GLB für Mage.glb finden") -ForegroundColor Cyan

# 2) index_3d.html von alten Three/Loader-Tags säubern, falls vorhanden
if(Test-Path $Idx){
  $html = Get-Content $Idx -Raw -Encoding UTF8
  $before = $html
  $html = $html -replace '(?im)^\s*<script src="https://cdnjs\.cloudflare\.com/ajax/libs/three\.js/r128/three\.min\.js">\s*</script>\s*',''
  $html = $html -replace '(?im)^\s*<script src="https://cdn\.jsdelivr\.net/npm/three@0\.128\.0/examples/js/loaders/GLTFLoader\.js">\s*</script>\s*',''
  if($html -ne $before){
    $html | Out-File $Idx -Encoding UTF8 -Force
    Write-Host "[OK] Alte Three/GLTFLoader Script-Tags entfernt" -ForegroundColor Green
  } else {
    Write-Host "[OK] Keine alten Script-Tags gefunden" -ForegroundColor Green
  }
}

# 3) Leeres favicon anlegen (404 vermeiden)
$ico = Join-Path $Root "favicon.ico"
if(!(Test-Path $ico)){ [byte[]]@() | Set-Content -Path $ico -Encoding Byte }

# 4) Minimal-Configs (falls fehlen)
$corePath = Join-Path $Cfg "najika_personality_CORE.json"
if(!(Test-Path $corePath)){
@'
{
  "meta": { "version": "1.0", "type": "Core Personality" },
  "identity": { "name": "Najika", "age": "Adult" },
  "style": { "base": "dramatisch, verspielt, analytisch" },
  "rules": { "stay_in_character": true, "concise": "2-4 Sätze", "no_ai_mention": true }
}
'@ | Out-File $corePath -Encoding UTF8 -Force
}

# 5) Ollama-Modell aus lokalem GGUF bauen (ein Modell: "najika")
#     -> Pfad zu deinem File: C:\NajikaCore\najika-brain\models\Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-Q5_K_M.gguf
$GGUF = "C:\NajikaCore\najika-brain\models\Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-Q5_K_M.gguf"
if(!(Test-Path $GGUF)){
  Write-Host "[ERR] GGUF nicht gefunden: $GGUF" -ForegroundColor Red
} else {
  $FROM = ($GGUF -replace '\\','/')
  $mf = @"
FROM $FROM

SYSTEM """
You are Najika — erwachsene, dramatisch-verspielte, analytische Begleiterin.
Bleib in Charakter, 2–4 Sätze, kein Meta/AI-Talk. SFW; NSFW wird clientseitig
über Platzhalter (SCENE_*) lokal expandiert.
"""

PARAMETER temperature 0.85

PARAMETER repeat_penalty 1.2
PARAMETER num_ctx 8192
PARAMETER stop "User:"
PARAMETER stop "</s>"

TEMPLATE """
{{ .System }}

User: {{ .Prompt }}

Najika:
"""
"@
  $mfPath = Join-Path $Root "prompts\Modelfile_najika_local"
  if(!(Test-Path (Split-Path $mfPath -Parent))){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Split-Path $mfPath -Parent) | Out-Null }

  try{ & ollama rm najika | Out-Null }catch{}
  & ollama create najika -f $mfPath
  Write-Host "[OK] ollama:model 'najika' erstellt" -ForegroundColor Green

ChatGPT:

Kurzfix für dein aktuelles Problem (THREE is not defined) + saubere Mage.glb-Ablage.
Kopier das komplett in PowerShell und drück Enter:

# ==== PATCH INDEX: stelle globales THREE bereit + Mage.glb sicher ============
$Root  = "C:\NajikaCore"
$Idx   = Join-Path $Root "index_3d.html"
$Chars = Join-Path $Root "assets\kaykit\characters"
$Mage  = Join-Path $Chars "Mage.glb"

# 1) Mage.glb sicherstellen
if(!(Test-Path $Chars)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Chars -Force | Out-Null }
if(!(Test-Path $Mage)){
  $pref = @(
    Join-Path $Root "assets\characters\najika.glb"
  )
  $src = $pref | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1
  if(-not $src){
    $src = Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $Root "assets") -Recurse -Filter *.glb -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 | ForEach-Object {$_.FullName}
  }
  if($src){ Copy-Item $src $Mage -Force; Write-Host "[OK] Mage.glb -> $Mage" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "[WARN] Kein GLB gefunden für Mage.glb" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
}

# 2) THREE global verfügbar machen (für nicht-module Scripts)
if(!(Test-Path $Idx)){ Write-Host "[ERR] index_3d.html nicht gefunden" -ForegroundColor Red; return }
$html = Get-Content $Idx -Raw -Encoding UTF8
$inject = @'
<!-- THREE global bridge -->
<script type="module">
  import * as THREE from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js";
  window.THREE = THREE;
</script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/js/loaders/GLTFLoader.js"></script>
'@

if($html -notmatch 'window\.THREE\s*=\s*THREE'){
  if($html -match '<script\s+src="js/(room_manager|kaykit_loader)\.js"'){
    # vor dem ersten Room/Kaykit-Script einfügen
    $html = $html -replace '<script\s+src="js/(room_manager|kaykit_loader)\.js"',
      ($inject + "`r`n" + '<script src="js/$1.js"')
  } elseif($html -match '</head>'){
    $html = $html -replace '</head>', ($inject + "`r`n</head>")
  } else {
    $html = $html + "`r`n" + $inject
  }
  $html | Out-File $Idx -Encoding UTF8 -Force
  Write-Host "[OK] THREE-Bridge + GLTFLoader injiziert" -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
  Write-Host "[OK] THREE-Bridge schon vorhanden" -ForegroundColor Green
}

Write-Host "`nFertig. Im Browser **STRG+F5** (Hard Reload)." -ForegroundColor Cyan
# ============================================================================
